sems can dbang ldan pas/ /myur du byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /e ma'o me tog mchod pa'i bdag /thams cad kyis 1snani rgyan byed de/ /gang phyir mchod nas de bzhin gshegs/ /rin chen nyid du myur du 'grub/ /e ma'o mchod pa'i mar me ni/ /rgya chen dge ba bdag yin te/ /gang phyir gnas snyebacas myur du ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi spyan yang thob3/ /e ma'o dri yi rang bzhin gyi/ /mchod pa'i lha rdzas yid 'ong babya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dri/ /lus rnams kun la 'byin par 'gyur④/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal gyes / rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa bzhi bskyed de/ 'di rnams kyi ched du brjod pa ni/ e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag spyan 'dren brtan pa'i bdag /gang phyir bdag gis spyan drangs pas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la brtan par 'gyur⑥/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje zhags pa dam po'i bdag /rdul phran zhugs pa thams cad kyang / /bdag gis slar yang drang bar bya/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog dam po'i bdag /bcings pa kun las grol ba rnams/ /sems can don kun 3bcing bar 'dod/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag /kun gyi bdag tu gyur nas kyang / /bran du yang ni gyur pa yin/ /zhes bya ba yin no/ /'di tsam kyis dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bstan pa yin no// //de nas bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad dang tha mi dad par bsams la bsdu bar ༄she bya'o/ /de nas bsdu bas byin pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā 31—999

da ban+dha dze+e hūṃka ro mi zhes brjod cing / e ma'o kun du bzang po yi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes/ /zhes ched du brjod pa ched du brjod par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs kar zhugs te slar byung nas/ rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa dang gcig tu gyur te/ yang ched du brjod pa ched du brjod pa mdzad de/ e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rngu/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba med/ /rdul phran thams cad ji snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gcig tu gyur/ /de nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba la sogs pa blangs nas/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du byas la/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btabs 5nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa dang / rigs thams cad la rgyas gdab pa dang /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drang ba dang / rjes su mnyes par bya ba dang / dgyes pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / 'od kyis snang bar bya ba dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la nges par sbyor ba dang / 'dzum pa rmad du byung ba la nges par sbyor ba dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs par bya ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gcod pa dang / dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa dang /spros pa med pa'i chos la nges par sbyor ba dang / mchod pa ma lus shing lus pa med pas de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / theg pa gzhan la 'dod pa 31—1000

dang / sems can nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las bsrung ba dang / srung tsho7ba thams cad las yongs su bskyab gepa dang / sku dang gsung dang thugs gcig tu byas pa nyid kyi bcing ba dzu nyid kyi khu tshur dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskyed pa dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khyems dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / smon lam dang / thabs rdzogs par bya ba dang / rdo rje lcags kyus sems can thams cad thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du dgug pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i spyod pa la gzhug pa dang / theg pa gzhan 'dod pa la ④sems dral ba dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing skye ba med par dbab pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi grong khyer bskyang pa nyid la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'di ni las kyi rgyal mchog ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin yin no// //de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs su bzlas pa'i spos chus/ mchod pa'i yan lag rnams bsangs la/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas yongs su bzlas la/ badz+ra pu྾ hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / me tog gi phyag rgyas me tog /badz+ra gadhe hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / dri'i phyag rgyas dri/ badz+ra dhū 5pe hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / bdug pa'i phyag rgyas bdug pa dang / a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde/ār+ya 6nut+pan+da tāta ces bya ba dang / ral gri'i phyag rgyas ni bshos te/ rdo rje bsdams pa las ral gris 'debs pa'i ④tshul du byed pa ni ral gri'i phyag rgya'o/ /badz+ra ā lo ke zhes bya ba dang / mar me'i phyag rgya ni mar me'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / til dang / nas dang / ku sha dang / 'bras yos dang / me tog dkar po dri zhim pa dang / tsan+dan dkar po'i chu dung la 31—1001

sogs pa'i snod du blugs la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i mtshan nyid can gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang lan gsum mam bdun nam①/ nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas la gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas ji lta ba bzhin du sgo dbye ba byas la / dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen po bcings te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes bzlas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' ③sbyor bdag nyid/ /lag ngar gnyis ni rdo rje btsir ༄snye/ /rdo rje se gol brdabs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bya/ /g.yon pa'i se gol brdabs pa dang / /g.yas pa yis ④ ni grub par 'gyur / /g.yas pa thal mo zhes bya ste/ /'dus pa yang ni gnyi ga yin/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje basbu ba'i phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid do/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza⑤ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya'i snying po'odu / /'di ni bka' 7tsam gyes bsgrags pas/ /'khor lo'i tshogs ni 'khor bcas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad gshegs 'gyur na/ /gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom byed cing / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig rab tu brjod par bgyi/ /de nas sgo rnams thams cad du/ /lcags kyu la sogs las bgyis nas/ /las chen mchog gi phyag rgya yis/ /dam tshig rnams ni gzhag par bgyi/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya dang / /sems dpa'i rdo rje la sogs pas/ /de ltar sems dpa' chen po bsgrub / /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes byar 9brjod/ /'di skad ces ston te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis bgegs bskrad pa dang / srung 7ba yang byas la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis sgo yang bcad 11de/ rdo rje sems dpas mchod yon phul la/ rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te/ badz+ra dh+wa 7tu dṛ sh+ya zhes 37—/002

bya ba la sogs pas thams cad blta bar byas la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ste sa ma ya ho ①a haṃ zhes bya ba dang / dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i snying po dang / sngags lan gsum brjod la chos dang las dang phyag rgya chen po rnams kyis kyang / de rnams la rgyas btab ste/ dbang bsgur ba'i phyag rgya rnams kyis sangs rgyas la sogs pas 3dbang bskur la/ mchod yon phul nas mchod par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā zhug ta puju pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / me tog gis so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang dris so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū ④pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang bdug pas so/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde 3ār+ya nut+pan+da tāta bye ces bya ba dang bshos kyis so/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dī pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ zhes bya ba dang mar mes mchod pa bya zhing klu/ sgeg mo la sogs pa mchod pa brgyad kyis yang dag par mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a rgo renit+yā ta na pū dza spa ra ṇa karma badz+re hūṃ ⑨aḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba ād+ma dz+wa — nit+yā ta na pū dza spa ra ṇa kad+ma kṛ rngo1dzaḥ.oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba ād+ma ā+oṃ rtsertanit+yā ta na a nu rā ga ṇa pū dza spa ra ṇa karma bā ṇi hūṃ hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta āt+pa lda ༄ rte/nit+yā ta na sā dhu ka ra pū dza spa ra ṇa karma tuṣ+ṭi aḥ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhe ṣe ke rasne bh+yo badz+ra ma ṇi oṃ/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta srubye bh+yo badz+ra te dza ni dz+wa la s+thāḥ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā sha pa ri pū ra ṇa tsit+na 'im ṇi dh+wa dzā gre bh+yo badz+ra dh+wa dza 7gre hūṃ/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma hā spru ti pra mor+ya kā ⑫re bh+yo badz+ra hā gya hāḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ga ta badz+ra dharma ta sa mā ti bhi stu no mi ma hā dharma kṛ s+thāḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā 31—1003

nir ha ri tu no mi ma hā gho ṣa nu ge sgo/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ak+ṣa pa ri bā ra ta di sarba sru tān ta na mastu no mi sarba maṇ+ḍa le hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarnya bhā ṣa budhe saṃ gī ti pirgo yo stu no mi badz+ra bārtse r+pā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pa pū dza me gha sa hūṃspa ra ṇa pū dza karme ka ra ka ra/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu྾ pra sa ra sga ra ṇa pū dza karme ki ri ke ri/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ka dz+wa la spa ra ṇa pū dza karme ka ra ka ra—/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa pū dza karme ku ru ku ru zhes bya bas sems dpa' bcu drug dang 'dra ba'i rig ma las kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /de'i phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin te/ rdo rje bsdams pa dkur bzhag ste/ /btsir ba gnyis su byas pa yisabye / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis ni/ /bsgyings bcas bsor rngub gnyis ka yis/ /lcags kyu 'dzin ltar gnas pa dang / /mda' 'phangs pa 5 yi tshul dang ni/ /legs so zhes pa snying gar bzhag /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gnyis/ /snying gar nyi ma bstan (byepar bya / /g.yon pa la ni gru mo gzugs/ /de bzhin kha phyogs bskor bar bya/ /g.yas pa yis ni g.yon par dbye/ /snying gar g.yon pa pya ral gri 'dud༅/ /mgal me 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /rdo rje gnyis ka kha nas dbyung / /rdo rje gar bskor bkrol ༄ ba yi/ /thal mo 'grom shesnapa spyi bor gzhag /go cha mthe'u chung phye 7ba dang / /khu tshur gnyis ni mnan pa'o/ /de nas phyag bzhi byas la/dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen pos peganas te/ oṃ badz+ra ād+ma kopho⑫haṃ zhes bya ba 'dis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjer bdag nyid bsgom mo/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā ba shurnyophothuhaṃ zhes bya bas rang bzhin gyis dag par mos par byas la/ oṃ sarba sa ma yo3 haṃ zhes bya bas 31byed1004

bdag med pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyis rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i lha thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa rdo rje'i tshig gam yid kyis bzlas la/ thams cad bdag yin no zhes bsgoms la/ lha thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'byung bar bsam zhing /bzlas pa la brtson par byas na de lta bus ni thams cad kyis bzlas par 'gyur ro//ji srid skyo bar ma gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bsgoms la skyo bar gyur na yang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod la/ mchod yon phul te mchod la khye phyag bzhi byas nas/phyag rgya gang dang gang nas byung ba de dang de nyid las bkrol la/ rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa'i phyag rgyas thu badz+ra muḥzhes bya ba dang / dgrol bar bya'o/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i gnas kyi nges pa ni bshad zin to/ /mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i gnas ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje rin chen dang / rdo rje chos dang / rdo rje las kyi gnas nyid yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyi gnas ni spyi gtsug yin no/ / de nas byerdo rje rin chen gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya snying ga nas byung ba/ rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas su gnas pa dang /oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca zhes bya bas phyag rgya thams cad dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sarba mu tram̐ mi tri ku ru ba ra ka ba tse na baṃ zhes bya ba dang / mdzub mo gnyis kyis snga ma bzhin du go cha bgos thu la/ tha mar mnyam pa'i thal mos snga ma bzhin du mnyes par byas la/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas/mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi phyir/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo stegye/bdag gi 4 cho ga ma tshang ba gang dag bgyis pa de bzod par mdzod cig ces gsol ba btab la/ mchod yon phul nas/ oṃ kṛ to ba san+d+ra 7satārja sidhe ma khye31—1005

daṭ+wā ya thā nu ga gats+tsha hūṃ ①bud+dhā bi ṣa yo/ pu na ra tsa ga ma na yats+tsha 1 zhes bya bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams gshegs pa'i phyir bskul bar bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra satwa muḥzhes bya ba'i snyeng po 'dis/ rdo rje sems ma'i 9phyag rgya gyen du dgrol bar bya'o/ /de ltar na thams cad kyang gshegs su gsol bar 'gyur ro/ /ji lta ba bzhin du sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams ni—/ de bzhin du yid kyis legs pa'i sbyor bas rang gi lus la bcug la/rdo rje srung sreb dang / rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje khu tshur dang / rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya rnams kyis bdag nyid bsrung ba byas nas langs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi las dang / glegs bam bklag pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de ltar nyin 6re zhing thun bzhir zla ba gcig gam/ zla ba drug gam/ lo gcig gam/dus ji srid kyi lha rnams las gnang ba thob par gyur pa de srid kyi bar du bya'o/ /yang na snga ma bzhin du rnal 'byor chen po dang / mchod pa la sogs pa byas la/de nyid kyis rgo rdo rje gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi 8ni phyag rgya cher/ /byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla/ /de nas badz+ra a ko la sogs pa'i snying po gsum bzlas la/ de'i don gsum po rnam par bsgoms nas / phyag rgya bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la sogs shepa'i sngags lnga pos rang gi snying gar / rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul la/ sngar bshad pa'i snying pos dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i gnas ji lta ba bzhin du bkod de/nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sbyor bas zhugs la/ badz+ra ād+ma ko la sogs pa'i sngags kyis de rnams dang gcig tu gyur par byas la/ badz+ra dh+wa tu ra haṃ swa yam̐ zhes bya bas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen por bdag nyid nges par 37byed1006

byas te/ thams cad kyang bdag nyid kho na yin no zhes bsgoms la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po'am/ sngags zlos shing lha thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang sngags kyi sgra 'byung bar ①yang bsam par bya'o/ /phyogs de lta bu la sogs pas kyang rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ngal zhing dub na mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis ④bstod pa dang / mchod pa dang 3/ phyag bzhi byas la/ thun bzhi'i tha mar yang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bstod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa ④byas la gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gsang sngags rnams ni/ rnal 'byor chen pos bsgrub par bya ba yin pas/ dkyil 'khor bsgom par mi nus pa gang yin pa des ni rnal 'byor chen po byas la/ thams cad kyi sngags re re zhing bzlas brjod 'bum 'bum byas la/ badzo tiṣ+ṭha snyezhes lan 'bum bzlas la rdo rje slong ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ mtshan thog thag bzlas brjod byas na 'grub ⑥par 'gyur ro/ /de nas brtsams te des bum pa la sogs pa de nam mkha' la 'jog par nus par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje mdzub sor gnyis legs par/ /rab mnyam gzhag pas bsnyams nas ni/ /shi ba thams cad slong ba ste/ /rdo rje slong ba zhes bya'o/ /badz+ra ā 5be+e sha a zhes bya ba yang bzlas brjod 'bum byas la/rdo rje dril bu mar la byugs te/ sreg blugs —/stong gis mngon par sbyangs la/rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i phyag rgyas bzung la mtshan thog thag bzlas brjod byas na de 'grub par 'gyur la lag na thogs pa thams cad 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga'o // //nyu 31—1007

de ltar sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ kun dga' ra ba 'am/ yul lam/ grong khyer kyi shar ram/ byang gi phyogs kyi char ram/ rang yoyid dang mthun pa der dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /der shin tu mnyam zhing snum la shar du gzhol ba/ tshad dang ldan zhing tsha sgo can ma yin pa'i sa'i char rgyal pos ni khru brgya 'am lnga bcu'o/ /blon po dang blon po chen pos ni khru lnga bcu'am nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /tshong dpon nam ded dpon gyis ni khru nyi shu'am de'i phyed do/ /sgrub pa pos ni khru bcu gnyis sam drug pa bya'o/ /de la dang po kho nar mngon par 'dod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su/ mi rus kyi phye ma khrag dang dug dang bcas pa dang / mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg kyi 2cho gas dkyil 'khor gyi bgegs bzlog la/ bdag dang slob ma dang sa bdag la sogs pa zhi bar byed 3pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas sa sbyang du gzhug par bya ste/ 'dom gang tsam la sgog ma'am lte ba'am pus mo nub pa tsam du 'og tu brkos la/ sgos chu dri zhim pos sbrus pa'i sas bkang la/ rdo rje rtse mo yongs su bzlas pa'i spos chus chag chag btab ste/ 'thas par bcags la shin tu mnyam par byas pa/ khang pa brtsegs pa'i nang du chud pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes par byas pa/ sgo bzhi dang skar khung gis yongs su bskor ba / tha mar dril bu legs par btags pa dang bcas pa'i rgyal mtshan dang /bla re'i 5mchod pa sna tshogs byes pa/ sangs rgyas rin po che la sogs pa'i ras ris dang sgu gzugs kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ grwa bzhir spos snod gzhag pa 6 /me tog dang mar me dang gos la sogs pas nye bar mdzes par byas la dris byugs te / rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs su bzlas pa'i spos chus yongs su bsangs la/31—/008

rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan bdun bzlas par bya'o/ /sa sbyang ba dang yo/ngas su gzung hūṃba'i cho ga'o// //de nas bdag nyid khrus byas shing lus dris byugs la/ ji snyed pa'i gos dang rgyan gdags shing / shin tu dmar ba'i gos bgos la/ me tog gi phreng ba gdags shing gdong dri zhim par byas la/ yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad nas brtsams te/ tshes bcu'am/ tshes bcu gsum mam bcu bzhi nas brtsams te/bco lnga'i bar du dkyil 'khor gyi las bya'o/ /gnyug mar gnas pa'i sa'i char ṭi phyag dar dang / skyang 5nul byas la/ de bzhin du lag pas reg par byas nas / rdo rje sems dpa' bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas cho ga thams cad spyad par bya'o/ /yang na 5/tshes bco lnga'i snga dro nas brtsams te bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i zhag ni/ slob dpon ④slob ma dang bcas pas smyung byebar gnas par bya'o/ /de la re zhig dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su 'dug la/bdag bsrung ba dang / bgegs gzhom pa la sogs pa bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i 'khor los dkyil 'khor sprul la/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa sngon du 'gro ba dang sdom pa bzung bye 7la/ rnal 'byor chen po dang khang pa brtsegs pa dang /gdan la sogs pa bskyed la/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/bdag nyid spyo ba bskyed par bya'o/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /lha dang dam tshig gis mnyam par/ /gyur par bdag ni som nyi med/ /byang chub sems dang sems gcig las/ /mi ldog par ni bdag gyur 3te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su ni/ /deng 31byed1009

bdag skye bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa mchog yin no/ /de nas yan lag thams cad kyis phyag byas te/spos snod lag tu thogs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bar bya'o/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yihūṃ/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba thuyis/ //rdo rje can gyi ṅku dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ dang po'i sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal ④mchog dang las kyi rgyal po'i sremachog rnam par bsgoms nas/ yang sgo dbye ba sngon du 'gro bsakhu/rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas su dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen pos gnas pa'i bar du byas nas/ de'i sngags zlos pa la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/sgrub pa'i grogs mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor zi ba'i phyir/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas langs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs la phyag byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nam mkha'i khams gang bar mngon sum du bsams la/bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /stobs chen rdo rje can bdag yin/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /phyag na rdo rje brtan bdag yin/ /bdag po rdo rje chen po bdag /byin gyis brlabs pa 7snami 'dor ro/ /de nas badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa zhes bya ba mig gnyis su bkod la/ yi ge a las rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed la/ rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te/ badz+ra satwa 31—/010

u/trīṣ+ṭha shezhes bya bas dkyil 'khor de nam mkha'i steng du bteg 3go/ /de nas rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya des bdag nyid lan cig byin gyis brlabs la/yang phyag rgya chen po bcings te/ phyag rgya la gnas de bzhin langs/ /kun du rnam par bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod nas/ /bsgyings nga/'i tshul gyis yongs su bskor/ /rdo rje'i rte lta bas phyogs dang mtshams dang /dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / ra ba dang dra ba byas nas/ rkang mthil nas yongs su gzung ④ste/ sa gzhi nas ri rab kyi rtse mo'i bar du/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byas la/ yang bgegs gzhom pa la sogs pa byas nas/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di dang ldan pas/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dgug par bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra sarba phyo maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ dzaḥ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdzub mo dang / mthe bong rdo rjer bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor thams cad dgug pa yin no/ /rdo rje 'khor 'o/'i phyag rgya dang / ma hā badz+ra tsakra a bye tiṣ+ṭha sibye hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis yang dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab kyepar bya'o/ /rdo rje rgyu'i las kyi phyag rgya nyid 'di'i phyag rgya yin no/ /de nas seng ldeng las byas pa'i rdo rje'i phur bu/dbus dang grwa bzhir rdo rjes brdung bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra ki 7la ya sarba birgyu ban+dha hūṃ zhes bya ba'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung ste/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa blangs la/ hūṃ zlos shing de dang dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhi dang dkyil 'khor gyi kye lte bar phur bu lnga bskyed la/ lag pa g.yas pa spurdo rje rtse gsum par byas pas brdung zhing 'di skad ces bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ gha gha s+thā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭan / phaṭa/ ki la ya ki ga la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭaḥme badz+ra ki 5la ya/ badz+ra dha rod 6ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs 31—1011

su bzlas pa'i bsang chu'i bum pa dkyil 'khor gye sgor bzhag la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi las kyi phyag rgyas bsrung ①ba thams cad brtan par byas la/ rdo rje go chas go bskon par bya ste/ de yang bcing ba'i cho ga'i 3spyor ba la/ /rdo rje khu tshur rab tu brtan snye/ /rdo rje go chas go bskon pas/ /dkyil 'khor kun nas bsrung bar spubya/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /yang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ dkyil 'khor yongs su brtag ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas dris nye bar byugs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i gnas su tsan+dan dang gur gum la sogs pa'i sde gus dkyil 'khor gru lngabazhi par byas la/ lhag ma rnams ni zlum por bya zhing rang rang gi sngags kyang lan bdun bdun du bzla bar bubya'o/ /de nas nam mkha'i phyogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dgug pa dang /gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang mnyes pa la sogs pa byas la rang gi snying gar bcug ste/ mchod pa lnga pos legs par mchod do/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i bum pa 'bru la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan par chu nyung zad cig ⑦blugs la / rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mchod yon phul te/ spos chu dang me tog kyang bcug la spos kyis bdugs te/ cho ga bzhin du lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /nyin zhag gnyis pa la thun gsum du yang dag par bzlas par bya zhing / des ḍo⑩dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /yang dkyil 'khor du bzlas la/'og nas bshad pa'i de'i 1 7mtshan nyid bdag nyid chen pos shes par byas la/rdo rje sems dpa'i spyan sngar gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin dang /rdo rje sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas spyan la re re zhing mar la sogs pa'i sreg blugs 1(dbul bar bya'o/ /lhag par gnas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o// //31—1012

de nas phyi rol du gtor ma byin la/ nye reg byas nas/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod de/ me tog la sogs pa dang sgeg mo la sogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa la ①mchod la/ phyag byas nas slob ma lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de la re zhig dang por khrus legs par bya'o/ /gos gtsang ma bgo zhing /lag na me tog thogs pa'i slob mas slob dpon la phyag byas la/ 'di skad smrar gzhug go/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rngutshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la sprul/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la sprulazhu/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byed du gzhug ste/rtog pa rnams ni legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang por ④ldan pas nyon/ /brjod khyengs blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid 5stsal gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar ma lus da ltar 3so sor bshags/ /bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya ches 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan la yang / /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo //thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing / /blo gros sdeg bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom/ /ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang zhugs pa/ /bde bar 3 1—1013

gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ /dman pas 'jigs pa rnams kyi rgyal byed tshal/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing / /blo gros rnams 17rgyal thugs rje cher ldan pa'i/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing / /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid//'bras bu'i stobs kyis 2dgra las rgyal gyur pa/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs/ /mnyam med byang chub rnam par gzung bar bgye/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am/ /yang na yongs su bskyab par zu bya phyir ram/ /rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /'di dag thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du btang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni/ /bdag dang gzhan rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir / /skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom par bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad 'phags gnas la bdag ni gnas par bgyi / /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /bdag gis de skad ces brjod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag gis bdog pa —thams cad yongs su gtang bar bgyi'o / /bdag gis 5sems can thams cad la mnyam pa'i sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad theg pa thams cad dang /thabs kyi bye brag thams cad kyis btul 6nas/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la rab tu gzhag par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis sems can 31—1014

thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur kyang / sems can 'ga' yang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba kyimed do zhes sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis chos thams cad skye ba med pa nyid du rjes su rtogs par bkyi'obye/ /bdag gis ma yengs zu pa'i sems dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sems kyis gyepha rol tu phyin pa drug la babe+eb par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis theg pa gcig gi tshul du gnas par yang rtogs par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la gnas par 5so sor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir bslab par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'uchos ma 'dres pa rnams so sor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir mngon par brtson par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa ma lus pa'i bar la mngon par gnas par bya ba'i phyir mngon par kye/bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /'di nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi byang chub chen por sems bskyed par 3rdo rje lta bu yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' bzhin byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo ste 'di nyid ni bcom ldan 'das kun du bzang po'o/ /de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyis ji lta ba 1bzhin du yang dag par rdzogs par byas pa'i 4 stobs kyis bdag sems bskyed pa 'di la gnas pas kun du bzang po'i spyod pa zhes bya ba sgo mtha' yas pa la gnas pa mtha' med par gyur pa rdzogs par byas nasashā1/gdul bya'i 'gro ba'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams la spyod pa'i rab tu dbye ba'i sgo mang po bstan pas yang dag par mgu bar bya ba dang / yang dag par dga' bar bya 37—1015

ba dang / yang dag par gzengs bstod pa la nges par sbyar bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sa ma ya a zhes bzlas pas slob ma'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la/de'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa de shebazhag la/ su ra ta sa ma ya ste a khyeho/ badz+ra sebye ya thā su khaṃ zhes bya ba'i snying po yang — snying gar bzlas la/ spyi bor spos chus brlan pa'i lag pa bzhag ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' bzlas shing / rdo rje bsam par bya'o/ /dpral bar yi ge tram̐ las rin po che/ gog mar yi ge hūṃ 4 las pad+ma/ spyi bor kai las sna tshogs rdo rje bsams la/ badz+ra satwa badz+ra rat+na/badz+ra dharma/ badz+ra karma zhes zlos shing / rang gi snying ga la sogs pa byebyin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dris de rnams kyi lag par dri sbyin par bya ste/me tog gis me tog go/ /bdug pas bdug spos dbul lo/ /mar mes mar me'i snang ba bya'o/ /de nas u dusmra ra dang a shwaṅga la sogs pa'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog bcings pa/ rdo rje bzhad pa bzlas la sbyin par bya'o / /des kyang shar ram byang du bltas te rtse mo nyid nas bca' bar bya'o/ /de nas ku sha sar pa la rdo rje rnon po dang / rdo rje sems dpa' yongs su bzlas pa byin nas/ 'dis ni gdan du gding zhing / 'dis ni sngags su gyis 7la khyol cig ces bsgo'o/ /de nas dpung pa g.yon par ni/ /rdo rje srung ba bzlas pa yi/ /srung skud mdud pa gsum ldan pa'i/ /bdag nyid kyis ni legs par bcing / /de nas zab cing rgya che ba'i chos ci nus par bstan pas / thams cad la gzengs 1bstod pa byas nas/ bzhin bzangs dag longs shig /nang par dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes bsgo ba lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //31—1016

de nas nyi ma shar kar dkyil 'khor de de bzhin du steng du nam mkha' la bzhag la thig gdab par bya'o/ /de la dang por re zhig tshon rtsi sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / lngang gu dang / dkar po dri zhim pos bsgos pas srad bu so sor lkubasgyur la/ go rims 'di nyid kyis bzhag nas/nge/ la hūṃ hūṃ byāḥ.a oṃ zhes bya bas rngurang rang gi sa bon las mi bskyod pa la sogs pa srad bu la bkod de/ dīp+ta dṛṣ+ṭi e ku sha dzaḥzhes bya ba mig gnyis su bkod la/rab tu g.yo zhing 'bar ba'i mig /mig gi rji ma 'dren pa ni/ /zhes bya ba'i 'bar ba'i lta bas/ mi bskyod pa la sogs pa la bskul zhing / bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor chen po'i zig gdab par bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje'i thig bdag la stsol cig /ces bya bas kyang bskul bar bya'o/ /de nas rang gi sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i mi bskyod pa la sogs pas btab pa'i srad bu 'bar ba'i lcags kyus bkug ste/ rang gi lag na gnas pa la/ srad bu /thu des gang bar byas la/ a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥ spa 5ra spa ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.a t+yan ta/ a nu pra biṣ+ṭa/ sarba dharmāḥ.oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes zlos shing bsgril bar bya'o / /bsgril nas mig g.yas dang g.yon gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba bskyed la/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭa skyem ṭa zhes tsubya bas brtan par byas la/ srad bu de 8dris byugs pa'i gser la sogs pa'i snod du legs par bzhag la/ dri dang me tog dang bdug spos la sogs pas mchod la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tram̐ mā nyi kra ma hūṃ zhes bya ba rdo rje bsdams pas bzung ste/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas sems dpa' bcu drug bzlas pa'i dris/ dkyil 'khor 3 1—1017

gye sa hūṃgazhi yang byugs la/ phyi rol kun du me tog gis mdzes par byas nas/bar snang la bzhugs pa'i rigs thams cad la dumachod yon phul te/ me tog la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pas thams cad mchod la/ phyag byas te/mig g.yas dang g.yon du yi ge dza ser bo bkod la/ nyi ma dang zla ba ser por snang ba bskyed de/ glu dang rol mo la sogs pa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor brtag par bya'o/ /de la re zhig sngar sngags bzlas pa'i srad bu dri zhim pa tha ma dkar po dang ldan pa/ yid kyis badz+ra dh+wa tu zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i ①tshig gis bzlas la rnam par snang mdzad du gyur par byas nas/ sgrub ④pa po'i grogs mchog badz+ra karma zhes brjod de rang gi snying ga 1nas rdo rje las kyi gzugs su sprul par bya'o/ /de nas badz+ra satwa zhes brjod de/ rdo rje sems dpar bdag nyid bsams la srad bu de g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur kyis bzung la/ dza zhes bya bas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog rdo rje las kyi gzugs can gyi lag tu srad bu de btang la/phyogs thams cad du sgomanyam pa nyid du bsgom zhing / shar phyogs su bltas te/rdo rje srad bus 7gdab par bya'o/ /yang slob dpon lhor 'dug la byang du bltas te/ gnyis pa gdab par bya'o/ /de nas me'i phyogs kyi char gnas pa la / byang du bltas te phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du thig gdab po/ /rlung gi phyogs su gnas te/ lho phyogs su bltas la nub kyi thig gdab po/ /de nyid du 'dug ste byang gi thig gdab po/ /yang me'i phyogs su 'dug ste lho phyogs kyi thig gdab par bya'o/ /kha khyer gyi thig kyang gdab par bya'o/ /yang me'i mtshams su gnas te rlung gi mtshams kyi bar gyi thig gdab pa dang / yang bden bral gyi mtshams su gnas te dbang ldan kyi mtshams kyi bar du 87thig 31—1018

gdab par bya zhing / slob dpon dang sgrub pa'i grogs mchog bskor huphyogs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /de la re zhig srad bu'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sru tram̐ mā ti kra ma hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / dza dza dza ⑫zhes bya ba gsum gyis sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis drang bar bya'o/ /de la sgo ni cha brgyad pa'o/ /sgo khyud ni sgo'i tshad kyi phyed do/ /kha khyer phyi'i thams cad dang nang gi kun ni sgo'i phyed do/ /tshon sna lnga'i sa ni kha khyer byu phyed kyi tshad du bya'o/ /rta babs ni sgo'i sum 'gyur du bya'o—/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor kyi phyed la zur bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa kha khyer gyis yongs su bskor ba/ ka ba brgyad dang ldan par thig btab la / zuseng ldeng gi phur bu 'og rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bu la/ steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyibs can gyi phur bu la/ rdo rje phur bu'i sngags bzlas la/ rdo rje tho bas brdungs te snga ma bzhin du btab la/ de la brtod pa'i srad bus nang gi dkyil 'khor dang / phyi'i rdo rje'i ④phreng ba dbang ldan gye phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas nas bskor ba'i rim gyis thugadab par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi tshad kyi nyis 'gyur la/ mtha' skor 6khru drug par bya ba ni tshad chung ngu yin te/gzhan dag tu ni ji tsam 'tsham 7par bya'o/ /da ni lung las gsungs pa'i thig gi mtshan nyid brjod par bya ste/ sar pa las ni bkal nas kyang / /tshad dang ldan pa mdzes pa yi/ /thig gis mkhas pa ci nus kyis/ /dkyil 'khor kyi ni thig gdab po/ /gru bzhir bgyi zhing sgo bzhi dang / /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes bgyis la/ /thig bzhi dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan / /grwa yi 8phyogs ni thams cad du/ /sgo khyud kyi ni nang rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol thig gdab po/ /de yi 31—1019

rim pa'i nang zhugs la/ /'khor lo 'dra bar rdo rje yi/ /thig gis yongs su bskor bya zhing / /ka ba brgyad kyis rmyemadzes bgyis par/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs la/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab po/ /shar dang nub dang byang dang lhor/ /thig bzhi btab pas dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /nang dang phyi rol kyi kha khyer dang / dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / rnga ⑤yab dang zla ba dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang bri ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi grwa'i mtshams thams cad du/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu btags pa'i ba dan sna tshogs btags pa dang / de'i sgo rnams kyi ni khyud kyi 5mtshams rnams su/ zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje rin po ches mdzes par bri bar bya'o/ /gal te bgegs byung ba bzlog par 'dod na/ phur bu'i sngags len 'bum bzlas pa'i phur bu zhidakyil 'khor gyi lte bar lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te gdab par brtan rngupa dang / dbyibs 'dra ba'i phur bus bgegs thams cad la 3gdab par bya'o/ /de yang ji skad du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi lte ba la btags nas/ shar nas bskor snye7phyogs su zlum por bskor ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor thig btab pa de'i phyi rol tu khor yug chen po/ de bzhin du zlum por thig btab la/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor der grog mkhar gyi sa la sogs pa las (bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan byas la/ brgya byin kyi gzugs brnyan shar phyogs na gnas pa la/ yi ge i las brgya byin mdog ser po'o/ /me la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan la yang de bzhin te/ ram̐ las me lha dmar po/ oṃ haṃ las gshin rje mdog 1nag po/ kai las srin po nag po/ paṃ las chu lha dkar po/yi thulas rlung lha dud ka /phaṭa las lus ngan po ser po/ sum+bha 4dzāzhes bya ba 31—/020

las dbang ldan dkar po bskyed la/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas bkug te rmyebacug la bcings te dbang du byas nas phur bus gdab po/ /shin tu yang yun ring du ②bgegs med par byed 'dod pas sas dgab par bya'o/ /de lta zun yang gal te bgegs byed na/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi spyor ba byas la 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bkug nas/ lcags kyu la sogs pas kyang dgug pa la sogs pa byas te / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ rkang pa g.yon pas bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan mnan te/ hūṃ baṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas spel ba'i tshul gyes/g.yon pa ④brkyang ba'i gnas pas 'dug la/ bgegs byed pa'i sprin la sogs pa la mngon par bltas te/ phyag rgya 'phangs te bstan thu la nam mkha'i khams thams cad du spros pas 'od zer 'bar ba kun du 'khrug bya pa'i rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyis / rkang pa bteg cing bsnun pas/ sprin la sogs pa thal bar byas par bsam thupar bya ste/ de lta bus ni bcom pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /yang na stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du byas la/ de'i 'og tu a las rnam par snang mdzad du gyur nas/ rgyud las bshad pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur nges par byas la haṃ las 'phags pa mi g.yo ba yid kyis byethugs ka nas phyung ste/badz+ra haṃ brnya zhes yid la brjod la/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rim du rlung gi phyogs su dri'i kyezig le bdun byas te/ thig le re re zhing yang re re'i nang du chud par byas la/ dbus ma dang tha ma yang 0thig le bdun dang ldan par byas te / thig le bdun po de dag kyang rlung lha bdun po ri dwags la zhon pa mdog nag po/ 'phags pa mi g.yo bas zhags pas bkug nas bcings par gyur par bsams la/ de rnams kyi ( dbus ma gcig ni gtso bo yin la/ lhag ma thig 31—1021

le drug po ni de bskor te kun nas 1gnas par bsam mo/ /de nas kham phor a las ri rab tu bsams la/ de'i steng du a nyid las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du rdo rjes g.yogs pa/ dbus su yang rdo rje rtse lnga pa yi ge hūṃ gi sa bon las byung ba mtshams rnams su mdung rtse gsum pa rnam par bsams la/de bzhin du badz+ra haṃ kyeban+ta zhes brjod de/ kham phor des ji skad du bshad pa'i thig le bdun dgab par bya'o/ /de nas kham phor dang ri rab kyi steng du oṃ las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad bsams te/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar g.yon brkyang ④bas ri rab mnan nas/ral gri dang zhags pas rlung rnams la sdigs mdzub mdzad par bsams te/ de lta bus ni gerlung rnams thams cad bcing ba hūṃbyas par 'gyur ro/ /de la /skyechu la sogs pa'i bgegs bzlog par mebashad par bya ste/ haṃ las rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i 'phags pa mi g.yo bar bdag nyid bskyed la/ grog mkhar gyi sa 'am/ ba glang 8gi phyi ba sa la ma lhung bas bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan byas nas/ khaṃ las ral gri/ ram̐ las me'i snying po bskyed la/ ki las zhags pa dang / lcags kyu bskyed de/ lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/lag pa g.yas pas lcags kyu dang zhags pas drangs nas/ bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan gyi nang du bcug ste/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas gnas la/ rkang pa g.yon pas spyi bo nas btsir la/ 'di skad ces brjod do/ /na maḥs man+ta badzā rde/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sgo ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra ka haṃ mo zhes brjod nas gzugs brnyan de ral gres gtub par bya'o/ /dug dang ske tshe dang lan tshwa la sogs pas gzugs brnyan bsgus la mes gdung bar bya'o/ /me yis gdungs pas de nyid 31—1022

kyang / /gdungs par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /tshangs pa'am brgya byin yin na yang / de yi mod la myur du 'tshig /ces bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/ /las 'di dag kyang 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor gyis de'i gsang sngags khri bzlas pa'i sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas de'i 'og tu las bya'o/ /yang oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs drug pa/phyag g.yas ①gnyis na ral gri dang dgra sta bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon gnyis na zhags pa zhugatun shing bsnams pa/ lho phyogs su gzigs pa/ khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis nam mkha'i khams kun du gang bar mdzad pa rngurnam par bsams la/mdung thung gi phyag rgya bcings la/ sprin la sogs pa bzlog pa'i bsam ④pas/tsham ngam dang bcas pas rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la/ mdzub mo gnyis sbyar ba ni mdung thung gi phyag rgya'o/ /de ltar na yang gal te bgegs rnams pyezhi bar ma gyur na/ kham phor so ma btang ba gnyis kyi nang du khrag dang dur khrod kyi sol ba dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang /da du ra'i lo ma'i khu bas sngags bris la/ yungs kar la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas nas/ kham phor kha sbyar te/ de'i nang du bzhag la/ me'i bgegs la sogs pa bsams la/ sreg blugs thubargya'am sreg blugs hūṃbadun sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas de dag 'jig ༄ pa'am 'chi ba'am/ mi ma yin pas gzung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sbyor bas yi ge hūṃ bzlas brjod 'bum byas la/ mi rus kyi rgyu las byas pa'i phur bu sor bzhi pa'i tshad tsam la/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ de bzhin du rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs 31—1023

pas bkug cing bcug ste bcings nas/ gzugs brnyan la phur bus gdab po rkade nas me'i tsha ba zhi bar tshubashad par bya ste/ me'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor—/ de'i steng du pad+ma'i dbus su gnas pa'i 'khor lo/ de'i steng du baṃ gnyis nas kyebacom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dung dang kun+da ltar dkar bar bzhugs te/ mtsho chen po ma dros pa 'dra ba'i rgya mtsho chen po bzhi las/chu bo bzhi 'bab pa lta bu'i char gye rgyun babs thu pas phyogs bcur 'gengs par gyur par bsam (snyepar bya'o/ /rdo rje can budang rdo rje me ltar 'bar bas kham phor gyi ④ri rab dang / phur bu yang dag par bsrungs kye7la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed can kye dag gis/ de rnams kyi nam mkha' bcing bar 7byas la/ rdo rje bcings pas dra ba bya'o/ /yang na mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg gis bgegs bzlog par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na gnas pa'i phur bu hūṃ bzhis bton la/ 'og nas bshad pa'i tshon sna lngas phur bu'i bu ga bkang la/ mnyam por gzhag go/ /de nas hi zhes bya bas mig g.yas pa dang / g.yon par nyi ma dang zla ba tshibaskyed la/ khro bo'i lta bas kun du bltas la/ sgo rnams bya'o/ /de nas tshon rtsi byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes bya ba / 'dis phyag rgya dang ldan pas tshon rtsi thams cad la lan bdun gyi bar du mngon par bzlas na/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /de la phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnyis las ni/ /mdzub mo rtse mo mnyam sbyar ba/ /byas nas tshon rtsi thams cad ni/ /'bar ba'i lta bas dgug par bya/ /hi zhes bya ba dang /31— 024

rdo rje nyi ma'i khro bo'i dam tshig 1gi phyag rgya dang / g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mtha' sbyar rngubar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes zlos shing dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams te/ g.yas nas bskor bas g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis tshon rtsi dgye bar bya ste/ phyis ci bder bya'o/ /de'i rim pa ni 'di yin te/sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang lngang gu dang dkar ba'i zurim pa 'dis ci bder dgye'o/ /khru drug par bya ba ni tshon rtsi'i ri mo chung tshad yin te/ de phan chad khru bskyed byepas rkang pa yang bskyed ⑤par bya'o/ /de yang rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ sngon po rdo rje rtse rang bzhin/ /gnyis pa gser la dmigs pa ste/ /pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin gzhan/ /de bzhin gzhan dag mar gta hūṃ'adra/ /dkar po nang du shes bya ste/ /'di ni klutshon gyi rim par bshad/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /shar phyogs su ni sngon po che/ /lhor ni ser po dang ldan pa/ /nub kyi phyogs ④ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni ljang gur yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ni/ /shel ltar snang ba bla na med/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril 'chang zhing / /rab mnyam gzhag ste de yis bri/ /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lngas brgyan la/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs gzhag cing / /sangs rgyas kyi ni phyogs kun gyi/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus rnams su/ /rim bzhin du ni dam tshig mchog /bzhi po legs par gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ngo/ de dag tu/ /rdo rje gom pas song nas ni/ /mi g.yo ba la sogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bzhi po thams cad gzhag /mi g.yo ba yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs mnyam par gzhag /rin chen 'byung ldan dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo 31—1025

rje snying sogs rdzogs par gzhag /tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje spyan sogs rdzogs par bzhag /gdon mi za ba'i nyudakyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje rgya gram la sogs gzhag /'khor lo yi ni grwa rnams su/ /rdo rje lha mo rnams kyang gzhag /dkyil 'khor phyi rol grwa rnams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rnams kyang gzhag /sgo rnams kun kyi nang du ni/ /sgo srung dubazhi yang gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim phyogs su ni/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang gzhag /de la rdo rje shugs kyi snying po ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra be+e gā kra ma hūṃ / de la 'di'i phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ yid kyis ri mo bteg nas ni/ /rdo rje srad bu'am gzhan yang rung / /phyir byung chanang du zhugs kyang rung ④/ /dam tshig nyams pa chode mi 'gyur/ /de la bcom ldan 'das rnam par ⑥rdo rje snang mdzad ni/ sku mdog dkar po seng ge'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dz+wa'od mnga' ba/ dar la'i stod g.yogs dang / smad g.yogs mnabs pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / dar dpyangs kyi zudabang bskur ba dang ldan pa/ zhal bzhi pa zhal dang po shar du gadzigs (khye pa'o de bzhin du mi bskyod pa la sogs ⑩yang de bzhin te/ sku mdog kyang sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / glang po che la sogs pa'i gdan la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / rdo rje rin po che dang / rdo rje pad+ma dang / sna tshogs rdo rje la sogs pa bsnams pa'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'od mnga' ba/ rin po che'i /1 cod pan dang / dar dpyangs kyi mudabang bsgur ba dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig pa ⑫rnam par snang 31—1026

ma/dzad la mngon sum du phyogs pa rnams rang rang gi phyag rgya chen po dang badz+ra dh+wa tu zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i snying po zlos shing bzhugs su gsol la/dz+res pa ltar bar snang la mngon du hūṃ bzhugs pa rnams kyang de bzhin du phab ste gcig tu bya'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan sngar / satwa badz+re zhes bya bas rdo rje sems ma sgu mdog sngon mo/ rdo rje rtse lnga nga/ dmar po bkod la/ badz+ra ā be+e sha a zhes bya bas dbab par bya'o/ /g.yas su rat+na badz+re zhes bya bas rin chen sems ma sku mdog ser mo/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rtse mo rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'o/ /rgyab tu dharma badz+re zhes bya bas rdo rje chos ma sku mdog dmar mo/ pad+ma dkar dmar 'dab ma bcu drug pa la 'dab ma brgyad thur du gyes pa/ 'dab ma brgyad gyen du bltas pa/kha ma bye ba'i nang na rdo rje rtse lnga pa chud pa'o/ /g.yon du karma badz+re zhes bya bas/rdo rje las ma sku mdog ljang gu/ sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ kha dog lnga pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa nas bskal pa bzang po'i mthar thug pa'i bar ni/ phyag rgya chen pos rang rang gi mtshan ma rdo rje la sogs pa bsnams pa / rab tu dgyes pas spyan gdangs pa/ sems dpa'i byal mo krung gis bzhugs pa yin no/ /rnam par snang mdzad ni de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yin la/'di dag thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings la dmigs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rnam par snang mdzad la mngon par phyogs par bya'o/ /mi bskyod pa'i mdun du ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /g.yas su ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /g.yon du ni rdo rje chags pa'o/ /rgyab tu ni rdo rje legs pa'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan gyi mdun du ni rdo rje rin chen la sogs pa yang de bzhin du shes par 3 1—/027

bya'o / /lhag ma ni shes pa kho nar zad do/ /phyi'i khyadakyil 'khor gyi khyams la byams pa la sogs pa/ bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhis 2stong du ma tshang ba/ shar phyogs la sogs pa'i phyogs su cha mnyam po go rims bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /de la shar phyogs pa rnams ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa'o / /lho phyogs pa rnams ni rdo rje rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /nub phyogs pa rnams ni rdo rje pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ /byang phyogs pa rnams ni sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /de nas 'di rnams kyi 1dgod pa'i rim pa dang / mtshan ni 'di dag khruyin te/ oṃ sarba saṃ s+thā /rngur pa ri shudhe dharma byute ga ga na sa muṅga te ma hā na ya thupa ri wā re swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'di ni rig pa'o/ /de la de rnams kyi mtshan ni/ byams pa/ seng ge/ rab gsal/ thub pa/ me tog /me tog gnyis pa/ spyan legs/ ded dpon/ lag ⑪chen/ stobs chen/rgyu kar 9rgyal po/ rtsi sman/ snyan pa/ tog /'od chen po/ grol ba'i phung po/ rnam par snang mdzad/ nyi ma'i snying po/ zla 'od 'phro/ 'od bzang / mya ngan med/ skar rgyal/ rab gsal/ phreng thogs/ yon tan 'od/ don gzigs/ mar me/ mthu ldan/ sman pa/ des kyepa/mdzod spu / bstan 7ldan/ lha'i dpal/ gdul dka'⑫/ yon tan rgyal mtshan/ sgra gcan/ tshogs can/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ tshig brtan/mi 'gying pa/ 'od mdzad/ lhun chen/ rdo rje sdom pa can/ mi bsnyengs pa/rin chen/ pad+ma'i spyan/ stobs sde/ me tog 'od zer/ ye shes dgyes/gzi chen/ tshangs pa/ 'od dpag med/ klu sbyin/ brtan par gshegs/don yod mthong / brtson 'grus sbyin/ bzang skyong / dga' bo/ 'chi 37—1028

pred / seng ge'i rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba/ chos/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po/ kha lo sgyur① / dgyes par gshegs/ chu lha/ yon tan lag /spos kyi glang po/ rnam par gzigs/ 'brug sgra/ legs sems/ yid bzangs—/ dri med/ zla ba grags chen/ gtsug na nor bu/ drag shul can / seng ge sdestabs/ ljon pa/ rnam par rgyal ba can/ shes rab brtsegs/le gas gnas/ blo gros/ yan lag skyes/ blo mtha' yas/ gzugs bzang / mkhyen ldan/ 'od zer/ brtul zhugs brtan/ bkra shis/bden pa'i tog1 /pad+ma/ sred med kyi bu/ lag bzangs/ ye shes 'byung gnas/ yon tan 'od 'phro/ tshangs pas byin/ rin chen 'byung gnas—/ lha'i me tog /don legs sems dpa'④ / chos kyi dbang phyug/blo gros grags pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ phan par bzhed pa/ rnam par rol ldan/ mun pa dang bral ba/ sgra gcan lha/ ri bo'i rgyal mtshan/ tshogs can 'od/ rin chen snying po/ shin tu mthor gshegs—/ skar rgyal/ ru rings/ yon tan gragasatre/ nyi zla/ nyi ma'i 'od / skar mkhan/ seng ge'i tog /dus mkhyen rgyal po/ dpal byu snying po/ srid mtha' gzigs pa/ glog gi 'od/ gser gyi 'od⑥/ seng ges byin pa/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i tsargyal mtshan/ mchog dga' grags pa/brtson 'grus brtan pa/ grags pa rdzogs pa/ bsnyengs pa dang bral ba/mchod 'os lha/ sgon ma chen po/ 'jig rten 'od/ spos dri zhim pa/yon tan mchog 'dzin/ mun pa dang rnam par bral ba/ seng ge'i 'gram pa/rin chen grags pa/ skyon rab zhi ba/ bdud rtsi 'chang ba/ mi'i zla ba/31—1029

shin tu gzigs pa/ rab tu brgyan khyepa/ nor bu'i 'od/ ri bo brtsegs/ pa'i tog /chos kyi 'byung gnas/ tshe sbyin/ rin chen 'byung gnas/ skye dbang mtshungs pa/ stobs kyis gshegs pa/ blo gnas/ gdugs mdzes pa/gtso bo shin tu 'phags dpal/ seng ge'i sgra/ rnam rol ldan pa/ klu'i 'od/me tog ri bo/ klu dga'/ spos kyi dbang phyug /shin tu grags pa/ stobs kyi lha—/ yon tan phreng ldan/ klu'i lag pa/ mig brgyan pa/ legs par sbyang ba'i ṭublo/ zil gnon ye shes/ mtha' yas pa'i spyan/ bden par nagasung / nyi ma'i 'od/ nges pa'i blo/ mtha' yas gzugs/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen tog /the tshom rnam par spangs pa/ 'jig rten 'das pa—/ don yod/ rnam par gnon pa/ rtog par mdzad pa/ me tog rgya'/ mtshan—/ ri dbang rgyal po/ gzi brjid chen po/ don mdzad gzigs nga//grags pa mtha' yas/ rin chen lha/ don gnas mkhyen pa/ blo rdzogs pa/mya ngan med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba/ tshangs lha/ sa'i dbang phyug /me+e tog spyan/ rnam par 'byes pa'i sgu/ chos kyi 'od/ kun gzigs/ yon tan—/ 'od gsal/ zla ba'i zhal/ rin chen 'od/ rin chen tog /grags pa'i bla ma/ 'od byed/ gzi brjid dpag med/ dus mdon/seng ge'i sku/ mkhas blo/ rgyal bar dka'azi/ yon tan phung po/ zla ba'i togalta /mthu thob/ mthu pa 3mtha' yas/ zla ba/ dri med/ don thams cad gzigs pa/ dpa' bo/ 'byor ldan/ bsod nams/ sgon ma/yon tan 'od 'phro/ blo yangs/ legs skyes/ nor lha/ yid gnyis spong /'dzin pa dpag med/ mchog sred/ chom shaṃ med/ mi gnas pa/ der 31—1030

gnas—/ tshogs can gtso bo/ 'gro ba'i 'od zer/ phal chen rgyal ba/gzi brjid mtha' yas/ don gyi ①blo gros/ sman pa'i rgyal po/ tha ba spangs nga/ / rims nad med pa/ legs sbyin/ grags sbyin6sna/ me tog byin/skyes bus ①byen/ rdo rje sde/ phal chen sbyin/ zhi ba'i blo gros/ spos kyi glang po/ sred med kyi bu/ des pa/ mi tshugs pa/ nyi zla/ glog gi togapya/mchod pa zhes bya ba ste/ nyis brgya lnga bcur gcig gis ma tshang ba byeni shar phyogs kyi khyams kyi nang du dz+re bar ༅ bya'o / /ghudapal sbas/ ye shes nyi ma/don grub/ lhun po brtsegs/ dgra 'dul/ pad+ma/ dgra bcom grags pa/ye shes 'gros/ nyon mongs bral/ 'dam bu/ spos bzangs/ yul 'khor rangs/ lha grags/ srid mtha' gzigs/ zla ba/ sgra gcan/rin chen zla ba/ seng ge'i rgyal mtshan/ bsam gtan dgyes/ rdzogs ldan/rnam par rol pa/ yon tan rin chen/ dgra bcom grags pa/ pad+ma'i ngos/mdzod spu ldan/ spobs pa grags/ rdo rje nor bu/ tshe dpag med/ nor bu bkod / dbang chen/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ lhun po grags/ 'od zer bcu pa/ ma smad pa/ glang po'i 'gros/ yid 'thad/ rin chen zla ba/zhi ba/ rab gsal rgyal po/ kha lo sgyurashe/ dga' ba'i dbang phyug /gtsug na rin po che/ bsnyengs bral/ rin chen snying po/ zla zhal/ dri ma mred par grags pa/ zhi ba'i gzi brjid/ dga' ba'i tog rte /sgra gcan lha/na tshod bzang po/ lha dga'/ rin chen phung po/ mdzes par gshegs/ seng ge'i phyogs pa/ shin tu mthor gshegs/ skye ba'i dbang po/ blo gros bzang po/ 'jig rten 'od/ rin chen gzi brjid/ skal ldan/ shing rta/31—1031

kun du rgyal ba/ dga' ba bkod pa/ stegs 1mdzad pa/ spos kyi glang po/blo gros 'od 'phro/ ri bo'i rgyal mtshan/ rin chen spos bzangs lge chos brtan—/ gzi brjid drag shul can/ chos kyi nor bu/ bzang pos byen pa/bde gshegs zla ba/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ seng ge'i zla ba/ /tshungs grupa med pa'i dpal/ legs par skyes pa je/ thub pa med pa'i tshogs/ grags pa'i bshes gnyen/ bden pa/ dka' thub chen po/ lhun po'i 'od zer/yon tan brtsegs pa/ mchod pa grags pa/ chos grags/ sbyin pa'i 'od/glog 'byin/ bden par gsung ba/ 'tsho byed/ na tshod bzang po/legs pa'i tshogs can/ rnam par nges pa'i blo gros/ srid mtha' nor bu'i spos / rgyal bas dgyes pa/ seng ge'i 'od zer/ rnam par snang mdzad/grags pa mchog /thugs rab tu gzhungs pa/ nor bu'i zla ba/ drag shul 'od zer/ brtul zhugs thub med/ 'gro bas mchod pa/ nor bu'i tshogs/'jig rten bla ma/ glang chen seng ge/ zla ba/ rin chen 'od zer/ sgra gcan sbed pa/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ 'od zer ldan pa/ rab tu zhi ba'i stobs5 /'jig rten bzang po/ mya ngan med pa/ shugs bcu pa/ stobs la dgyes pa/mthu dpal/ mthu thob pa/ mthu chen po/ yon tan snying po/ bden par spyod pa/ dge mchog rgyal po/ skar rgyal/ 'od zer chen po/ glog gi 'od/yon tan rgya chen rin po che/ dpal 'od/ bdud 'dul bar mdzad pa/go cha bgos pa/ seng ge'i phyag /me tog bzang po/ rin chen mthon po/rgya mtsho/ sa 'dzin/ don gyi blo mnga' ba/ yon tan bsags pa/ yon tan tshogs/ rin chen me/ 'jig rten 'das pa/ 'jig rten zla ba/31—1032

dbyangs snyan pa/ tshangs pa'i tog /tshogs can gtso bo/ seng ge'i stabs/drag shul gyis byin pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug /gzi brjid 'od/ 'od zer chen po/ rin chen snying po/① rin chen grags pa/ tshogs can gsal ba/grags pa mtha' yas/ 'od zer don yod/ lha'i drang srong / skye ba'i dbang po/ dge 'dun brtan/ phyogs bzangs①/ tog /yul 'khor me tog /chos kyi blo gros/ rlung gi shugs ltar gshegs pa/ legs bsam grags pa/ snang ldan/ lha tshogs/ yon tan srung zu/ don gyi blo gros/bsnyengs med/ grogs brtan/ 'od gnas/ mtshungs med④/ nor bu'i zhabs—/ thar pa'i gzi brjid/ ngos bzangs/ blo bzangs/ kun du gzi brjid/ ye shes mchog /tshangs par gnas/ bden pa gsung ba(snye/blo bzangs/ stobs byen/ seng ge stabs/ me tog /ye shes 'byung gnas—/ me tog byen/ yon tan snying po/ rin chen grags pa/ grags pa rmad du byung ba/ mi mtshungs pa/ bsnyengs med/ nyi ma'i 'od/ tshangs par gshegs pa/ lha'i mthu rtsal/ ye shes dgyes/ lha bden/ nor bu'i snying po/ ye shes dpal/ bcings med/ brtul zhugs brtan/ lha'i gzi brjid/ tshangs pa thub/ dal gyis bzhud/ brtul zhugs/ dka' thub / 'od zer phung po/ gzi brjid chen po/ tsam pa ka /dga' mdzad—/ tshogs can bzang po/ dbang po'i rgyal mtshan/ dgyes pa chen po/sna ma'i me tog 'od/ tshogs can 'od/ bsgrun 3༄par mdzad/ mdangs 'gro/don legs nges/ khyu mchog /lag bzangs/ 'od zer chen po/ bsam pas byin/ bsod nams 'od/ rin chen dbyangs/ rdo rje'i sde/ 'byor 31—1033

ldan—/ seng ge'i stobs/ dri ma med pa'i spyan/ 'od srungs①/ blo gsal/ye shes blo grosabye/ gzi brjid drag shul can/ 'od zer chen po/ nyi ma'i 'od—/ dri ma med pa'i 'od/ gzi brjid rnam par 'byes pa/ khengs med/sbrang rtsi'i zhal/ zla 'od glog sbyin/ rab tu zhi bar gshegs/ mi 'khrugs pa/dgra bcom grags pa/ chos kyi yon tan/ zhing bzang po/ bkod pa'i rgyal po / mngon par 'phags pa/ sbyin sreg 'od 'phro/ pad+ma'i dpal/ rin po che'i bkod pa/ shin tu bzang po/ rin po che'i mchog /thugs shin tu gzhungs pa/ 'od dpag med/ rgya mtshos byin/ tshangs pa'i tog /zla ba'i gdugs/ 'od 'phro ba/ dri med rgyal po/ 'di rnams ni lho phyogs kyi khyams kyi nang du bri bar bya'o / /zhuye shes grags pa/ kun las rgyal ba/yon tan 'od/ sgra rnam par grags pa/ zla ba rgyas pa/ pad+ma'i 'od zer/brtul zhugs bzang po/ sgon ma rgyal po/ glog gi tog /'od zer rgyal po/skar mkhan/ grags pa rdzogs ldan/ pad+ma'i snying po/ rgyal spyan mdzes/rnyog pa med pa'i don/ drag shul sde/ bsod nams gzi brjid/ mthu rtsal can / thogs med blo/ sgra gcan lha/ ye shes phung po/ kha lo sgyur ba/skye dbang mtshungs pa/ me tog tog /sgra gcan 'dzin/ rtsi sman chen po/rgyu skar rgyal po/ sman pa'i rgyal po/ bsod nams glang po/ gcod ④par mdzad pa/ rnam par grags pa'i rgyal po/ nyi ma'i 'od zer/ chos kyi mdzod/blo gros bzang po/ yon tan dbang mtshungs/ rdo rje'i sde/ shes rab brtsegs / legs par gnas/ blo sbyangs/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ yon tan mchog /'brug sgra dbyangs/ mngon par shes pa'i tog /tog gi 'od/31—1034

mi 'dren dge ba/ tshangs pa/ skyes mchog spyan sdug /klus byin/ bden nga/'i tog /brgyan pa/ zhum ①pa med dbyangs/ rin chen 'od/ dbyangs byen / seng ge 'od zer sna tshogs/ ye shes dpa' bo/ pad+ma'i phung po/pre tog rgyas pa/ mthu rtsal stabs/ bsod nams phung po/ gzugs mchog/ska/ra mkhan/ zla ba'i sgon ma/ gzi brjid phung po/ byang chub rgyal po/mi zad pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i spyan/ yan lag brgyad thupa/ yul 'khor shes rab/ mchog /gzi brjid tshim mdzad/ shes rab byen/'jam dbyangs/ chags pa med mdzad/ gtso bos byin/ gtso bo/ ye shes mthu tsalakye/ 'od 'phro can/ dbang po/ shugs 'chang / skar rgyal/'od bzang po/ grags pas thu byin pa/ gzugs bzang po/ rgyal po/don grub pa/ seng ge'i sde/ nor lha'i bu/ grags pa/ rgyal ba/ brgya byen snying po/ bsod nams 'od zer/ 'od zer bzang po/ smrang 'don/sgon ma'i rgyal po/ ye shes brtsegs/ lha mchog /sa'i bdag po/ rnam par grol ba brnyes pa/ gtsug gi gser/ sgra gcan bzang po/ thub dka'/thub gsal/ zla ba'i 'od zer/ gser kyi 'od/ legs byin/ lha'i yon tan dbang po/ chos kyi gdugs/ bsod nams lagasaphya/ chags pa med pa/ye shes gya nom/ blo gros zhib mo/ gzi byin thams cad pa/ rtsi sman rnam par grol ba'i tog /'od kyi mdzod/ ye shes rgyal po/ 'jigs mdzad/chu bo'i spong ba/ thogs med grags pa/ bden pa'i phung po/ dbyangs snyan pa/ ri dbang mtshungs/ chos brtsegs/ thar pa'i gzi byin/legs mdzad/ rab tu zhi ba'i sku/ yid du 'ong ba'i gsung / blo sbyangs/31—1035

chu lha/ 'gro bas mchod/ seng ge'i legs①/ chos kyi mthu pal⑤/ skal pa bzang po/ mi 'khrugs pa'i mdog /gzi brjid rgyal po/ rtog mdzad spyan legs/ don la gnas pa'i blo mnga' ①ba/ snang ba'i 'od zer/ spos kyi gzi brjid/ kun du dga' bar mdzad pa/ don yod par gshegs pa/khro ba bcom pa/ gzugs mchog /legs gshegs/ rab tu sbyin par grags pa/ 'od bzangs④/ lha'i nyi ma/ shes rab byin/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i bdag nyid/ gzi mdangs/ rgyal rigs/ skal ldan shing rta/gser mchog /rnam par grol ba'i gtsug /chos ldan/ spos gnas/dregs pa spangs/ ye shes kyi mdzod/ tshangs par gshegs/ tsan dan mya ngan med pa/ seng ge'i 'od zer/ yul 'khor tog /pad+ma'i snying po/gzi brjid mtha' yas/ lha'i 'od zer/ shes rab me tog /mkhas pa/ye shes 'byor ldan/ tshangs pa dbyig /phyag na rin chen dbang ldan rdzogs par gsung ba/ mchog gsung / mchod 'os/ skar rgyal nyi ma/ 'dam las rgal ba/ ye shes brnyes/ grub pa/ rma bya/ mchod ⑤sbyin/ phan par bzhed pa/ ye shes ldan pa/ grags pa 'od zer kyi dra ba/ rnam par bcom pa/ bai ḍūr+ya'i snying po/ me tog lha'i rgyal po/ /zla ba dran pa'i 'od/dge ba'i 'od/ yon tan mchog ma/ kun 'od rin po che'i dpal/ skyes bu zla ba/ sgra gcan/ bdud rtsi'i 'od/ 'jig rten mchog /skar ma'i 'od—/ zhi ba'i stabs/ ye shes rgya mtsho/ ri'i dbang po/ rab tu zhi ba/yon tan mtha' stobs/ lha'i dbang po/ dbyangs snyan pa/ ngos bzang /don la gnas pa/ yon tan gzi brjid dpal/ mkhyen ldan zla medakhya / nga 31—1036

ro dpag med/ 'od bzangs①/ shin tu thugs gzhungs pa/ don dgongs gnyi mug bral/ dbyangs kyi yan lags ④khyad 'phags/ mchog tu mdzes par gshegs pa/ zhi ba'i don/ skyon med blo/ dbyangs dge ba/ pad+ma'i mdzod—/ 'od zer bzang po/ spobs pa'i mdog /stegs bzang po/tshogs kyi dbang po/ bsnyengs pa ①dang bral ba/ ye shes bzhed pa/ spobs pa'i spyan/ blo'i mchog /zla ba/ rin chen zla 'od/ bsnyengs pa med pa/gzi brjid chen po/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ dbyangs bzang po/ shes rab chen po'i stegs/ blo gros zla med/ rdo rje mkhregs pa/ byang chub blo gros/ljon shing dbang po/ gdangs snyan pa/ bsod nams stobs/ mthu'i dpal/'phags pa dgyes pa/ mthu stobs/ skar ma la dgyes pa/ sprin gyi rnga sgra/'di rnams ni nub ④phyogs kyi khyams kyi ⑤nang du zi bar bya'o / /⑥spyan sdug pa'i zhal/ ye shes bzang ldan/ 'byor par ldan pa/ yon tan phung po/gsal ba/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ ye shes nga ro/ nam mkha'/ mchod sbyin nga ro/ shes rab rnam dgod nga ro/ yon tan 'od zer gzi brjid/ drang srong dbang po/ blo dang ldan pa/ spobs pa'i tshogs/ mchod sbyin/bzang po/ zla ba'i zhal/ shin tu gzigs pa/ rdul dang bral ba/ yon tan tshogs/ tog dang ldan pa/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yul 'khor spobs pa/ rin chen rab sbyin/ zla ba dgyes pa/ seng ge'i stobs/dbang sgyur rgyal po/ bdud rtsi gsal ba/ bsam gtan snyoms pa/'khrugs hūṃ pa med pa/ dri ma rab zhi/ phyogs ma bslad — pa/ mdzes pa zhal bzangs—/ shugs gnas/ ye shes ldan pa/ gsungs pa'i rngudabang po/31—1037

gzi brjid chen po/nyu blo gros zab mo/ bdud rtsi/ chos kyi stobs/mchod par ldan/ me tog 'od/ khams gsum mchod gnas/ sgra gcan nyi ma'i snying po/ lha'i mchod pa/ thar pa'i rgyal mtshan/ dge ba'i gtsug /bdud rtsi 'od/ rdo rje brtan pa/ rin chen phung po/ mdzes par gshegs pa/nyi ma ltar gshegs pa/ dga' ba'i 'od/ yon tan gtsug /dpal rdzogs/seng ge'i stabs④/ gyen du 'phags pa/ me tog byin/ 'od 'gyed/ pad+ma/ye shes dgyes/ bkod pa mdzes/ gti mug med par gnas pa/ rma med pa/tog gi rgyal mtshan/ bde bar dgongs/ gti mug med pa'i rgyal po/ /cho ga mkhyen/ dag pa'i rgya mtsho/ rin chen mnga'/ mi mnga' ba/ skye bo dga' bar mdzad pa/ rma bya'i nga ro/ ma zhum pa/ srid pa'i sred pa/ dri ma spangs pa/ spyod pa'i stegs/ lha mang pos snyan par grags pa/ rin po che'i stabs/ phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa/ dpal/ dgra las rgyal ba/'byor ldan grags pa/ yul 'khor bzang po/ me tog 'od/ seng ge'i nga ro/zla ba ltar shar ba/ 'joms pa'i mchog /mi g.yo ba/ phan pa dang ldan par gshegs pa/ bsod nams sgon ma'i rgyal po/ dbyangs kyis gubaskul ba/gau ta ma/ mdangs stobs/ blo gnas pa'i rang bzhin/ zla ba bzang po/byang chub yan lag me tog /bkra shis legs donabye/ ye shes gzi brjid/stobs—/ dge ba'i sgol 57 ma/ mthu stsal brtan po/ lha sgra(bye/ rab tu zhi ba—/ nyi ma'i zhal/ thar pa'i brtul zhugs/ tshul khrims 'od/ brtul zhugs gnas/ rdul med snying po 'phags/ mig sman/ 'phel bar mdzad pa / spos kyi 'od/ dus mkhyen 'od/ dran pa'i dbang po/ thogs pa 31—1038

med pa'i rgyal mtshan/ byang chub mchog bgrod/ spyod pa gsal/ rin chen dgyes / chos kyi dbang phyug /lha thams cad pa/ bshes gnyen chen po/bshes gnyen bzang po/ rab tu zhi ba'i stabs①/ bdud rtsi'i bdag po/lhun po'i 'od/ 'phags pas bstod ⑤pa/ snang ldan/ gzi brjid 'bar ba/snang ba gzigs/ legs spyad ①rnam par smin/ legs dgyes/ mya ngan bral/rin chen 'od/ spyod pa dang ldan pa/ bsod nams stobs/ yon tan rgya mtsho / rmad du byung ba/ nga rgyal spong / bdud brlab 0par mdzad pa/bag chags las rgal ba'i stobs/ mi phyed pa'i blo mnga' ba/ rgya mtsho/dag par mdzad pa/ tshogs can grol khruba'i rgyal po/ dga' ba'i 'od/byang chub rgyal mtshan/ ye shes rin chen/ shin tu bsel ba tshangs pa rgyal ba/ ye shes dgyes/ rdzu 'phrul tog /skye dbang mtshungs pa/ sa'i dbang phyug /nyi ma dgyes/ sgra gcan zla ba/ me tog 'od/ sman pa'i bdag po/ mdangs mnga'/ bsod nams dgyes/ dga' ba'i stobs/dbyangs snyan pa/ chos kyi dbang phyug /tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ spyod pa bzang po/ 'khrul pa med pa'i blo/ dbyangs chen po/ snyan par grags pa/tog ldan/ gzi brjid/ rnam par grags pa/ 'gro ba'i dbang phyug /ljon pa/ gti mug rab zadabyu / dpag tu med pa/ zla ba bzang po/spobs pa mtha' yas togadza /brtul zhugs bstar ba/ mchod pa'i gnas/mya ngan rgal/ dge ba dgyes 2pa/ 'gro ba'i blo gros/ dgyes par gshegs pa / zhabs mdzes/ at+palaspu / dul gnas me tog /sgobs pa mtha' yas—/ 'od zer/ drang srong gsal ba/ yon tan brtson 'grus/ snying po/31—1039

lha'i bdag po/ rin chen mthon po/ gsal ba/ skal ldan shing rta can/bsod nams blo gros/ sbyin sreg 'od 'phro/ yon tan mtha' yas/ gzi brjid phung po/ seng ge'i ①stabs/ mi g.yo ba/ rab gsal/ 'od spyod pa—/ glu dbyangs/ 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ dbyig gi mchog /'jig rten dga' ba/ dga' ba mtha' yas grags pa/ sprin kyi tog /shes rab 'gros/spos ②bzangs/ nam mkha'i dbyings/ ①lha'i rgyal po/ nor bu gsal ba/nor bzangs/ sgon ma/ rin chen nga ro dbyangs/ skye dbang rgyal po/ sgra gcan sbed pa/ dge ba mdzad/ seng ge'i blo gros/ rin chen grags pa/don mdzad pa/ mdzad mtha' gzigs pa/ srid pa'i me tog /mdzod spu ldan pa/ spobs pa mtshungs med0/ rgyal po/ ye shes rnam 'byed nga ro/seng ge'i mche ba/ mdzes par gshegs pa/ bsod nams sgon ma/ bkra shis ldan pa/ yul 'khor mya ngan med pa/ blo gros sems dpa'ape/ blo dang ldan pa/ chos kyi sgon ma/ spyan/ shin tu gzigs pa/ shugs kyis 'dor ba—/ stobs chen/ shes rab me tog /brtan pa'i dbyangs/ bde dang ldan pa/ don gsung ba/ dgyes pa gsal rjo ba/ seng ge'i zhal/ gtsug phud snang bar mdzad pa/ 'di rnams ni byang phyogs kyi khyams kyi nang du bri bar bya'o / /7/yang na byams pa dang / mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song kun 'dren dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros / spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha'i mdzod/ ye shes tog /'od dpag tu med pa/ zla ba'i 'od/ bzang skyong / dra ba can gyi 'od/ rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/31byed1040

kun du bzang po zhes bya ba/ bcu drug po ji ltar mngon par dga' ba'i sku mdog dang / rgyan dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / dar dpyangs kyi hūṃdabang bskur ba dang ldan pa dgod par bya'o / / bye phyogs bzhir rnguyang rta babs bzhi dang ka ba brgyad/ khru drug gam bdun gyi tshad tsam rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyu las byas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang / dril bu dang dar la sogs pas brgyan pa / rdo rje sems dpa' mngon par bzlas par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi shar la sogs pa'i ④ phyogs kyi char/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sdong pos brgyan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdang / gser 'od dam pa klog tu gzhug go/ /chos smra ba de dag kyang sangs rgyas ltar ci nus pas mchod par bya'o/ /de lta bus ni bgegs thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / dkyil 'khor grub par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad du spos snod brgyad dzilas ga pur dang / a ga ru dang / tu ruska skye dang tsan+dan la sogs pa rgyun mi 'chad par gtul bar bya'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor legs par bkod nas/du phyi rol nye 'khor kun du dris nye bar byugs la/ mo tog gi sil ma bkram nas/ dgongs ka'i dus su/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas me tog gi phreng ba blangs la/rdo rje shugs kyis dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya zhing / oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ zhes kyang brjod par bya'o/ /yang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi lhag pa dang / ma tshang ba'i 1 nyes pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bltas la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing dkyil 'khor 'ilan bdun bskor /shārteb byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la/ phreng ba phul te/ rdo rje gar byas nas blangs la rang gi mgo 31—1041

la bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ zhes kyang rgyun mi 'chad pa kho nar bzla bar bya'o/ /de yang / rdo rje dril bu rab bskul bas/ /sangs rgyas ma tshang yongs su bskoralku / /lhag pa gang yin 'dor mdzad pas/ / 'grub 'gyur smad par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i rjes la yi ge hūṃ las bdag nyid rdo rje hūṃ mdzad du bsam par bya'o/ /de nas dbus su 'dug nas ni//rdo rje slob dpon mnyam gzhag pas/ /rdo rje sgo ni rnam bzhi'o3 / /yid kyis su ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badz+re gha ṭā zis ma ya/ shā a+yobe sha hūṃ/ rdo rje mdzub mo yang dag sbyar/ /sbyar ba bkan te bsdams nas su/ /rab tu khros nas dbye ba ni/ /sgo dbye ba yi mchog yin no/ /de nas rin po che'am/ sa las byas pa'i bum pa/ rtsa ba mi gnag pa gsus pa che ba mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang gyeb/ byi ru dang / gser dang / dung dang / mu nyig dang /pad+ma rā ga ste rin po che thams cad dang / bṛ ha ti ⑦dang / kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang /ha sa dang / daṇ+ḍita pa la dang / shwe ⑪ta a pa ra dzi kluta ste sman thams cad dang / 'bras dang / nas dang / gro dang / til dang / ma sha ste/'bru thams cad dang / spos chu dri zhim pa dang / me tog dkar po dri zhim pas yongs su bkang la/ dris kun du byugs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba btags la/mgul pa ras dkar po bzang pos bcings pa/ 'dab ma dang 'bras bu dri zhim pas kha brgyan pa/ sngar bsnyen pa byas pas mchod yon phul la/ rdo rje bsdams pa la sems ma rdo rje mas yongs su gzung ba'i rdo rje me tog gi lcug ma las—/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ badzo ⑫ da ka hūṃ zhes bya ba yang bzlas brjod stong rtsa brgyad byas la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 37—1042

—sems dpa'i spyan sngar gzhag go/ /gnyis pa la yang rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ 'jug pa'i sgor mngon par phyogs par bya zhing /chu des bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /'jug pa'i dus su slob ma byang chub lkusems ma'i phyag rgya bcings pa'amadzu / 'ching du gzhug go/ /dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i bum pa la yang / so so rang rang gi mtshan mas mtshan la/ de rnams kyi rang rang gi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad yongs su bzlas la / dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi mtshams su gzhag par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi yang phyi rol du ni bum pa gang ba'o/ /ma rnyed glupar gyur na bcu las nyung bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs pas④ / dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bum pa dang / bum pa gang ba yang dbul bar bya ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rin po che dang / chos dang / las kyi rdo rjes mtshan la/rang gi rigs kyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas pa'i bum pa bzhi dang /bum pa gang ba bzhi dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad mngon sum lta bur bsams la/ me tog la sogs pas yang dag par mchod de/phyag bzhi la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sdom pa gzung trel/ rdo rje sems ma ji lta ba bzhin du bcings la 'jug par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i 4/chu ji lta bar 'thungs la/ bdag nyid la dbab par bya ste/ g.yon pa'i khro bo'i khu tshur kyis lag pa g.yas pa'i sems ma rdo rje ma'i gung mo yang dang tsuyang du dral 8zhing /a zhes bya bas ji lta ba bzhin du brtan par byas la/ dbab pa nas/ de nyid kyis 6ni rdo rje gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi rtseni phyag rgya cher/ /byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla/ /zhes bya ba'i bar gyi 31—1043

cho ga sngar bshad pa rnams byas la/ 'og nas bshad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lngas rjes su gnang ba dang / gzengs ①bstod pa dang / lung bstan pa dang /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sngags kyang blang bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag la byin gyes brlab pa la sogs pa byas nas/ bdag rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba la sogs pa ming ④gang yang rung ba brjod la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag rgya chen po bcings te/ de'i gnas su badz+ra dh+wa tu a zhes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid du phab la/ badz+ra 3 haṃ zhes brjod do/ /de nas badz+ra jo tu ra haṃ byas pas rdo rje dbyings su bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i bar gyis ④phyag rgya chen po bcings la/ de'i gnas su badz+ra ā 3be sha aḥ'uzhes bya bas/ rdo rje dril bu bdag nyid la 3 phab ste/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍipho druhaṃ/de nas badz+ra ā be+e shā haṃ zhes bya bas dril bu der bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar na rdo rjes bsgrub spupar 'gyur ro / /⑩ rdo rje slob dpon sems dpa' yi/ /1rdo rje lcags kyu bcings nas ni/ /se gol mang po brdabs ⑫bgyis la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dza ⑫dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod do/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom ⑫byed cing / /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig 1rab tu brjod par bgyi/ de bzhin du rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas/ dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du byas la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis bgegs thams cad wībaskrad pa dang / ra ba dang dra ba byas te/ dam tshig gi rdo rje khu tshur gyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bcad la/ yi ge gnyis kyis go cha'i srung bas ⑫thams cad yang dag par bsrungs 8nas/ mchod yon phul la sngon du 'gro ba'i dam 31—1044

—tshig gi 1phyag rgya rnams kyis blta ba byas la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya ste sa ma ya ste/a/ haṃ zhes brjod par bya zhing / rang rang gi snying po dang / sngags kyis kyang mthar yang dag par bskul la/ chos dang las kyi kyephyag rgya chen po rnams kyis kyang phyag ①rgyas btab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa nas/ bskal pa bzang po'i mthar thug pa'i bar du dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rnams kyis kyang dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa'i rang gi snying po nyid chos kyi phyag rgya yin no/ /rdo rje dang / rin po che dang / chos dang las ma rnams kyi ④ phyag rgya dang / phyag hūṃrgya chen po ni rdo rje la sogs pa'i nang du tshud pa'i bud med kyi gzugs 'dzin pa dang 4/ yang na de rnams rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i gzugs can no/ /g.yon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur bkan la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang mdzub mo gnyis kyi mthe'u chung nas brtsams nas phye la/ thal mo khong stong du byas pa 'di ni/ byams pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ 'di rnams kyi rig pa ni sngar bshad pa yin no/ /rig pa de dag nyid de rnams kyi ljags la bkod pa 'di ni de rnams kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yi ge a las rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed la/bris pa dang de'i rjes su mthun par/ de rnams phyag rgya chen por bcing ba ④/ni/de rnams kyi las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga par bsams la/ bris pa dang rjes su mthun pa kho nar de rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po bcing bar bya'o/ /rig pa tsade nyid kyang spyi'i yin no / /ḍade nas mchod yon phul nas mchod par bya ste/ ras zung 'bum mam/ zung khri'am/ zung stong ngam / zung brgya'am/ zur re re'am/ thams cad la spyir zung gcig 31byed1045

dbul ba'am/ bla re rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / grwa bzhir ba dan rnam pa sna tshogs gdags pa dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan rnams kyang yi ge oṃ dang rdo rje sems dpa' lan bdun bzlas la dbul bar bya'o/ /me tog gi shing brgya'am/ bzhi'am me tog thams cad kyang snga ma bzhin du mngon par bzlas la/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ zhes bya bas dbul bar bya'o/ /dri la 3rig pa bzlas pa'i dris byugs la/ dri zhim pa'i dri bzang po thams cad dang /bdug spos kyi rig 3pa bzlas pa'i/ ga pur thu.a ka ru dang tu ru ska dang /tsan+dan la sogs pa legs par sbyar ba'i bdug pa gtul ④ba'i spos snod 'bum mam—/ khri'am/ stong ngam/ brgya dbul bar bya ste/ bcu las nyung ba ni mi bya'o/ /mar me'i snod 'bum mam/ khri'am stong ngam brgya'am bcu'am bzhi la snga ma bzhin du mar me'i sngags bzlas pa dang / swaste ka la sogs pa'i lha bshos kyi kha zas bza' ba dang / bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'i snod 'bum mam/ khri'am/ stong ngam/ brgya'am/ bcu la a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa snga ma bzhin du bzlas te/ lha thams cad la dbul bar bya'o/ /rol mo'i cha byad pyestong phrag bcu khyesnyed la yi ge hūṃ dang 1rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi lag pa'i sor mo rnams kyis rol mo brdungs pa byelta bu'i phyag rgya rnams kyis/rol mo bcu po 'di lta ste/ pi waṃ dang / gling bu dang / rnga dang / cang te'u dang / cha lang dang / rnga bo che dang / rdza rnga dang / rnga rings dang /guñja dang / ti mi li dang / brdung ba'i tshul du byed pas dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi rol du gar mkhan dang / rol mo 1dang / cod pan dang / gdu bu dang /rna rgyan 7la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams /skyekyang / oṃ dang hūṃ 8mngon par bzlas 37byed1046

—'a/ dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dar dpyangs dpyang bar ①bya ba dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / rnga yab kyis brgyan cing / dra ba dang dra ba 4phyed pas spras pa/ zla ba phyed pas nye bar mdzes par byas pa/ rta dang glang po che dang /ba lang gi khyu shin tu btags tshipa rnams kyang dbul bar bya'o/ /rta babs yid du 'ong ba'i dril bu la sogs pa dang bcas pa yang dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas sbeg mo la sogs pas kyang yang dag par mchod la/ dngos grub thams cad grub pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzod cig ces de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba gdab ④par bya'o / /gede nas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor du bzhag la/ phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ 'bras yos bcas shing til dang bcas/ /'bras chan blume tog chu dang bcas/ /sran chen ⑦bcas shing mang du bya/ /snum khur la sogs bza' ba rnams/ /zhes ldubya ba'i gtor ma la/ a kā ro zhes bya ba la sogs pa bzlas nas/ shar phyogs nas brtsams nas/ gtor ma gsum gsum gtor bar bya zhing / dri dang spos dang / me tog dang / mchod yon rnams kyang thog ma dang mtha' khyamar dbul bar bya'o/ /de la dang por re zhig maṇ+ḍal rnams byed du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas spyan drang ngo / /de nas dam tshig bstan la/ mchod yon yang phul te/ dri la sogs pas legs par mchod la gtor ma phul te/ de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de la sngags dang phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin te / shar phyogs su kha bltas te/ rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang ba'i tshul gyis 'dug nas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan la/ g.yas pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya sta zur phyogs su bzhag ste g.yas pa'i mdzub mo'i lcags kyus spyan drang ba 31—1047

ni / brgya byin spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar ma byas pa ni brgya byin gyi ①dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /rkang pa g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis/ 'dug la/ spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang pa ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas de'i sngags ni/ na mo badz+ra su tsa di shi di shi badz+ra pā ṇi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ me'i phyogs su bltas nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo zlum por bkug ste/ gung mo'i tshigs gsum par btsugs la/ mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa 'di ༄ )ni/ me lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sbyan drang ba'i phyag rgya las bye mthe bong gi ngos la/ mdzub mo btsugs pa ni/ me lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo mthe bong ngos la btsugs te/phyir drag tu brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i sngags ni aghi a bye nyi ka pa li a ka pa li/cho/ dz+wa la dz+wa la da ha shi khi tod rū pāk+ṣa swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su bltas nas snyim pa mdun thudu bzhag ste/ sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba rngo la khu tshur bcings nas srin lag gnyis bgrengs te thugashibs la g.yabs te/ de nang du bzhag pa ni/ gshin rje spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /srin lag gnyis yang phyi rol du de bzhin du gshibs te/ bsgrengs 8la snying gar gzhag pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las srin lag sbyar ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni ya ma ye swā hā/ bden bral gyi phyogs su bltas te/ rkang pa mnyam par 'dug la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khya tshur bcangs pa las( / mdzub mo dang gung mo ral gri 'dra bar gshibs te/bgreng la bzhag /lag pa g.yon pa yang de ltar byas te/ sta zur logs su bzhag la/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bkug ste/ g.yab pa ni bden bral spyan 31—1048

drangs pa'i 4phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las g.yon pa sta zur logs su ral gri 'dra bar bzhag pa ni/ bden bral gyi dam tshig gi bye phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i bye phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni/ be+er btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni sarba khyu ④ta bha yi ka ra ku ru ku ru swā hā/ chu lha'i phyogs su rkang pa mnyam par 'dug la/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcings ④/nas/ mje bong dang mdzub mo gnyis gcig tu sbyar te/ zhags mig ltar byas la g.yon pa'i khu tshur yang de ltar ⑥ byas te/ snying gar bzhag ste 7/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo'i chabe+egs kyus g.yab spyo)pa ni/ chu lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las g.yon pa'i mdzub mo khu tshur gyi tshul du bzhag pa las/ zhags mig ltar byas pa ni chu lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rgya las/ mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni tri tri pu sha /tri tri shi gi to li bi ru ⑫pāk+ṣa swā hā/ rlung lha'i phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs te/ gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs dang por/ mdzub mo bkug pa'i thor to btsugs ⑪la/ lag pa g.yas brkyang 3de bzhin du bya ste/sta zur logs su bzhag cing ⑫/ mthe bong bsgul ba ni/ rlung lha spyan drang ba'i phyag rgya'o ④/ /de nyid las mthe bong snga ma bzhin du gzhag pa ni rlung lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drang ba'i dam tshig gi muphyag rgya las mthe bong brkyang ba ni/ slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni/ oṃ sā saṃ khā khā khu kha swā hā/ ku be ra la mngon du bltas te/ 'dug nas/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la/ rdo rje bcing ba nang du bzlog wīste/ mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs la brkyang / de'i rgyab tu srin lag gnyis so sor bzhag nas/ gung mo gnyis rdo 31—1049
