bar the tshom med/ /deng bdag nyi ma dam pa ste/ /bdag gi mchod sbyin bla na pred—/ /sangs rgyas thams cad spyan 'dren pas/ /deng bdag 'dus pa'i ma/chog yin no/ /de nas yan lag thams cad kyis rmyephyag byas la spos snod lag tu thogs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bar bya'o/ /ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor bri/ /deng 'dir sangs rgyas kun gshegs te/ /dngos grub 'di ni stsal du gsol/ /de'i rjes la sngar bshad pa'i rim pas de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas / de nyid kyis ni rdo rje gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /dam tshig gi du ni phyag rgya cher/ /byin gyis brlabs nas snying po bzla/ /de ltar dam tshig gsum mchog tu thob pa'i slob dpon gyis rang gi phyag rgyas/ 'khor lo kun gyi cho ga ni/ /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bya/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub byed pa'i/ /rtog pa kun la yang dag 'jug /dam tshig che gsum zhes bya ba / /rgya 'di gsang sngags sgrub byed yin/ /dngos grub kun gyi cho ga la/ /rdo rje dril bu rab sgrub yin/ /cho ga lhag gam ma tshang yang / /'grub 'gyur smad par mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das la yang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/bcom ldan 'das sems can gyi khams ma lus pa lus pa med pa'i skyabs dang /phan pa dang / bde ba thams cad myong bar bgyi ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid kyi grub pa dam pa'i 'bras bu thob par babyi ba'i bar du stsol bye cig par bdag la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lgogrub pa'i rdo rje stsal ⑤ te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis ge 31—1173

bka' sprul na/ mi 'di rnams ji ltar bgyi ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsol cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yang gcig tu 'dus nas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ma hā ma da lo/ pra be sha ya sadze+e dubye /ro tran ni ba ra ya ba be bya/ pra mo k+ṣa ya dur dṛṣ+ṭa par+ya ban+dha bi sho dha ya nā sha ya/ bi nā sha ya ha ha ha ha hūṃ/ de ltar rjes su gnang ba thob nga/ dang / khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor steng du nam mkha' la bzhag nas/ de nyid kyi snye bdag nyid byin kyis brlabs te / phyag rgya de nyid rang gi snying gar bzhag la de'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas khro bo'i lta bas blta zhing dbang ldan nas brtsams te/ bgegs thams cad bskrad pa la brtson par bya'o/ /yi ge a las rang gi rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje bkod la/rang gi rkang mthil kyis yongs su bzung thunas/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas brtsams te ri rab kyi steng gi bar du dkyil 'khor gyi gnas de rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par mos pas hūṃ bzhi zlos shing / g.yas nas bskor bas 'gro bar bya'o//de nas khro bo'i lta bas dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / ra ba dang / rdo rje dra ba bya'o—/ /yang hūṃ zhes zlos shing rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi gzugs nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byung ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i khro bo la sogs pa rdo rje 'bar ba 'jigs su rung ba kun du 'khrugs pa/ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i dgra 5'jigs su rung bas sgog ma'i phyogs kun du gang ba dang 6/ khro bo'i sku mchog gis mi shaṃgayo ba rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha' nas babs te/ gar las byung ba'i me tog gi thal mos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 8yang dag par mchod la/ dkyil 'khor kyi lte 31—/ 174

bar g.yon brkyang pas 'dug ste/ bskal pa'i me dpung ltar 'bar ba'i khro bo'i tshogs 'byin pas bdud thams cad kun du skrag par bya'o/ /de nas dga' bas yo/ngas su bskor ba'i tshul gyis shar phyogs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas des g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pa nyu/nyid kyis 'dug la/ bgegs thams cad bskrad nga/ra bya'o/ /de nas gnas de nas lho phyogs su song la g.yas brkyang ba'i gnas pas de bzhin du bgegs rnams rjes su bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas gnas de nas g.yas brkyang ba dang / g.yon brkyang ba dag gis nub phyogs su song la/zlum po'i 'dug stangs bcas nas de bzhin du bgegs rnams bskrad par bya'o/ /de nas gnas de nas nam mkha'i khams ma lus par khyab par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams g.yo bar byed pa'i rdo rje'i 'gros kyis 4byang phyogs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /de nas g.yas brkyang ba dang mthun pa'i rkang stabs dang /zlum po'i 'dug stangs dang / sa ga'i 'dug stangs rnams kyis bgegs rnams nges par bskrad par byas nas/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis shar phyogs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /de ltar na stang stabs bzhis bgegs thams cad gzhom par bya'o/ /yang rdo je'i 'gros kyis kyidakyil 'khor gyi cholte ba bskor bar byas la/ shar phyogs su mngon par bltas te/ mchod 5nas dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba phur bu'i 'gros su 'gro bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i khro bo'i phur bus dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su d+ngha ༄phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /stang stabs byed pa'i dus 'dir khro bo'i tshig gis hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra rgyun mi 'chad par gdon par bya'o / /de nas rdo rje'i 'dug stangs phyed kyis 'dug la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na khārka hūṃ zhes zlos shing g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag nas/ g.yas 31—1175

pas rdo rje bsor lkuzhing bgegs rnams la bsnun par bya'o/ /yang rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas kyang bgegs rnams bsreg pa la sogs pa bya ste/ hūṃ badz+ra a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ( r+shar ṇa hūṃ phaṭa rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la sgyu/ sor mo rnams nang du 'bar ba ltar byas la mthe bo rdo rje ltar 4 bsgreng ba ni rdo rje me'i phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tri brnya sarba bispyon hūṃzhes bya ba phyag rgya dang ldan pas bgegs rnams bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mje bong gnyis brkyang ste stoms la bzhag 6/ pa ni rdo rje spyan dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya'o / /rdo rje bsdams pa brkyang la bzhag ste4/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ rnyo me bha ba rak+ṣa sabaṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba dang 'og bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang sngags/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes bya ba phyag rgya dang bcas pas nam mkha' bcing bar bya'o/ /rdo rje thal mo mthe bong poganyis brkyang la mdzub mo gnyis mche ba lta bur bya ba ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sbyan gyis rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi ⑪steng du nam mkha' bcing bar bya'o/ /oṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings (rkal/ mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du bskor te/ mgo bo'i steng du mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du gzhag pa ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas shar phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba'i sngags so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ mthe'u 1lngachung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar la bzlog ste spyi bor gzhag pa 'di ni rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /yang rdo rje zhags pas de nyid bcing bar bya ste/ hūṃ badz+ra pā sha dīḥrdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mkhrig ma mdud pa byas pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'o/ /rdo 31—1176

rje ba dan gyis ①nub phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra pā tang ki pā tang ki ni ra ṭa rngurdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong ④gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du byas la / mdzub mo gnyis mnyam ⑤ nas srin lag phye ste/ mthe'u chung gnyis ba dan gyi rtse mo ltar byas pa ni ba dan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rdo rje nag mos byang phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ s+thāḥbadz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya nyid snying gar bzhag la brtan par byas pa ni rdo rje nag mo'i'o/ /rdo rje rtse mos lho phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa ra spyoru ṭa ma ṭa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis 3ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul du bya ba ni rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje las kyi dkyil 'khor bcing bar bya'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra karma yo byehūṃ zhes bya ba rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi byer ba byas nas rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje dra ba bya'o/ /sngags ni badz+ra bhan+dha /⑫baṃ/ de'i rjes la sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgyas sgo phye la/ rdo rje'i rgyu'i sperang bzhin can gyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa badz+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūṃ dzaḥzhes bya ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas dgug par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo dang mthe bong rdo rjer bya ba ni dkyil 'khor thams cad 'gugs pa'o/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra tsakra a bye tiṣ+ṭha sedhe muhūṃ zhes bya ba dang bcas pas dgug pa ni dkyil 'khor des byin gyis brlab par bya'o—/ /rdo rje khya tshur gnyis 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul gyis bskor ba ni 'di'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas seng ldeng gi rdo rje thuphur bu yi ge hūṃ las mtha' yas dang murnam par rgyal ba dang / sprin sgra dang / gsus po che zhes bya/ stod khro bo'i gzugs la smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam par bsams la tsan+dan dmar po'i byug pas byugs shing / srad bu dmar pos bcing bar mubyas la/ oṃ lakro dha ya sa 37—1/77

hi ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa tri ta ma ṭa mazhes bya ba brgya rtsa brgyad zlos shing g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung rdogyel/ dkyil 'khor kyi grwa bzhir rdo rjes brdung bar bya ba'am/g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa blangs la/ lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa lta bur byas pas dbang ldan rmi phyogs nas brtsams te/ dkyil 'khor kyi tshugrwa bzhir ji skad du bshad pa'i phur bu bzhi sngags 'dis skyed cing 5brdung bar bya'o/ /oṃ gha gha ghā zhe)ta ya ghā dzata ya sarba dubye 8/ phaṭa/ tī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ badz+ra tī la ya badz+ra dha ro ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ yang na oṃ badz+ra tī le tī khā tsuya sarba be+espyo ⑫hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bya ba phur bu bzhi la yongs su bzlas la 'di nyid zlos shing g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyes bzung la g.yas pa'i 'bar ba'i rdo rjes brdung nyu1zhing dkyil 'khor gyi spugrwa bzhir gdab par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis bgegs bsal 6ba dang / ra ba dang dra ba yang byas la/ dam tshig gi rdo rje khu tshur gyis sgo bcad skrude/ rdo rje go cha'i phyag rgya oṃ bye 15zhes bya ba'i sngags dang bcas pas lha rnams dang bsrung ba thams cad yang dag par bsrungs wīnas/ rdo rje gnod sbyin bzlas pa'i bum pas bsang gtor bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i sgor bzhag la rdo rje gnod sbyin zlos shing bdag nyid dam/ grogs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar nas brtsams te byug par bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rtse—bdag po lnga'i gnas su tsan+dan dang gur gum nal sogs pas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa bya/ lha lhag ma rnams kyi gnas su ni dkyil 'khor zlum por bya zhing rang rang gi sngags lan bdun bdun bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su 'dug la yid kyis dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su brtag par 3gebyas nas nam mkha'i 37—1178

phyogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang /bcing ba dang / dbang du byas la gur gum 77la sogs pa'i thig le de rnams su rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rang rang gi sngags kyis 27bzhugs su gsol la mchod pa rnam pa lngas yang dag par mchod par bya'o/ /de nas phyi rol du gtor ma byin la nye reg byas nas/ mchod yon la mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang / yi ge hūṃ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ 'di 1skad du bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum par spos chu cung zad blugs 4la/hūṃ las rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed de/ rang gi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab la dbang bsgur ba'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur nas/ mchod yon phul nas semachod pa rnam nga/ lnga dang / sgeg mo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams kyis kyang yang dag par mchod nas—/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas yongs su bzung 6ba'i rdo rje dang me tog gi lcug ma las kye.oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas me tog gis sel mar gtor nas 8spos kyang gtul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje me dang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad gnyis yongs su bzlas pa'i bdug spos dbul bar bya zhing / dkyil 'khor gyi zhag ni thun gsum du bzla'o/ /de nas rdo rje 9 hūṃ mdzad kyi spyan sngar gzhag par bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par skruganas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin dang / rdo rje me dang / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang /mā ma tī la re re zhing mar la sogs pa'i rdzas las brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o/ /lhag par gnas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o/ /31—1179

de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la ①mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod de/ sgeg mo la sogs pa'i mchod ②pa brgyad dang / me tog la sogs pas kyang yang dag par mchod la phyag byas nas mchod yon phul la/slob ma lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de la re zhig dang por legs par khrus byas la / gos gtsang ma bgos shing lag par me tog thogs pa'i slob mas/ slob dpon la phyag byas la kye'adi skad ces brjod du gzhug go/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen pos tshul brtan ④pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang stsal du gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang stsal du gsol/ /thar pa chen pos zhegrong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par bgyidu / /de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i snying gar hūṃ las rdo rje bskyed la/ khya tshur g.yas pas rdo rje bzung ste/ snying po de'i snying gar gzhag ⑦ par bya'o/ /su ra ta sa ma ya ste ho sernyi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes bya ba brjod nas de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa byed du gzhug par bya ste/ rtog pa ma lus legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang po snyeldan pas gson/ /brjod ⑨ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa'i/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob⑪/ /dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang / /rtag tu 31—1180

bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo / /thugs rjes ①khyab pa'i thugs khyedang ldan gyur cing / /blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom/ /ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang bzhugs pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ /dman pa'i 'jigs pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal—/ /srid pa'i 'byor pa zil gyis ①gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing / /blo gros rnam rgyal ④thugs rje cher ldan pa'i/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /srid dang bral ba rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs/ /mnyam med byang chub rnam gsum gzung bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am/ /yang na yongs su bskyab par bya phyir ram/ /rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir—/ /'di dag thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du btang ⑤/ /de bzhin tshul khyems bzod dang brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni//bdag dang gzhan rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom par bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sngags la mkhas pa yi/ /chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad 'phags gnas la bdag ni gnas par bgyi/ /zhes bya ba lan gsum brjod do/ /bdag ni snede skad ces brjod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag gis log pa'i bsam pa ④thams cad yongs su gtang ④bar babyu'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la snyoms ⑨pa'i sems bskyed par bgyi'o⑫ / /bdag 31—1181

gis sems can thams cad theg pa thams cad dang / thabs kyi bye brag thams cad kyis btul nas/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings la rab tu gzhag par barmi'o/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur kyang / sems can 'ga' yang yongs su 3snamya ngan las 'das pa med do zhes sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis chos thams cad skye ba mod pa nyid du rjes su rtogs par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis ma yengs pa'i sems dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sems kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug la babe+eb par bkyi'o/ /bdag gis theg pa gcig gi tshul du gnas par yang rtogs par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la gnas pa'i so sor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir bslab par bgye'o/ /bdag ni 2stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi ༄ 7dang / so so 4yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so sor rtogs par bya ba'i phyir mngon par brtson par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du bdag gis phyasangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa ma lus pa'i bar la mngon par gnas par bya ba'i phyir mngon par bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /'di nyid ni 9byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 3byang chub chen por sems bskyed pa rdo rje lta bu yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yab dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' bzhin byed pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras kyi thu bo ste/ 'di nyid ni bcom ldan 'das dpal kun du bzang po'o/ /de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyis ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag par rdzogs par byas 9pa'i stobs kyis bdag sems bskyed pa 'di la gnas pas kun du bzang po'i spyod pa zhes bya ba sgo tsomatha' yas pa la 31—1 182

gnas pa mtha' med par gyur pa rdzogs par byas nas gdul bya'i 'gro ba'i tshogs ma lus pa rnams la spyod pa'i rab tu dbye ba'i sgo mang po bstan pas yang dag par mgu bar bya ba dang / yang dag par dga' bar bya ba dang / yang dag par gzengs bstod pa la nges par sbyar bar tsho bgyi'o/ /sdom pa don du gnyer ba la bslab pa'i gzhi lnga 'dzin du gzhug go/ /de nas slob ma'i lag tu rdo rje dris dri/ me tog gis me tog sbyin zhing bdug pas kyang slob ma yang dag nga/ra bdugs la/ mar me mas mar mes snang bar bya'o/ /de nas u dum bā 3 ra'am a shwaṅga'i so shing spos dang / me tog la sogs pa dang ldan pa la khro bo rdo rje bzhad pa bzlas pa dang / ku sha sar pa ma nyams pa 1 la khro bo rdo rje rnon po bzlas la de la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas khro bo rdo rje srung ④ ba bzlas pa'i srung skud mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa/ de'i dpung pa g.yon par bdag nyid kyis bcing bar bya zhing / rdo rje sems dpa'i gtsug tor gyis yang dag par bsrung ba dang / byams pa'i go cha bskon la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ bzhin bzangs longs la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byos shig / nang nga/ra 5dkyil 'khor chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas nyi ma 'char ka'i dus su lha thams cad de bzhin du bar snang la bzhag ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas spos chus byugs la me tog la sogs pas kyang mdzes par byas nas/ tshon sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / dkar po dri zhim pos bsgos 6 pas srad bu so sor kha bsgyur 7la go rims 'di nyid kyis bzhag nas hūṃ hūṃ n+d+raḥbyera.a ā zhes bya ba ༄9rang 31—1183

gi sa bon 'di las byung ba'i thig gi 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa la sogs pa rang rang gi phyogs na bzhugs par yang dag par btang ba dang / 'bar ba'i lcags kyus drangs te rang gi lag na gnas pa'i srad bu legs par dgang bar bya zhing / oṃ a byo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāḥspa hu ra sga ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmāḥ.a t+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā hūṃ zhes zlos shing bsgril bar bya'o/ /de nas srad bu de tsan+dan bzang po la sogs pas byugs pa'i gser gyi snod la sogs par bzhag la / me tog gis mchod de rdo rje bsdams pas bzung la thig gdab pa'i sngags/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad la sogs pa bdag po rnams kyi sngags kyang brgya rtsa brgyad bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod la phyag byas nas langs te yid kyis rnam par snang mdzad du gyur nas/ phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i grogs mchog hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis khro bo'i rdo rje las kyi gzugs su dbyung 1bar bya'o/ /yang de nyid rdo rje hūṃ mdzad du gyur pa la mig g.yas ④dang g.yon gnyis su yi ge dza las zla ba dang nyi ma ser po snang ba bskyed la/ dza zhes bya bas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gi lag du srad bu de btang la/ srad bu dang po g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis thubazung la phyis ni ci bder bya zhing phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsam mo/ /phyogs kun mnyam pa nyid dmigs la/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab ste/ /shar dang nub dang byang dang lhor/ /thig bzhi btab pas dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /oṃ badz+ra sru tra mā ti kra ma hūṃ zhes bya ba 'di dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sems can gyi don gyi phyir 'dir gshegs su gsol zhes bskul bar bya'o/ /grwa 31—1184

bzhir bya zhing sgo bzhir gdod/ /rta babs bzhis ①kyang rab tu brgyan/ /srad bu bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ /dar dang phreng bas shin tu brgyan/ /zla ba phyed par rab gnas pa'i/ /khyams kyis yongs su bskor ba dang / /dra ba dra phyed dag gis spras/ /sgo rnams dang ni rgyan cha can/ /rlung gis bskyod thupa sna tshogs mchog /ba dan dril bu sgra sgogs pa/ /khyams ni med par gyur pa'i sgo/ /me tog chun 'phyang rgyan ⑤gyis bskor/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi grwa ④rnams dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen brgyan par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim 3srad bu bye/ /shes rab can gyis ⑥de nang du/ /rdo rje rin chen gyes brgyan te/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /ka ba brgyad dang rta babs bcas—/ /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis brgyan pa ste/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor srad bu bye/ /srad bu byes pa ⑦tshon gyes dgang 3/ /lhag ma ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor yin par blta'o/ /gal te bgegs zlog khyapar byed 'dod par gyur na ⑪seng sdeng gi phur bu stod rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa la/ smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa lta bu la snga ma bzhin du rdo rje phur bu'i sngags bzlas te dkyil 'khor gyi kyelte bar rdo rjes brdung bar ⑫bya'o//yang dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba'i dbus su sngar kyebastan pa'i phur bu dang 'dra ba'i phur bu gzhan dag la phur bu'i sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas go rims 'di bzhin du bgegs thams cad la phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /ji skad du bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte ba la btags pa'i srad bus bskor phyogs su/phyi'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa'i yang phyi rol du/ de bzhin du 'khor yug chen por skyazlum bor thig legs par gdab 31—1185

par bya'o/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor der grog mkhar kyi sa la sogs pas bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan byas nas brgya byin gyi gzugs brnyan rang gi phyogs na gnas pa la i las brgya byin ser pothu/ me la sogs pa'i gzugs brnyan la'ang de bzhin te/ ram̐ las me lha dmar po'obye/ /oṃ haṃ las gshin rje nag po'o / /kre las srin po nag po/ bam las chu lha dkar po/ yang las rlung lha dud ka /phaṭa las lus ngan po ser po/ sum+bha las dbang ldan dkar po bskyed la 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bkug ste/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du byas nas phur bus gdab bo/ /shin tu yun ring du bgegs med par byed phye'adod nas sa dgab par bya'o/ /de ltar na yang gal te bgegs byed na rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi spyor ba byas la 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bkug nas rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas kyang dgug pa la sogs pa byas la/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ rkang pa g.yon pas bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan mnan te/ hūṃ baṃ hūṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pa spel ba'i tshul kyis zlos shing 'ugayon brkyang ba'i gnas pas gnas na/de lta bus bgegs bcom par 'gyur ro/ /yang na stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin sngon 7du bya ba'i rjes thogs la/ a las rnam par snang mdzad du gyur nas / rgyud las gsungs pa'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur nges par bsams la / rang gi snying ga nas haṃ las 'phags pa mi g.yo ba yid kyis phyung ste/badz+ra haṃ ban+dha zhes yid la zlos shing / phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du rlung gi mtshams su dris thig le bdun byas te/ thig le re re zhing yang nang du chud par byas la/ dbus ma dang thig le bdun dang ldan par bya'o/ /thig le bdun po 31—1186

de dag kyang rlung lha bdun po mdog nag po ri dwags la zhon par bsams la/'phags pa mi g.yo bas bkug nas zhags pas bcings par gyur par bsam mo/ /de rnams kyi dbus tūm gcig ni gtso bo yin la/ lhag ma rlung lha 2 drug ni de'i 'khor du kun nas gnas pa yin no/ /de nas kham phor a las ri rab tu bsams la/ de'i steng du a nyid las dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du rdo rjes g.yogs la / dbus su yi ge hūṃ gi sa bon las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa mtshams rnams su mdung rtse rnam par bsams la/ de bzhin du badz+ra haṃ ban+dha zhes zlos shing kham phor des ji skad bshad pa'i yi ge yo bdun po dgab par bya'o//de nas kham phor dang ri rab kyi steng du yi ge oṃ las sngar bshad pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad bsams la/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba yang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas ri rab bzung nas ral gre dang zhags pas rlung lha rnams la bsdigs pa mdzad par bsam sngupar bya ste/ de lta bus ni rlung lha 5 thams cad bcing bar 6byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas chu la sogs pa'i bgegs bzlog pa 3bshad par bya ste/ yi ge hūṃ 8las 'phags pa mi g.yo ba rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas par bdag nyid bskyed la/ grog mkhar kyi sa'am/ ba'i ( lco ba sa la ma lhung ba las bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan byas nas/ yi ge khaṃ 7las ral gri dang / ram̐ skye las nang na me yod par bskyed cing / k+ṣ-i /—las zhags pa dang / lcags kyu bskyed de/ de lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ lag pa g.yas pas ral gri dang / zhags pas drangs nas bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan gyi nang du bcug ste/ g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas gnas la/ rkang pa g.yon pas spyi bo nas btsir nas/ na maḥs man+ta badzā skrurde 31—1 /87

tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na sgo ①ṭa ya hūṃ ṭa 1ga haṃ oṃ zhes zlos rngushing gzugs brnyan de ral gris gtub par bya ba'am/ dug dang ske tshe dang lan tshwa ④la sogs pas gzugs brnyan la bskus la me yis gdung bar bya'o/ /me yis gdungs pas de nyid kyang / /zhi bar 'gyur bar ⑤the tshom med/ /tshangs pa'am brgya byin yin na yang / /de'i mod la myur du tshig⑥ /ces bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs so/ /las 'di yang 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ⑦gsang sngags 'di khri bzlas pa'i sngon 3du bsnyen pa byas nas de'i 'og tu las brtsam par bya'o/ /yang na oṃ snyahūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa ⑨zhabs drug pa/phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang dgra sta bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang gtun shing bsnams pa/ lho phyogs su khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis nam mkha'i gtos kun du gang bar mdzad pa ⑫bsams la/ mdung thung gi phyag rgya bcings te/ sprin la sogs pa bzlog pa'i bsam pas tsham rngam ⑫dang bcas pas rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa ⑫nang du bcings la/ mdzub mo gnyis nang sbyar ba ni mdung thung gi phyag rgya'o/ /de ltar na yang gal te bgegs rnams zhi bar ma gyur ⑫na/ kham phor so ma btang ba gnyis kyi nang du khrag dang dur khrod kyi sol ba dang / dug dang / ske tshe dang / da du ra'i lo ma'i khu bas gsang sngags bris la/ yungs kar la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ kham phor kha sbyar te de'i nang du bzhag la/ mi'i bgegs la sogs pa bsams te/ sreg blugs brgya'am sreg drugs bdun sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas de dag 'jigs pa'am/ 'chi ba'am/ mi ma yin pas gzung bar 31—1188

'gyur ro/ /yang na rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sbyor bas yi ge hūṃ bzlas brjod 'bum byas la/ mi rus kyi rgyu ① las byas pa'i phur bu sor bzhi pa'i tshad tsam la lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas de bzhin du rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas dgug pa dang /gzhug pa dang / bcing ba byas nas gzugs brnyan phur bus gdab par bya'o/ /de nas me'i tsha ba zhi ba bshad par bya ste/ me'i steng du yi ge baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor / de'i steng du pad+ma'i dbus na gnas pa'i 'khor lo de'i steng du yi ge baṃ de nyid ④las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dung dang kun da ltar dkar ba steng na bzhugs te/ mtsho chen po ma dros pa 'dra ba'i rgya mtsho chen po bzhi las chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab pa lta bu'i char gyi rgyun sar pas phyogs bcur 'gengs par 'gyur bar bsam par bya'o rdo rje spyan can 3dang rdo rje me ltar 'bar bas ④kyang kham phor byi ri rab dang phur bus yang dag par bsrungs la rdo rje gnod sbyin dang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi spyan dag gis de rnams kyi nam mkha' bcing bar byas la rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje dral bar 1bya'o/ /yang na mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg gis ⑥bgegs rnams bzlog par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gye dbus na gnas pa'i phur bu hūṃ bzhis bton la/ rang gi lag na gnas pa'i rdo rje 3bcug ste 'og nas bshad pa'i tshon sna dulngas phur bu'i bu ga bkang la mnyam por byas nas thig skud tshon dkar po dri zhim par byesbangs pa gdab par bya'o / /de ltar thig legs par btab nas hi zhes bya ba las mig g.yas pa dang g.yon par nyi ma dang zla ba bskyed la khro bo'i lta bas kun du bltas la sgo rnams dbye'o/ /de nas tshon rtsi byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye 'ihūṃ/31—1189

zhes bya ba 'dis 1phyag rgya dang ldan pas tshon rtsi thams cad la 2lan bdun bzlas na rdo rje'i dbang ༄ —bzhin du 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /phyag rgya ni 'di yin ④ tebye/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnyis las ni/ /mdzub mo'i rtse mo mnyam sbyar ba/ /byas nas tshon rtsi thams cad ni/ /'bar ba'i lta bas dgug par bya'o/ /hi zhes bya ba dang rdo rje nyi ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya mthar spar bar bya'o/ /de la 'bar ba'i lta ba ni 'di yin te/ /rab tu 'bar ba 6mig bsgul zhing / /mig gi spru ma 'gugs byed pa/ /lta ba gzi can yin par bshad/ /'gro ba thams cad 'gugs byed pa'o/ /dībye dṛṣ+ṭa e ku sha dzaḥzhes bya ba 'di yang mig tu dgod do/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ zhes zlos shing g.yon pa'i rdo rje 7khu tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi phyogs nas brtsams te g.yas nas bskor bas tshon rtsi dgye bar bya ste/ phyis ci bde bar bya'o/ /de la rim pa ni 'di yin te/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /ljang gu dang / dkar po'o/ /de yang / sngon po rdo rje rtse rang bzhin1// /gnyis pa gser la dmigs pa ste/ /pad+ma rā ga'i rang bzhin gzhan/ /de bzhin gzhan dag margad tshi'adra/ /dkar po nang du shes bya ste/ /'di ni tshon gyi rim par bshad/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /shar phyogs su ni sngon po ste/ /lhor ni ser po dang ldan pa/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /byang ni ma1ljang gu yang dag ldan/ /dbus kyi sa yi cha nyid ni/ /shel ltar snang ba bla na med/ /rtag tu rdo rje dril 'chang zhing / /rab mnyam gzhag pas bri bar bya'o/ /yang na snga ma bzhin du 7rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas las byas nas/ gser ram dngul las byas pa 'am sa yang rung ste 37—1 /90

legs bris pa'i/ /pha gu gru bzhir byas pa la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni gzhag par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa rmyel asni pra dīp+ta ā kaste ya sarba 3thā ga ta ma hā badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ/ sangs rgyas spyan sngar rdo rje ni/ /'bar bas bskor ba gzhag par bya / /de bzhin rin chen 'od bskor ba/ /pad+mo rdo rje kun de bzhin/ /snying po ni 'dis bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa badz+re dz+wa la mā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na badz+re dz+wa la mā la hūṃ ṭ+wā 7/ oṃ dharma badz+re dz+wa la mā la hūṃ byāthuḥ/ oṃ karma badz+re dz+wa la mā la hūṃ āḥrdo rje shugs kyis rubargal nas ni/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar de bzhin du/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin bri ba/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la rdo rje shugs kyi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūṃ/ de nas 'di yi phyag rgya bshad / /yid kyis sneri mo bteg 3nas ni/ /rdo rje srad bu'am gzhan yang rung / /phyir byung nang du zhugs kyang ni/ /dam tshig 'gal bar de mi 'gyur / /de yi dbus su sems dpa' che/ /phyag na rdo rje bri ba ni/ /ut+pal che sngo mtsher byeba'i mdog /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad bsnyus pa ni/ /khro dang bcas pas 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /g.yon brkyang tshul du gnas pa ste/ /'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /g.yon pa'i zhabs kyi mthil kyis ni/ /dbang phyug chen po mnan par bya/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs kyis 9༄u ma yi/ /nu ma'i steng du gnon pa bri/ /'di tshi yi snying po 'di yin no/ /hūṃ oṃ ni sum+bha badz+ra bibyet+ta ma hūṃ phaṭaḥ1 ces bya ba dang / oṃ badz+ra shu la zhes bya ba'i snying po gnyis ni lha chen po'i'o lo/ /oṃ kro dha badz+ra asni dzā la ya tri shu lo dhan+da badz+ra dṛ da yo badz+re ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni u ma'i'o/ /de yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje khro bo gzhag pa ni/ /khros pa mche 7ba 'byung ba ste/ /'bar ba'i 4phreng bas 31—1191

'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /de nas de dag gi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra karma kro dha rā gā ⑫ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tuṣ+ṭi hūṃkro dha sā dhu sā dhu hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa gnyis par yang / /der ni rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ /rdo rje khro bos bskor ba bri/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /ṭ+wā bye.oṃ badz+ra bi shur+bhe kro dha ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra srur+ya ma hā dz+wa la ma 1la kro dha dz+wa la ya sarban ⑥hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ke tu de hi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra āḥ sa ta 3kro dha ha ha ha ha hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa gsum pa yang / /rdo rje'i sde ni bri bar bya/ /khro bo bdag nyid chen pos bskor/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po bshad do/ /trīḥ.oṃ badz+ra dharma kro dha bi nā sha ya bi sho dha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā ༄ byekro dha hrīn+da khyun+da rtsu phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ke tu kro dha pra be+e sha khyaya maṇ+ḍa le sarban hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bhā ṣa ba da ba da hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhi par yang / /rdo rje dbab pa bri ba ni/ /rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po bshad do/ /aḥ⑫oṃ badz+ra karma hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ka pa tsa kro dha rak+ṣa 4hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā da khā da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha muṣ+ṭi sā tedha ya sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor gyi ni grwa rnams su/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi tshul ba zhin du/ /ji ltar go rims thubazhin du ni/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa kun bri'o/ /de nas de rnams kyi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra lā gya ⑫/rā ga ye sahūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mā le a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gī te ga ta hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ badz+ra dṛ thuh+ye ba shaṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ rdo rje shugs kyis brgal nas ni/ /31—1192

dkyil 'khor dam pa'i phyi rol du/ /de yi grwa rnams nyid du ni/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi rnams bzhag /de nas de rnams kyi snying po ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ①pū dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ puste pū dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa—/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gabye kyepū dza spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo rnams kun gyi dbus su ni/ /lcags kyu la sogs gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rol gnas rnams su/ /phyi'i rdo rje'i rigs rnams so/ /de nas de dag gi snying po bshad de/1/ oṃ badz+ra i ku sha ma hā kro dha ā kar+ṣa ya sarba sa ma ya na hūṃ dzaḥ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pra be ④sha ya sarba sa ma ya na hūṃ hūṃ oṃ badz+ra sgo ṭa ma hā kro dha ban+dha brnya sarba sa ma ya na hūṃ sbyo/baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be+e sha ya ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya sarba sa ma ya na hūṃ hoḥ/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyams la / shar phyogs su byams pa dang / mthong ba don yod dang / ngan song thams cad sbyong ba dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams par 'u bri'o/ /lho phyogs su spos kyi glang po dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' mdzod dang / ye shes tog rin po che bsnams par bri'o/ /nub phyogs su 'od dpag tu med pa dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / bzang skyong dang / dra ba can gyi 'od pad+ma bsnams par bri'othu/ /byang gi char rdo rje snying po dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa dang / kun du bzang po sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams par bri'o / /yang na 'khor ba 'jig dang / gser thub dang / 'od srungs dang / shākya thub pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi po ma gtogs pa/ byams pa la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhis stong /༄du ma tshang bar /༷ shar 31—1193

phyogs nas brtsams te khyams la'ormye/ /oṃ sarba saṃ s+thā ⑤ra pa ri shudhe dharma te ma hā na ya pa ri bā re swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i rig pa 'dis ④ rdo rje dbyengs kyi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /yang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyams la shar khya phyogs su sgyu ma'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu/ thub pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje mtshon cha chung ma dang bcas pa/ lhor bdud rtsi 'khyel pa/ rdo rje 'od/ rdo rje dbyig pa/rdo rje gser smug chung ma dang bcas pa'o/ /nub tu rdo rje glang po sna/ rdo rje phreng ba/ rdo rje dbang / rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje gtun shing / rdo rje rlung / rdo rje me/ rdo rje 'jigs pa chung ma dang bcas par ro/ /byang phyogs su ni rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje dus/ rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso bo/ rdo rje chu klung 4chung ma dang bcas pa ghu bri bar bya'o/ /khyab 'jug la sogs pa 'di dag thams cad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams kyi shā sku'i phyed kyi tshad tsam du thams cad ༄ 1khyams la brten par bya'o zhes rdo rje rtse mo las gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas rdo rje gser la sogs pa 'di rnams kyi snying po dang rig pa rnams bshad do/ /oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra te me tshin+dha tsakre na badz+re ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa 1 ke hūṃ/ oṃ badzi ni kau ma rī shī rgyu / ā be sha ya garnya shasde nyuzin/badz+ra pā ṇi r+pā thuye badz+ra sa ma ye s+dzam nu sma ra ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dan+ta tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ/7oṃ badz+ra shādhi dza pa dza pa ak+ṣa ma la ya sarba na mā ra ya shān+ta tiṣ+ṭha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a yu dha 8hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi ha na ha na badz+re ṇa byen+da bhen+da pi ḍa ya sarba dubye z-i da ya ni oṃ sum+bha hūṃ phaṭa 3/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa li ta dīp+ta badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ a mṛ te sarba duspyo kṛt+na badhe na ha —/na pa tsa bi dh+wad+ma ya bi nā sha ya tshin+da bhen+da bhasmi ku ru murta na ha da ya/ badz+re ṇa ye ke tsita ri— ma ma ā mu ka mya 31—/ 194

bisna ①bi nā ya ka ste da ma ya dīp+ta kro dha badz+re ⑤ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra so mya hūṃ/༄ oṃ badz+ra karnyi mā ④ra ya so mya byu pe pra dīp+ta khya rā ge na shī rgyu sgo ṭa ya z-i da yo/ badz+ra dha ra sabye na ma hā basbyod ⑥na ka ra le shi ta rabye rngo)badz+re ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa ⑨aghi gha ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi kṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra me kha le kha ṇi kha rku shasde na bi sha ku ru ⑩triṣ+ṭa mā ra ya bi 11sha ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma de hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi la ye hūṃ/ tshin+da a se na bhin+da badz+re ṇa mā ra ya u༅ (sted ya bi ba pi 43ba hūṃ phaṭa/ o badz+ra mā tusteya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā tshozhesha na ni bhak+ṣa ya sarba duṭ+wān ⑩badz+ra da sha ni shat+ta da ra ṇi ma nu ṣa rmā sa ā ha re nanyu / na ra ru dhi ra 1steb sa pri ya nyushemadz+dza sa mu le ba ṇa bi lip+ta ga te a na ya sarba dha na dha n+ya hi 1ra rgya su baṇ+ḍa a tri ṇi saṃ tra du rtem ya ba ra te bak+ṣi 2)ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma dha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ba shi ni tshu a na ya bhasmi bye5ku ru sarba pu ru ṣa dha si ku ru bye dha ma pra sā ༄ 5da ya bya ba ༷ )ha ra bh+yo/ bhū ta ba snye5ra bi dza yo ka ri badz+ra pa ti ka ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma ༄— si hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ba se ni a na ya sarba bste/ aṇ+ḍa ༄ ba na di tru pa ka ra rja ṇi shī rgyu ba shī kube+e dadz+re pra deyats+tsha a bi sha sa bye ka tha ya/badz+ra ṣ+peko sha dha ri ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mu sa la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dhu ti a na ya sarbe 5maṇ+ḍa lo pra be+e sha ya/ ā be+e sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ sarba karma steṇi me ku ru sa —shī rgyu shī rgyu/ la —snyegh+ra la gh+ra tā sa ya mā ra ya/ na rā be+e ṇa badz+ra kha ṭī ga dha ri ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ta hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi ga badz+re ni ghu gh+ra ghu glu shasde na mā 1ra ya/ bi ga ri bi nadh+wad+ma ya badz+ra pa ta dha ri ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ni hūṃ / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ya sabaṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ya da ha da ha bhasmi ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gra ha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bste pra bak+ta rdat+tha ka ra ya bhi ṣa ṇa na bste shī s+ho kṛṇ+ḍa ā be+e 37byed1 /95

sha gyeya/ bhak+ṣa ya ru bye ra ṇa pi ba ma hā yak+ṣa ṇi badz+ra pā sha dha 1ri ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/o badz+ra rdat+tha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu kha a na ya badz+ra rda bye ba ya ṇa rngu ke pā tā la ni ④ba si ni kha kha/ khā nyi khā hi/ sarba mu khe/ pra be sha ya/ sgo ṭa ya/ marma ⑤rji sarba duṭ+wān khyebadz+re ṇi sidha ④a dha ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma ra ṇa zuhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā li ma hā pre ta byu 6)pi ni ma nu ṣa/ rmā ⑫ sa ru dhi ra thra ye e bye hi kṛṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa bhak+ṣa kyeya badz+ra ḍā ki ni badz+ra shaṃ ka le sarba de ba ga ṇa ma tra byu te ⑫ ha ra ha ra krā rjan thu.a mu ka gya ka pā la a lo kṛ ⑫ta sarba kā ye kiñci kyer ya se/ badz+ra kha ṭī ga dha ri ṇi pre ta ma rku tutswaṣa/ sha rī re shī sgo/ ā be+e sha ya/tshorte pra be+e sha ya/brnya ya ba shi skyeku ru mā ra ya badz+ra rak+ṣa se spyohūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bispyo zhe hūṃ/oṃ badz+ra bhū ༄1ta ṣ+pe ma nu ṣa mād+ma ba sa ru bye ra mu tra pu ri byeṣ+ṭha ⑫ shi gha na/ ka re to gar+bha hā ri shā ya nyi shī rgyu i rda a mu ka 0mya ku ru badz+ra sho dha ni ka da ri ni sarba karma stseṇi me/ ku ru ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ha ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa⑫ / oṃ badz+ra ma ka re gra sa shī rgyu/ pra be+e sha ya/ pā tā ⑪lo bhak+ṣa ya badz+ra ma ka ra dha ra 3ni hūṃ phaṭa/me'i mtshams nas brtsams te/ bskor 3phyogs su bhi ma dang / dpal mo dang /dbang ldan ma dang / dka' thub bzlog 3 ma yang 'dis bri bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ga krumi ni sarba bhak+ṣe sā dha ya gu khya badz+ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad zla ba'i mdog can zhal bzhi pa/ rdo rje spril nyamo krung dang /phyag gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad sngon po ji skad bshad pa'i phyag rgyas rdo rje dang ⑫dril bu bsnams pa/ khro bo rdo rje sems dpa' yang sku mdog sngon po/ rgyal po gser gyi mdog can/chags pa dmar po/ legs pa margad (rte kyi mdog can/ rin chen hūṃ mdzad 31—1196

dang / rdo rje ①rin chen gser gyi mdog can/ nyi ma mdog dmar po/rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i mdog can bzhad ②pa dkar ser/ chos kyi hūṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje chos kyang sku mdog dkar dmar/ non po nam mkha'i mdog can / rgyu gser gyi mdog can/ smra ba zangs kyi mdog can/ las kyi hūṃ mdzad dang / khro bo rdo rje ①las sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ srung ba gser gyi mdog can gnod sbyin nag pope/ khu tshur ser po⑪ / khro bo sgeg mo sngon mo/khro mo khu tshur gnyis kyis pya rdo rje gnyis bsnams te/ rdo rje bsnyems pa'i tshul gyes chung kluzad 'dud pa/ cha lang brdung ba la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis bskor ba / phreng ba ma ser mo khu tshur gnyis kyis rdo rje phreng ba 'dzin pa/ man ta li ka brdung ba'i lha mo bzhis bskor ba/ glu ma mdog dmar gyi ldupi wang len pa la brtson pas gnas pa'i lha mo bzhis bskor ba/ gar ma sna tshogs pa'i mdog can / phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa bsnams te gar byed pa la brtson pa/myu kun da thogs pa gnas pa'i lha mo bzhis bskor te gnas pa'o/ /bdug pa ma mdog sngo ba g.yon pa'i khro bo khya tshur sdigs mdzub bgreng ba/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis spos khang bsnams pa/ ru dung 'bud pa la brtson pa'i lha mo bzhis bskor ba/ me tog ma ser ba/ phyag g.yon pa me tog gi snod thogs nas/g.yas kyis kye me tog gi char 'be+ebs pa/ pa ṭa ha thogs pa'i lha mo bzhis bskor te bzhugs 0pa/ mar me ma mdog dkar dmar/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur sdogs mdzub/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis mar me'i sdong bu bsnams pa/ti mi la bdug pa hūṃ la brtson pa'i lha mo bzhis bskor ba/ byug pa ma sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ phyag g.yon pas dris gang ba'i dung chos bsnams pa/31—1197

g.yas pas snadri 'thor ba dha ka 2brdung ba la brtson pa'i lha mo ④bzhis bskor ba/lcags kyu sngon po zhags pa ser po/ lcags sgog dkar dmar/ dril bu sna tshogs pa'i mdog can/ bskal pa bzang po'i mthar thug pa 'di dag thams cad kyang gang la khyad par gyi bdag ④med pa der ni g.yon brkyang ba'i gnas pas bzhugs pa/ thugs kar khro bo'i sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba la brtson pa/g.yas pa rdo rje khu tshur gyis rang gi mtshan ma bsnams te tsham ngam gye tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gzhan yang drag po la sogs pa phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i phyerigs yang dag par bri bar bya'o/ /de la drag po ni mdog dkar po lag pa bzhi pa/g.yas kyi lag pa gcig gis u ma la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang bcas pas mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon pa gcig gis mdung rtse gsum pa/gnyis 6kha ṭī ga 'dzin pa khyu mchog la zhon pa/ sbrul gyi mchod phyir thogs pa yod nga / rin po che'i cod pan zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mgrin pa sngo bar bri bar bya ste/ pa shu pa ti m+bi la kaṇ+ḍa u ma bri ya thuzhes smos pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab 'jug mdog nag po lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis na dbyig pa dang rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon gnyis na dung dang 'khor lo thogs pa/ nam mkha' lding la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje ser mo 5 ni gser gyi mdog can/ lag pa na mtshon cha dang / stan khyab 'jug dang 'dra'o/ /rdo rje dril bu ni mdog dmar po gdong drug pa/ lag pa g.yas gnyis na 17mdung thung dang rdo rje thogs pa/g.yon gnyis na khyim bya dang dril bu thogs pa/ rma bya la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje gzhon nu ma/ ni rdo rje dril bu dkrol bar shes par bya'o/ /thub pa'i rdo rje ni gser gyi mdog can/ gdong bzhi pa lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na rdo rje 37—/ 198

dang bgrang phreng thogs pa/ g.yon gnyis na ①dbyug pa dang spyi blugs rnguthogs pa / ngang pa la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje zhi ba ma zhuni tshangs pa dang 'dra bar shes par gebya'o/ /rdo rje mtshon cha ni mdog ser ba lag pa g.yon na rang gi rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yas na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rdo rje thogs pa/ glang po che dkar po la zhon pa/ rdo rje khya tshur ni rdo rje mtshon cha dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o—/ /khro bo rdo rje 'khyil pa ni mdog dmar po/ lag pa g.yas kyis phyepad+ma dang bcas pa'i rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na pad+ma dang bcas pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ rtas drangs pa'i shing rta la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje mi 'chi ba ni khro bo rdo rje 'khyil pa dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /khro bo rdo rje 'od ni mdog dkar po/lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon ⑥pad+ma dang bcas pa'i zla ba thogs pa/ngang pa la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje mdangs ni khro bo rdo rje 'od dang 'dra ba'o/ /khro bo rdo rje dbyig pa ni mdog sngon po/ g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na dbyig pa thogs pa/3 rus sbal la zhon pa'o/ /dbyug mchog ma ni khro bo rdo rje dbyug pa dang 'dra'o/ /khro bo rdo rje ser smug ni/ mdog dmar po lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na mi mgo thogs nas za zhing gnas pa/ rdo rje rked 'chings ma ni khro bo rdo rje sheser smug dang 'dra'o/ /rdo rje glang po'i sna ni tshogs kyi bdag po ste/ mdog dkar po lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa g.yon na 9gshol thogs te gnas pa glang po che la zhon pa/tre/ rdo rje 'ju ma ni glang sna dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni 'di yod de/ 'di ltar lag pa g.yon na kha ṭī ga thogs pa'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po khro bo rdo rje phreng ba ni mdog ljang gu/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon —1 me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ khu byug 31—1199

la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje za ba mo ni rdo rje phreng ba dang 'dra ba las/ de las khyad par ni 'di yod do/ /'di ltar ①lag pa g.yon na ②mdung rtse yod pa'o/ /rdo rje dbang ni mdog ser po lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa①/ g.yon na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa phag la zhon pa'o/ / rdo rje ④rta mgo ma ni rdo rje dbang dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni 'di yod de 'di ltar kha dog dmar ba yin no/ /tshogs kyi bdag po ni 3rnam par rgyal ba ni mdog dmar pya po/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na ⑦ral gri thogs pa tsan dudu ka la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje dga' mo ni rnam par rgyal ba dang 'dra'o/ /pho nya rdo rje jo ba ni mdog ser po lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na gtun thogs pal/ me tog can gyi dri la zhon pa'o/ /rdo rje pho nya mo ni rdo rje tho ba dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni 'di yod dermye/ 'di ltar lag pa g.yon na kha ṭī ga thogs pa'o/ /pho nya mo 1rdo rje rlung ni mdog sngon po/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na ba dan thogs pa ri dwags la zhon pa'o/ /pho nya rdo rje ma ni mdog dmar po lag pa g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang spe2dgang gzar thogs pa/ g.yon gnyis na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs thogs pa/ 'od zer gyen du 'bar ba 'bar ba'i rtse ⑫gsum pa/ra skyes la zhon pa7/ rdo rje 'bar ba mo brani pho nya rdo rje 'bar ba dang 'dra'o/ /mgyogs ma tsordo rje ma ni pho nya rdo rje rlung dang 'dra'o/ /pho nya rdo rje 'jigs pa ni mdog sngon po/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje g.yon na dbyig pa thogs pa mi ro la zhon pa'o/ /pho nya mo rdo rje 'khyor ma ni rdo rje 'jigs pa dang 'dra ba las/khyad par ni lag pa g.yon na zhags pa thogs pa'o/ /bran mo rdo rje lcags kyu ni/mdog sngon po/ lag pa g.yas pa —5rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na /— lcags kyu 37—1200

thogs pa klu'i rgyal po she sha la zhon pa'o/ /bran mo rdo rje kha ni mdog sngon mo/phag gi mgo can lag pa g.yas na rdo rje/ g.yon na ral gri thogs pa mi la zhon pa'o / /bran mo rdo rje dus ni mdog nag po lag pa g.yas na rdo rje/ g.yon na gshin rje'i dbyug pa thogs pa/ ma he la zhon pa'o/ /bran mo rdo rje dus ma rmyeni mdog nag mo/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje g.yon na kha ṭī ga thogs pa ro langs la zhon pa'o/ /bran rdo rje pyabagegs kyi gtso bo ni mdog dkar po glang po'i mdog grucan/ lag pa g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang dgra sta thogs pa/ g.yon gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa thudang so thogs pa/ lug thug la zhon pa'o/ /pho nya mo rdul ma ni mdog sngon mo/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na sen ma dza ka phye ni ka thogs pa/ byi ba la zhon pa'o/ /bran rdo rje glu ma d+ngha ni mdog dkar po lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na rdo rje spuzhags pa thogs pa/ gdengs ka brgyad yod pa/ chu srin la zhon pa'o/ /bran mo chu srin ma ni mdog dkar po3/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje jogs pa// g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i chu srin thogs pa/ chu srin la zhon pa'o/ /'jigs ma mdog paljang gu lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa/ g.yon na /tsoral gri dang phub thogs pa'o/ /dpal mo mdog ser mo lag pa g.yas na rdo rje/ g.yon na pad+ma thogs pa'o/ /dbyangs can ma mdog dmar mo/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje/g.yon na pi wang thogs pa'o/ /dka' thub bzlog pa mdog ljang gu/ lag pa g.yas gnyis na rdo rje dang 'khor lo thogs pa/ g.yon gnyis na pa ti sa dang ral gri thogs pa ༄ rtam mo thams cad dang / drag po la sogs pa nas chu lha'i mthar thug pa rnams kyi lag pa g.yas na rdo rje thogs pa gang yin pa de rtse gsum 3 7—1201

pa yin pa tūshes par bya'o/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams ni bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la mngon sum bye du phyogs par bri'o / /de nas dgongs ka'i dus la babs ldupa na/ rdo rje ti rīrnyi ri'i 4phyag rgyas me tog gi phreng ba blangs la/ yi ge hūṃ bzhi zlos shing dkyil 'khor du 'jug par byas la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi lhag pa dang / ma tshang ba nye bar zhi sreba'i phyir bltas la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing rdo rje shugs kyis dkyil 'khor lan bdun bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la phreng ba 'di phul te/rdo rje'i gar byas la (nyublangs la yi ge hūṃ bzhis rang gi mgo la bcing bar 7bya'o/ /de yang / rdo rje dril bu rab bskul bas/ /mkhas pas ma tshang yongs su bskang du/ /lhag pa gang yin 'dor mdzad pa/ /'grub 'gyur smad par mi bya'o—/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de nas dbus su 'dug nas ni/ /rdo rje slob dpon mnyam gzhag pas/ /rdo rje sgo ni rnam bzhi po/ /yid kyis su ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ badz+red gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha hūṃ/ 'di'i phyag rgya ni/rdo rje mdzub mo yang dag par/ /sbyar la bkan te bsdams nas su/ /rab tu khros nas dbye ba ni/ /sgo 'byed pa yi mchog yin no/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas bya'o/ /de nas rin po che sna bdun nam/ sa las byas pa'i bum pa rtsa ba mi gnag pa/ gsus pa che ba/ mgrin pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba—/ chu bzang po dang / rin po che dang / sman dang / 'bru thams cad kyis yongs su dgang zhing / 'bras bu dang bcas shing lo ma dang bcas pa'i ldum bus kha brgyan pa/ mgrin pa ras dkar pos bcings nas srung thu ba byas la phyi rol kun du dri zhim pos byugs te/ steng du rdo rjes mtshan pa'i me tog gi 31—1202

phreng ba dang / rdo rje chen pos 1byin gyis brlab par bya zhing / khro bo ti rībye ris 3yongs su bzung ba'i rdo rje dang / rnge tog gi lcug zhe snam las/ oṃ badzod ka hūṃ/ zhes bya ba 'dis ④lan stong rtsa brgyad bzlas pa dang / hūṃ bzhi pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bzlas pa byas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi spyan sngar legs par gzhag go/ /bum pa gnyis pa la hūṃ bzhi lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ 'jug pa'i sgor mngon par phyogs par gzhag go/ /chu des bdag nyid dang slob ma dbang bskur bar bya ba'am/ 'jug pa'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /byi 'uru dang ni sa le sbram/ /dung dang mu tig nor bu dang 6/ /rin chen kun zhes bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par bya/ /seng ha byā sgru ki ri kaṇi 3/ ha sa sa ha de ba ste/ /sman rnams kun zhes bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par bya/ /'bras kyi so ba mon sran gre'u 3/ /nas dang gro dang tel dag ste/ /'bru rnams kun zhes bya ba la/ /lnga po 'di dag shes par bya/ /de/'i rjes la phyag bzhi la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ sdom pa gzung 6bar byas nas ras sngon po la rdo rje gnod sbyin yongs su bzlas te/ sems dpa'i gtsug tor kyi ⑫gtsug tor bcing ba dang / gdong g.yogs byas la/ rdo rje go chas stod g.yogs dang / gtsug tor la brtsegs pa bgos kyenas/ slob dpon khro bo ti rīrnyi rkyeris me tog gi 4phreng ba sngon po bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya pra be sha mi zhes zlos shing zhugs la/ bcom ldan 'das dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa ma rungs pa'i sems can dag kyang mchis te/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i chu 'thungs la bdag nyid la dbab par tsuzibyas nas/ me tog de 5dkyil 'khor 31—1203

chen por dor la rang gi mgo la bcings nas gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bzhin du bltas nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ①zhes bya ba la sogs pas 'jug pa'i phyag rgya dgrol bar byas la/ chu'i dbang bskur ba dang / sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang / dar dpyangs dang / rdo rje phreng ba dang / rdo rje'i bdag po dang / rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas ②yang bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas te/ bcom ldan 'das las chade blangs nas/ /de kho na nyid dang /chos dang dam tshig dang / rdo rje brtul zhugs kyang blangs nas me tog la sogs pa dang / sgeg mo la sogs pas bdag nyid yang dag par mchod de tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa ④lngas rjes su gnang 'ub dang / hūṃ bzhi pa dang gzengs bstod pa dang / lung bstan pa yang blangs la/ yang bdag la byin gyis brlab pa la sogs pa byas nas ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa bzhin du bzlas pa byas nas bdag gi bu hūṃ mdzad rdo rje'o zhes rang gi ming nas brjod pa byas la/rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag rgya chen po bcings te/ de'i sngags a zhes bya ba'i 3mtha' dang bcas pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i bdag nyid dbab par bya'o/ /badz+ra 3 haṃ zhes rdo rje'i nga rgyal du rnam par bsgoms spul/ rdo rje de badz+ra dha tu ra haṃ zhes bya bas rnam par snang mdzad du bsgom par bya'o/ /de bzhin du rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar gyi phyag rgya chen po bcings la/ byang phyogs kyi sgor/ de'i sngags a zhes bya ba'i mtha' dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bur bdag nyid dbab par byas la/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍi ho ṅkuzhes nga rgyal bskyed nas/ de badz+ra ā be+e sha kro dha haṃ zhes khro bo rdo rje 'be+ebs pa nyu1bsgom par bya ste/ de ltar na rdo rje bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje slob dpon 31—1204

sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bcings nas ni/ /se gol mang po brdab bkyis ① la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bgyi/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥthuhūṃ baṃ hoḥzhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje cha khro bo yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom ④byed cing / /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig rab tu brjod par bgyi'o/ /de nas rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas rang rang gi sgo nas dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang / dbang du byas la / hūṃ bzhi pas mchod yon phul la/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs nga/ bzlas thunas bskal pa bzang po'i mthar thug pa'i dubar du dam tshig gi phyag rgya bsgrub par bya ste/ rang gi sngags brjod la/ dṛ ⑦ sh+ya dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ste/ ā ha thuzhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi sngags dang snying po brjod par bya ste/ de ltar na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bye rnams bshad de/ rdo rje gnyis las byung ba ni/ /dam tshig mchog tu grags pa yin / /de dag bcing ba bshad bya ba/ /khro bo bcing ba bla na med/ /lag ngar rdo rjer byas nas su/ /mthe'u chung lcags kyur bcing bar bya/ /mdzub mo gnyis kyis bsdigs pa ni/ /'jig rten gsum las ⑫rgyal zhes bya/ /de bzhin mdzub mo ngos sbyar te/ /nor bu 'dra bar rab tu dgug /gung mo mnyam bgreng pad+mar bya/ /gung mo mdzub mo gnyis kas hubyebasdigs/ /mdzub mo gnyis ka rdo rjer bya/ /g.yas pa lcags kyu dgug par bya/ /de nyid shaṃ zhes bya bar 'dud/ /legs pa sbyin pa de bzhin te/ /mdzub gnyis dpral ba'i gnyer mar gzhag /snying gar mdzub mos nyi mar bskor/ /lag pa brkyang ste spyi bor gzhag /mdzub mo kha nas dgod ltar byas⑫/ /mdzub mo'i sen mo 31—1205

sbyar bar bya/ /g.yas pas ral gri bcings pa'o/ /gung mdzub mnyam bsgreng 'khor lo yi/ /kha yi nang nas dbyung ba dang / /mdzub mo gung mor hūṃrdo rjer bya / /mdzub mo yis ni mgul par bskor/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni mche ba che/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni thurdo rjer bcings/ /sgeg mo la sogs pa'i ni rdo rje dbyings la sogs pa nyid la hūṃ zhes bya bas tsardo rje bsdams pa de ji lta ba bzhin du bcings sozi/ /snying gar mthe bo bsnyams la gzhagakhye /rab tu brkyang ba phreng ba'o / /thal mo sbyar te kha nas byung / /gar las thal sbyar spyi bor gzhag /rdo rje bcings pa thur du blugs/ /rang gi thal sbyar gyen du gtor/ /mthe bong mnyam ste nyurab tu bsdams/ /rab tu brkyang ste kyebyug pa'o/ /mdzub mo gcig po dgug pa'o 5/ /mthe bo gnyis ni mdud pa dor/ /mthe bo mdzub mo gdu bur bcing / /rdo rje khu tshur mdzub mo bsdamasakye/ /thugs kar yi ge dh+ri las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rnam par bsams la/ yi ge hūṃ nyid zlos shing phyag rgya thams cad bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i nges pa bshad de/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang /rnam par snang mdzad dang / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / rin chen hūṃ mdzad dang /chos kyi hūṃ mdzad dang / las kyi hūṃ mdzad kyi gnas nyid do/ /de nas rin chen hūṃ mdzad la sogs pa'i sngags bshad de/ oṃ badz+ra bye ༄ rteku ṭi kro dha na ya sarba rat+na ma s+thāḥphaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dṛsbyi kro dha dri shu mā shā1ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi shwa kro dha ku ru sarba skabi shwa byu pa tra ya sa da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ 'di'i phyag rgya ni sems ma rdo rje ma nas brtsams te blta bar bya'o/ /de yang / rig pa dam pa thams cad kyi/ /'jig rten gsum las rgyal zhes bshad/ /ces bshad pa yin no/ /31—/206

rdo rje de dang hūṃ mdzad kyis k+ṇiphyag rgya'i tshogs bsdus pa ni/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje hūṃ mdzad yin par bshad kyi/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad gzhan du gyur pa ni mi rigs te/ rgyud thams cad las khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba nyid rdo rje hūṃ mdzad yin par bstan to/ /de'i rjes la de bzhin du lngags la rdo rje bkod de/go rims 2ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas dang rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi yi ge dgod par bya'o/ /de ni 'di yin te/ hūṃ ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'o/ /hūṃ nani rin chen sems ma'i 'o/ /jiḥthuni chos kyi sems ma'i 'o/ /a ni las kyi sems ma'i 'o/ /hūṃ badz+ra satwa badzi/ ṭ+wā thurat+na badz+re s+thāḥ/ dharmā badz+re/ a karma badzi hūṃ ste tram̐ tai/ hi hi de ha dhika4/ /dhi hūṃ/ gre kri/ baṃ dri aḥzhes bya ba ni rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i 'o/ /ma hā ra he 3hūṃ/ rū pa sho bhe hūṃ / sgo tra sau khye hūṃ/ sarba pū dze hūṃ/ pra h+la da ni hūṃ/ pha la ga byeme hūṃ/su ti dzā tri ⑫hūṃ/ su gan+dha ki hūṃhūṃ/ a ya hi dza hūṃ/ a hi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ te sgo ṭa baṃ hūṃ/ghaṇ+ḍa a a hūṃ zhes bya ba ni rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa nas/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i bar gyi yin no/ /de'i rjes la yi ge a las thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed la las kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o/ /de ni 'di yin te/ khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis byas la/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje mdzub mo ni/ /g.yas pa'i nang du bsgreng bar bya5 //byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya 'di/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sbyin byed pa'o/ / bsgying bcas bsor shā bas gnyis ka yis/ /zhes ⑩pa ni rin chen hūṃ mdzad dang /rdo rje sems dpa' dang / sems ma rdo rje ma'i'o/ /lcags kyu 'dzin ltar gnas pa dang / /mda' 'phang ba yi tshul dang ni/ /legs so zhes pa snying gar bshad/⑪/ /dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje gnyis/ /zhes bya ba ni rin chen hūṃ 31—1207

mdzad dang / khro bo rdo rje khro gnyer can dang / rin chen sems ma'i'o /snying gar nyi ma brtan par bya/ /g.yon pa la ni gru mo gzugs/ /de bzhin kha phyogs bskor bar bya/ /g.yas pa yi ①ni g.yon pa dbye du/ /zhes bya ba ni chos kyi hūṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje chos dang / chos kyi sems ma'o/ /snying gar g.yon pa 5 ral gri mdung / /mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /rdo rje gnyis ka kha nas dbyung / /rdo rje gar bskor dgrol ba yis/ /thal mo 'gram pa spyi bor gzhag /ces bya ba ni las kyi hūṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje las dang /las kyi sems ma'o/ /go cha mthe chung mche ④ba mchog /khu tshur gnyis ni mnan pa'o/ /rdo rje bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis su/ /bsam pa g.yos pas sdud par bya'o/ /phreng ba bcings pa kha nas dbyung / /gar las thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag4 /thur du blugs dang gyen du gtor/ /mthe bong mnyam ste durab tu bsdams—/ /rab tu brkyang nas byug pa ni/ /mchod pa'i phyag rgya rab tu bstanasngo—/ /mdzub mo lcags kyu bcing ba ni/ /mthe lduchung las te lcags kyu che/ / mchod pa'i 1mdud pa mdzub gnyis gdub/ /rgyab gnyis kyang ni mnyam ste mnan / /sgo srung gi nyu ni phyag rgya kun/ /las kyi phyag rgya gar las byung / /de nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni ji ltar bris pa'i rjes su 'brangs te bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rin chen dang / chos dang / las kyi khro bo rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po gang yin pa de ni sems ma rdo rje dang / rin chen ma dang / chos ma dang / rdo rje las ma yang yin pa las 'di rnams ni rdo rje'i nang du chud pa'i lha mo'i gzugs 'dzin ma yin—/ /bdag nyid chen po gang gang gis⑫ / /phyag rgya gang dang gang bcings 3 7—1208

pa—/ /bzlas pa'i snying bo'i don du ni/ /der ni bdag nyid bsgom par bya /zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya thams cad kyi dam tshig go/ /g.yon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur bkan la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo dang / mthe bo gnyis kyi mthe'u ①chung nas brtsams te/ phye nas thal mo khang thustong du bya ba 'di ni byams pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ 'di rnams kyi rig pa yang sngar bshad pa yin no/ /rig pa de nyid de rnams kyi ljags la bkod pa 'di ni de rnams kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yi ge a las rang gi snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed la bris pa dang / rjes su mthun par de rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po bcing ba ni las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsams la bris pa dang rjes su mthun pa kho nar de rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po bcing bar bya'o//rig pa de nyid kyang spyi yin no/ /mthe bos mthe'u 3chung bcings nas ni/g.yon pa sor mo dbus ma gsum/ /rtse gsum pa yi dbus ma rtse/ /rdo rje phyag rgyar bzung ba ste/ /rdo rje rig pa dam pa ste⑤/ /rdo rje mthu zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas rab tu bshad pa ni/ /rdo rje sgyu ma la sogs btags/ /rdo rje bcing ba 6 dam bcas te/ /g.yon pa rdo rje bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur zhes bshad de//rdo rje rigs ni kun kyi 'di'o④/ /rdo rje de ni gnyis byas te/ /mtshan ma kun ni nges dugazhag go/ /rdo rje rigs ni thams cad kyi/ /phyag rgya rnams kyang 'byung ba de⑨/ /mdun du brkyang ste bzhag pa dang / /mdzub mo mtheb bstan bcas ⑩pa dang / /oṃ zhes bya ba spyi bor sbyar/ /rdo rje steng du bzhag pa'o/ /rig pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs rnams so/ /rab tu brkyang nas lag gnas pa/ /lag pa'i rgyab tu de bzhin te/ /khu tshur brkyang ༄ /la lag ngar 31—1209

bskum / /kha phyogs su ni bskor bar bya/ /rdo rje khro bo'i phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /g.yon pa'i mthe bo'i steng du gzhag /phreng ba bcings pa'i ⑫thabs su sbyar/ /nor sbyin par ni g.yas pa tsoriste/ /ral gri phyag rgya khu tshur gcig /tshogs kyi bdag po chen po'i phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /g.yas pa mdun du mdung ring ③'dzin//lag pa brkyang pa'ang de bzhin te/ /g.yas pa 'od ni 'bar ba bstan/ /rdo rje khu tshur bskyod pa'o/ /pho nya'i phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs so/ /bsgyings bcas mdzub mo khar mche ba/ /dbyug pa bsnun cing mnan pa dang / /dpung pa bsgum 4zhing bcar ba dang / /g.yas pa g.yon gyi 'dren pa'o/ /bran gyi phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs so/ /de nas u ༄yeṣ+pem la sogs pa'i 'um mo rnams kyi phyag rgya bshad par bya ste/ g.yon pa rdo rje mdzub bcings pas/ /rtse gsum mtshan ma mnan par bya/ /'di bcings pas ni yang dag par/ /rig pa dam pa rang 'grub 'gyur/ /rdo rje rigs ni thams cad kyi/ /g.yon pa rdo rje gtso bor 'dus / /dam tshig go na )༄ji bzhin par/ /phyag rgya bcing bar 3bshad par bya / /thams cad 'khor lo sor rtse gsum/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya kyede bzhin no//de bzhin oṃ gyi phyag rgya dang / /seng ge'i rnam par 6yongs su bzung / /rig pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya rnams so/ /'bar ba kun du 'dzin pa dang / /'di ni yang dag 'dus pa nyid/ /dbyig pa'i khu tshur 'dzin pa dang / /kha 'gram phyag rgya bskor ba'o/ /khro bo'i te dam tshig rnams so/ /btud pa'i phyag rgya dang phrad glupa/ /rdo rjes mnan nas btud pa ste/ /spyi bor gzhag pa tshogs kyi ste/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni bsrung ba'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi ni dam tshig go/ /lag pa bskum pa khar bzhag ste/ /rgyab tu yang ni bskor bar bya/ /'bar dang me 37—1210

stag stong pa tsaste/ /de ④nas khar yang gnas par bya/ /pho nya mo'i dam tshig rnams so/ /mtha' 'am gnyis ni khar bcug dang / /gcod cing rab tu gnon pa'o/ /dpung pa bsnol bas bsnol ba dang / /myur du phyogs pa'ang de bzhin no/ /bran mo rnams kyi dam tshig go/ /de nas lha chen po la sogs pa'i lce la de'i sngags dgod pa 'di ni de rnams kyi chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yi ge a las rang gi snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje de bzhin du bskyed la/ de rnams kyi phyag rgya chen po bcing ba ④ni/ las kyi phyag rgyar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgoms la/ phyag rgya chen po bris pa dang rjes su mthun par bya'o//de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang / bskal pa bzang po rnams dang / phyi rol gyi rdo rje'i rigs rnams ni rdo rje rin chen kyi 5dbang bskur bas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /dpal hūṃ mdzad la sogs pa ni sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan dang / rdo rje phreng ba 4dang / dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de nas mchod yon phul la mchod pa bya ste/de la re zhig rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyu las byas pa'i bum pa sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rdo rje la sogs pa rang rang gi mtshan ma can la rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rang gi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa dang bum pa gang ba rnams phyi'i dkyil 'khor kyi phyi rol du dbul bar bya'o/ /ras zung 'bum mam/ khri 'am/ brgya 'am/ stong ngam/ re re zhing ngam/ thams cad la byer zung gcig dbul ba'am snyu/ bla re rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang /grwa bzhir ba dan sna tshogs btags pa dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan rnams kyang oṃ dang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad yongs su bzlas shing badz+ra spa 31—1211

ra ṇa khaṃ zhes bya ba 'dis lha thams cad la dbul bar bya'o/ /me tog gi shing brgya'am / stong ngam/gyo bzhi'am/ shing dang me tog thams cad kyang rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / oṃ badz+ra pu྾ hūṃ zhes bya ba me tog gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas me tog la mngon par bzlas pa ①dang / byug pa ni dri zhim zhing dri bzang pos bsgos pa'i dri bzang po thams cad la dbul bar bya'o/ /rdo rje me dang / oṃ badz+ra gadhe zhes bya ba 'di'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / ga bur dang / a ga rnguru dang / tu ruska thu/dang / tsan+dan la sogs pa legs par sbyar ba la/ rdo rje me dang / oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūṃ zhes bya ba 'dis bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ spos snod 'bum mam/ khri'am/ stong ngam/ brgya 'am / ci 'byor pa rnams dang / mar me 'bum mam/ khri'am stong ngam/brgya'am—/ de bzhin du mar me'i snod chen po sdong bu 'bar ba dang bcas pa stong ngam/ brgya'am/ bcu 'am gcig la rdo rje me dang oṃ khya badz+ra ā lo ke/zhes bya ba 'di mar me'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas 'uyongs su bzlas la/ badz+ra ④spa ra ṇa khaṃ zhes ༄zlos shing dbul bar bya'o/ / swe bhi ⑨ka la sogs pa lha bshos kyi zhal ⑩zas 'bum mam/ khri'am stong ngam/ brgya'am/ grangs bcu snyed dang /bza' ba dang / bca' ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa la de bzhin du rdo rje me yongs su bzlas la/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan tāta ⑪ces zlos shing dbul bar bya'o/ /rol mo'i cha byad bcu po'am/ stong phrag brgya 'am stong ngam/rol mo'i cha byad bcu po hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / rol mo'i phyag rgya rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi ⑩sor mo rnams kyis de'i ⑫tshul du byed pas dbul bar bya'o/ /rol mo'i cha byad bcu bo ni pi wang gling bu dang / mu ra dza dang / mu kun da dang /31—1212

ka na sam dang / ma rī dang / mṛ tang ①ga dang / pa ṭa ha dang / kuñja dang / ti mi li brdung ba'i tshul du byed pa'o/ /phyi rol du gar dang rol mo bya ba dang / cod pan dang gdu bu dang / rna rgyan la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyang / oṃ zhes bya ba mngon par bzlas te dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du dar dpyangs par ④bya ba dang / me tog chun 'phyang gi ①rnam par brgyan pa dang / dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang zla ba ④phyed pas nye bar mjos bye par byas pa dang / rta dang glang po che dang / ba lang gi khyu shin tu btags pa rnams kyang dbul bar bya'o/ /rta babs yid du 'ong ba dril bu la sogs pa btags pa yang badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ zhes bya ba 'dis 'bul ⑥lo/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha ta/badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta ram̐④/ badz+ra dharma ga ya ṣ+pe④/ badz+ra karma ka rosgo be/ zhes zlos shing gar byas la/ rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa mchod pa rnam pa brgyad khro bo'i khu tshur gnyis ma gtogs pa'i las kyi phyag rgya rnams kyis dkyil 'khor thams cad mchod par bya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba ni khro bo'i khya tshur gnyis su 'gyur ro/ /yang rdo rje rigs kyi las kyi '-idakyil 'khor las gsungs pa'i ⑨las kyi phyag rgya bcu drug gis yang dag par mchod la/ khro bo'i rigs thams cad la dngos grub thams cad 'grub ⑫ pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzod cig ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o / /de nas sgrub pa'i grogs mchog dkyil 'khor du bzhag la/ phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ 'bras yos bya zhing ⑫til dang bcas/ /'bras chen ⑫me tog chu dang bcas/ /sran chan bcas shing mang du bya/ /snum khur la sogs bza' ba rnams/ /zhes bya ba'i gtor ma la a kā ro zhes bya ba la sogs 31—1213

pa bzlas nas/ shar phyogs nas brtsams te gsum gsum gtor bar bya zhing dri dang me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / mchod yon rnams kyang thog ma dang tha mar 'bul 1lo/ /de la dang por re zhig maṇ+ḍal rnams byed du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas ni spyan drang ngo / /de nas dam tshig bstan ②la mchod yon phul te/ dri la sogs pas legs par mchod la gtor ma phul te de nas gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas sngags dang phyag rgya ni 'di rnams yin te/ shar phyogs su kha bltas te/ rkang pa g.yas pa brkyang ba'i tshul kyis 'dug nas/ lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan la/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje phyag rgya sta zur phyogs su bzhag ste/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar spyan drangs pa 4ni brgya byin gyi spyan drangs pa'i shephyag rgya'o/ /de la mdzub mo be+egs kyur ma byas pa ni brgya byin gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /rkang pa g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis 'dug la/ spyan drangs pa'i gyephyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang 7ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas 'di'i sngags na mo badz+ra su tsa di shi di shi badz+ra pa ṇi snye rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ me'i phyogs su bltas nas lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo zlum por bkug ste/ gung mo'i tshigs gsum par btsugs la/ mthe bo lag mthil du bzhag pa ni me lha spyan drangs pa'i spuphyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las ⑫mabe+e bo ngos la mdzub mo btsugs pa ni me lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o / /phyag rgya de nyid las mdzub mo mthe bo'i ngos la btsugs ⑩/ te phyir drag tu brkyang ba ni slar btang 15ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de'i sngags ni asna ye hūṃ e khya kā ba li 1 dz+wa la dz+wa la dā ha ngashi khi to li pi rū pak+ṣa swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su bltas nas snyim pa 7mdun du bzhag ste/ sor mo phan tshun bsdol la khu tshur 31—1214

bcangs nas srin lag gnyis bsgrengs te/ gshibs la g.yab ste ⑫nang du bzhag pa ni gshin rje spyan drangs pa'i kyephyag rgya'o/ /srin lag gnyis ka yang phyi rol tu de bzhin du gshibs gru te bsgreng ba snying gar bzhag pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o—/ /de nyid las srin lag sbyar ba ni slar btang ④ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni ya mā ya swā hā/ bden bral gyi phyogs su rkang pa mnyam pas 'dug/ la/lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur bcangs pa las mdzub mo dang gung mo ral gri 'dra bar gshibs te bgreng khyal bzhag /lag pa g.yon pa de ltar byas te/ sta zur phyogs su bzhag la/ g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bkug ste g.yab ( kyepa ni bden bral spyan drangs pa'i mephyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las lag pa g.yon pa sta zur phyogs su ral gri 'dra bar bzhag pa ni bden bral gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya las khya mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang nyuba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni sarba ju ta ba yi ka ra ku ru ku ru swā hā/ chu lha'i phyogs su rkang pa mnyam pas 'dug la/ lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs la/ mthe bo dang mdzub mo gcig tu sbyar te/ zhags mig ltar byas la g.yon pa'i khu tshur yang de ltar byas te/ snying gar bzhag la g.yon pa'i mdzub mo lcags kyur byas pa ni chu lha spyan drangs pa'i ⑫ phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las g.yon pa'i mdzub mo khu tshur gyi tshul ⑪du bzhag pa las zhags mig ltar byas pa ni chu lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i phyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang kyeba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ ṭīng tī bu tra hunaṭī ṭī shi khi ti/ li pi byu pak+ṣa thu swā hā/rlung lha'i phyogs su bltas te 'dug la/ lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs te gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs dang por mdzub mo bkug pa'i thor to btsugs la/31—1215

lag pa g.yas pa yang de bzhin du byas te/ sta zur logs su bzhag cing mje bong bsgul 7ba ni rlung lha spyan drangs pa'i zhuphyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe bong snga ma bzhin du bzhag pa ni rlung lha'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i shuphyag rgya las mthe bo ngabarkyang ba ni slar btang ⑤ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ swa sa kha kha mu rte kha swā hā/ ku be+e ra la mngon du bltas te 'dug ⑦nas lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar la rdo rje bcing ba nang du bzlog ste/ mthe'u ⑤chung gnyis gshibs 1la brkyang de'i rgyab tu srin lag gnyis so sor gnas nas/ gung mo gnyis rdo rje ltar bkug ste g.yab ⑩ pa ni ku be+e ra spyan drangs pa'i ⑩phyag rgya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo gnyis nang du rdo rje bcing ba'i ⑫tshul du bzhag pa ni ku be ra'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i 6phyag rgya las gung mo gnyis brkyang pa ni slar btang shāziba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ ku be+e rā ya swā hā/dbang ldan gyi phyogs su bltas te 'dug la lag pa gcig tu thal mo sbyar ba byas la/srin lag dang mje'u chung nang du bkug ste bsnol la/ gung mo gnyis gshibs wīte bsgreng ba'i rgyab logs su mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje ④'dra ba bya/ mthe bo gnyis rab tu gshibs 7te bzhag la/ de gnyis ⑪ las mdzub mo gnyis phan tshun rtse sprad nas nang du g.yab kyi pa ni dbang ldan spyan drangs pa'i du phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las snga ma ltar mdzub mo rdo rje'i tshul du bzhag pa ni dbang ldan gyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i smrephyag rgya las mdzub mo brkyang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni dz+re dz+re shi ba dz+re bye 1swā hā/ g.yon pa brkyang ba'i gnas pas 'dug la/ lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar te bzhag la/ steng du bltas te mdzub mo gnyis kyi bye lcags kyus ni/ tshangs pa la sogs pa spyan drang bar 531—1216

bya'o—/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis stisnga ma ltar bzhag pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o / /spyan drangs pa'i ②phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba ni slar btang — ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni 'di yin te/ udhi brah+ma ṇi swā hā/ srur+ya ④gra ha a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ tsan+d+ra ya nak+ṣa tra a bye pa ta ye swā hā/ rkang pa mnyam par gnas pas 'dug la/ lag pa gnyis gcig tu sbyar te/ sor mo rnams 'a mtshams med par rtse mo phan tshun sbyar/ mthe bo zlum por byas la/ 'og tu bltas te sa'i lha mel sogs pa mdzub mo lcags kyus spyan drang ba ④ni 'og gi lha sbyan drangs pa'i 3phyag rgya'o/ /spyan drangs pa'i spuphyag rgya las snga ma bzhin du mdzub mo bzhag pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /mdzub mo gnyis btang ba ni slar btang ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni a sgo pri thi ⑩bh+yaḥswā hā a su re bh+yaḥswā hā/ na ge bh+yaḥswā hā/ de nas rang gi sngags de nyid kyis ⑪thams cad la 'thor rdorethung phul ba (stsobadag dang slob ma'i tshogs su bcas pa la bgegs med par mdzod cig /las kyi dngos grub kyang bdag la stsol cig /ces brjod la nyu nathams cad slar btang ngo / /yang na dpung bzangs kyis zhus pa las 'byung ba'i tshigs su bcad ngupa rnams kyis gtor ma dbul ⑫bar bya ste/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul—/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad tshogs bcas g.yog 'khor dang bcas la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas su/ /thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyis⑫/ /gsan nas phan gdag/sa slad du 'dir byon ⑩cig /'byung po gang dag ri rab steng 31—1217

gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyem rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gnas na lhag par gnas pa dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu nyulteng ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sel ma can na gang gnas dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang / /khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen byes dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dag dang sum mdo dang / /gang dag lam chen dang ni shing gcig dang / /dur khrod chen po'am nags tshal chen po'am / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan duganas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas rngusu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang byug pa rnams/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul bas/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de ltar gdon la mchod pa byas nas ni/ /de nas phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin5thu/ /shar phyogs rdo rje can de lha tshogs bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /rnge dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag bo ste/ /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs rnams la/ /so so so 31—1218

sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dgyes pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes lkuganyen 'dun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung dang 'u thabs cig tu/ /me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mar bcas/ /'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang / /bdag gi las 'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /de la 'di ni phyi dang nang du bcas pa'i gtor ma sbyin pa'i sngags so/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā rde ār+ya nut+pan na tāta/de nas nye reg byas la shar phyogs kyi sgo la mngon par bltas te/ gnas pa'i las thams cad pa'i thab khung gi 3dbus su dpal khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi sngags zlos ④shing me tog gis bzhugs su gsol la/ sbyin sreg gi cho gas dpal rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi sngags kyis ba'i mar las sbyin shedrugs brgya rtsa brgyad dbul lo/ /dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sngags kyis kyang khro bo rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i mthar thugs 6pa'i bar yang sreg blugs bdun bdun dbul lo/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa me thab las me tog gis ྅spyan drangs te 5rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bris pa'i dkyil 'khor du rang rang gi gnas su bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis1sna / /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub ches/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bgyi/ /de la bcom ldan 'das kyi 6dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs pa la snod du gyur pa dang / ma gyur pa brtag tso131—1219

mi 'tshal lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can kha cig ni sdig pa chen po bgyid pa yang mchis te/ de dag gis ①rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs te mthong na ngan song thams cad dang rjobral bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das nor dang bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la sogs pa dang / dam tshig la mi dga' ba dang /sngar spyad pa la sogs mi nus pa'i sems can dag kyang mchis te/ de dag kyang 'dir ji ltar 'tshal ba bzhin du bgyid cing zhugs pa rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can kha cig ni gar dang /glu dang gad mo dang / rtsed mo dang / kha zas dang / spyod pa la dga' ba rnams dang gye de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i chos nyid khong du ④chud pas lha gzhan gyi rigs dang dkyil 'khor du 'jug gisaphye / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor re ba thams cad yang dag par 'u gyur pa bla na med pa'i dga' ba dang / mgu ba dang / rangs par 'gyur zub der ni bslab pa'i tshig gis 'jigs shing skrag nas mi 'jug pa dag kyang mchis te/ de dag ngan song gi dkyil 'khor gyi lam du 'jug par kha bltas shing gnas pa rnams kyang dga' ba dang / mgu ba'i dam pa 'grub cing /bde ba dang / yid bde ba myong bar bgyi ba dang / ngan song gi rgyud thams cad du kha bltas pa'i lam las bzlog par bgyi ba'i be+ed du/ rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug tu rung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das chos can gyi sems can de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dam pa 'grub pa'i thabs kyis 'bad cing / nyon 31—1220
