bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun 2par ri phug gam chu bo'am rdzing bu la sogs pa'i gnas su gnas nas/ grogs bzang po dang ldan pas sngon du bsnyen pa byas te/ kun du bzang po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i tshul gyis bgegs thams cad gzhom par bya ba dang / phyogs thams cad bcings nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i nam mkha' bcing bar khubyas la/ phyogs bcu na mthar thug pa med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dmigs la mchod pa nyi shu bya zhing sdom pa gzung ba 7byas la/ rdo rje lta bu'i sgrub thabs kyi cho gas bdag nyid bsgrub par je byas la/rang gi snying gar rdo rje pad+ma bsams la/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nam mkha' dang mnyam par spyor bas rdo rje la bzhugs te gcig tu gyur par nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o/ /badz+ra dh+wa tu ra haṃ sa haṃ zhes brjod pa ji srid mngon du mthong bar gyur pa de srid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po grub par gyur pa'i phyag rgya ni 'di rnams kyis bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta muṣ+ṭi haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa muṣ+ṭi a/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na muṣ+ṭi ṭ+wāphye/ oṃ badz+ra dharma 6 muṣ+ṭi khaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra karma muṣ+ṭi haṃ/ bsgom par mi nus pa ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa 3tshig tsam gyis dmigs pa la lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi snying po re re zhing 'bum bzlas te/ de lta bus kyang dkyil 'khor chen po 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub pas ni gsang ba'i phyag rgya bcings nas gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/snying po dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang sngags dang rig tsupar bshad pa dkyil 'khor dang bcas par gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya de'i nang na chud par bsams la/ so so'i rig tsosngags 'bum mam khri bzla ba'am/ ji srid 31—1409

gzungs shekyi dkyil 'khor grub pa de srid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de la de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje bcing ba dam bcas te/ /gung mo myu gu bzhin du gshib/ /mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo bsgrengs3 / /dam tshig mchog gi dam tshig go/ /de ltar gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ rdo rje phra mo'i spyor ba yis/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag bsgoms nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor rdo rje phra mo dang / /ting nge 'dzin ni dbang bsgyur duba'o/ /de nas las kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /de yis 4rdo rje brtan 3par bzung / / mthe bong mthe'u chung 6 bcings pa ni/ /rdo rje las mchog dkyil 'khor ro/ /de ltar byas nas dkyil 'khor zi bar bya ste/ de la rgyal pos ni khru brgya'am khru lnga bcu pa bya'o/ /blon po'am blon po chen pos ni khru lnga bcu pa'am nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ /tshong dpon nam ded dpon gyis ni khru nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'am de'i phyed do/ /sgrub pa snyupos ni khru bcu gnyis pa'am khru drug pa'o/ /de las chung bar ni mi bya'o/ /de nas sa gzhi yongs su gzung —bar bya ste/ gtsug lag khang dang grong rdal dang //kun dga' grong ngam grong khyer ni/ /gang zhig shar dang byang du lta /—/ /lho dang nub tu ma yin no/ /shis shing sngon ni yongs brten pa'i/ /sa ni mkhas pas bgrod par bya/ /yang na yid ni dga' gyur pa/ /gang yin der ni brtsam par bya/ /der sa gzhi'i dbus su yi ge haṃ gis ⑫zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas sa gzhi yongs su gzung 1— bar bya ste/ rdo dang bong ba shing rul pa la sogs pa bsal bar byas nas/ chu'i dri zhim pos 8yongs su dgang ngo / /de nas legs par bcags te shar dang byang du gzhol ba/ khang pa brtsegs 3nama'i nang 31—1410

du chud pa/ phyogs bzhi nas rta babs kyi phyi rol du shing gi dral sgos 1bskor cing shing dral sgo bzhis nye bar mdzes par byas pas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi lhag par mdzes par byas par gyur te/ sa yongs su gzung 2ba'i cho ga'o/ /der sa'i dbus su sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gi gnas pas 'dug la/ bsam gtan bzhi'i rim bzhin dmigs nas 'og min gyi gnas su 'dug ste/ mi g.yo ba'i nying nge 'dzin la dmigs te/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas/sems thuso sor rtog pa la sogs pa'i rim gyes rnam par sangs rgyas nas 5ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du rdo rje rtse mo khang pa brtsegs pa nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rnams bsgom par bya ste/ 'di ni dang por sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas rnam par snang mdzad du bdag nyid bsgoms la rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bskyed de rdo rje bsdu ba byas nas rang gi snying gar 5gnas pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' la mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bstod par bsgom pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /de nas ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng nas babs te dkyil 'khor sa gzhi'i dbus su las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pas 'dug nas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i gnas su rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms la/de'i sngags dang phyag rgya zulan cig byin gyis brlab pa byas la/ de nyid kyi phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor de'i steng du nam mkha' la bsgom mo/ /kun du rnam par bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod nas/ /bsgyings pa'i tshul gyes yongs su bskor/ /de nas/ sems dpa' chen po bcu drug gi/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i thig skud ni/ /sar pa las ni bkal nas ni/ /tshad 31—1411

dang mthun par mdzes pa yisahūṃ/ /zig gi mkhas pas ci nus kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni thig gdab bo/ /de nas thig gi phyag rgya dang sngags ni 'di yin te/rdo rje phyag rgyas thig bzung rgunas/ /dang por dkyil 'khor thig gdab bo/ /phyi nas thig bzung bya ba ni/ /ji lta bas ni thig gdab bo/ /sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya 4sru tra ma thutikra ma hūṃ/ de nas shar du mngon par phyogs la thig brkyang la slob ma nub tu lta thubs thig bri ba dang / slob dpon lho phyogs su mngon par phyogs gyenas brkyang la/ slob ma byang phyogs su mngon par phyogs la bye bar bya'o/ /de yang / phyogs kun mnyam par byas nas ni/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor thig gdab ste/ /shar dang nub dang byang dang lho/ /phyogs bzhi'i thig gi dkyil 'khor brgyad/ /ces lung las gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin du nang gi dkyil 'khor la ni cha brgyad du brtag go/ /de nas cho ga 'di yis ni/ /kun nas zur bzhi legs par byas/ /phyogs bzhir yongs su bskor nas ni/ /sngags shes pas ni gnas bya ba/ /dbus kyi gnas ni spangs nas su/ /me yi phyogs su gnas nas ni/ /sngags pas sngags phyogs gyeshes pa yis / /snga ma bzhin du srad bu bre/ /de nas cho ga shes pa yis/ /dbang ldan phyogs su legs par bya/ /der ni nub tu mngon phyogs nas/ /byang phyogs su ni bye bar bya/ /de nas de ni dbang ldan mchog /yang ni bye/rlung gi phyogs su gnas/ /lho yi phyogs su mngon phyogs pas/ /nub kyi phyogs su bre bar bya/ /gnas de 9snayongs su spangs nas ni/ /bden bral gyi ni phyogs song ni / /de nas ji srid nub phyogs kyi/ /spyod yul bar du bye bar bya/ /zhes 'khor lo mchog 7la sogs pas bsrung ba yin no/ /gru bzhir bgyi zhing sgo bzhi 31—1412

dang / /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes bgyis la/ /thig bzhi dang ni ldan gyur pa/ /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /gru bzhi phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni nang rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim gyi nang du/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /ldan par 'khor lo bye bar bya'o/ /'khor lo de'i nang du rdo rje'i thig gis yongs su bskor bar bya'o/ /sgo ni/ zur bzhi pa la sgo bzhi ste/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i ①brgyad cha la/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis—/ /rten cing 'brel pa bsngags pa yin/ /nor bu chen po'i rin po ches thuso sor spras pa'i dril bu kha dog sna tshogs pas btags —pa'i rlung gis bskyod pa dar dang / 'phan dang / me tog dang phreng ba dang dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / zla bas nye bar mdzes par byas pa'i khyams kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun du byes pa la/ de'i rim pa'i nang du 4zhugs la 'khor lo 'dra ba'i thig gis yongs su bskor bar bya'o/ /ka ba brgyad kyis mdzes byas pa/ /rdo rje ka ba'i nang logs su/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lngas brgyan la/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /sangs rgyas kyi thuni gzugs bzhag cing / /sangs rgyas kun gyi phyogs kun gyi6/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi 7dbus rnams su//rim bzhin du ni dam tshig mchog /bzhi po legs par gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po de dag tu/ /rdo rje gom thupas song nas su/ /mi g.yo ba yi dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje 'dzin sogs bcas par gzhag /rin chen 'byung ldan dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje snying sogs rdzogs par gzhag /tshe dpag med pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje spyan sogs rdzogs par gzhag /37—/7 13

gdon shemi za ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje rgya gram la sogs gzhag /'khor lo yi ni nang logs su/ /rdo rje lha mo rnams kyang gzhag /dkyil 'khor phyi yi grwa rnams su/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa rnams kyang gzhag /sgo rnams kun gyi nang du ni/ /sgo srung 4bzhi yang gzhag par bya/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim phyogs su ni/ /sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang gzhag /'jug gam phyi rol 'byung ba na/ /ri mo'am rdo rje srad bu dag /yid kyis brdeg pa byas na rgo/ /de ni dam tshig nyams mi 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūṃ/ de la rgyal po'i ni rin po che lnga'i phye mas dkyil 'khor bri'o/ /blon po chen po dang mdun blon gyis ni rin po che'i phye ma dang bsres pa'am/ 'bras shā lu'i phye mas so/ /ded dpon la sogs pa ni 'bras btags cipa'i phye mas so/ /sgrub pa pos ni 'bras kyi phye ma nyid bsngags zhepa yin no/ /gur gum la sogs pa'i phye ma dri zhim po'i khu bas sam tshon lngas bsgo'o/ /de nas dang por ni sngon po dgye'o/ /de nas ni gser dang pad+ma rā ga dang margad dang mu tig dgye ste/ de yang / sngon po thog mar gtang 7bar bya/ /de nas ser po gtang bar bya/ /de yi 'og tu dmar po ste/ /de yi 'og tu ljang gu gtang 9/ /kun kyi nang rol dkar po ste//tshon gyi cho ga de ltar bshad/ /yang na/ yung ba dang rgya skyegs dang / rams mchog ste/ tshon ni bzhi pos btso bar bya/ /lnga la dkar po'i rang bzhin stekha//mnyam pas kun du 'grub par 'gyur/ /de la tshon bzlas pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las ni/ /mdzub mo gnyis ni legs sbyar ba/ /byas nas tshon rtsi thams cad ni/ /'bar ba'i lta bas dgug par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hūṃ/ tshon la yang sems dpa' chen po bcu 37byed/4/4

drug gzhag par nyubya'o/ /kun du bzang po'i sbyin sreg gi skabs su 'jug pa'i cho ga dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya nas brtsams te/ sems dpa'i rdo rje lcags kyu'i nang du bshad pas 'dir ma smras so/ /de yi sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pas/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad gang ba rnams/ /dkyil 'khor rnams su 'dus par 'gyur— / /de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom byed cing / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa yi / /cung zad rab tu brjod par bgyi/ /de nas 'dus pa dgyes pa nas/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams brtan par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab 'grub 4pa/ /grub pa nyid du nye bar gnas/ /de nas phyag rgya dang sngags 'dis sgo dbye bar bya ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las ni/ /mdzub gnyis dam sbyar gan rkyal gzhag/shin tu khros pas rnam dbye ba/ /sgo dbye ba yi mchog yin no/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon ni/ /mnyam bzhag dbus su gnas gyur pa5/ /yid kyis dbye bar bya ba nyid/ /rdo rje'i sgo ni bzhi pa'o/ /de la sgo dbye ba'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra urgyu ṭa 6ya sa ma ya pra be+e sha ya hūṃ/ de nas sgo rnams thams cad du/ /lcags kyu la sogs pa bgyis nas7/ /las chen mchog gi phyag rgya yis / /dam tshig rnams ni gzhag par bgyi/ /rdo rje lta bur bsgrub pa'i cho gas rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa/ phyag rgya chen po legs par bsgrubs nas las kyi phyag rgya gzhag par bya ste/ dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgyas 9dang / /sems dpa' rdo rje la sogs pa de ltar sems dpa' chen po sgrub pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/zhes brjod cing / de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ /sems dpa' chen po kun bsdu ba/ /spyan drangs nas ni rab tu gzhug⑫ /bcings nas de yi 37—/ /5

dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas mchod pa bya ste/ gal te rgyal po nor che ba yin na des rin po che sna bdun gyi rgyu las byung ba'i bum pa brgya'am/ nyi shu'am rtsa lnga 'amasnye / bcu drug gam/ brgyad dam/ lnga'am/ tha na rin po che las byas pa'i bum pa gcig byas la/ lhag ma dag ni zangs dang sa dag las bya'o/ /blon po la sogs pa rnams kyis 2ni longs spyod dang rjes su 'tsham par bya'o/ /de la bum pa'i mtshan nyid ni mchu 'phyang ba mgrin pa ring ba lto ba ③che ba mgrin pa snyeras kyis dkris 'upa kha 'bras bus bkang ba/ rin po che dang sman dang /'bru dang / spos chus yongs su gang ba byas nas gsang sngags kyi bsnyen pa bya'o//de la gsang sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badzod ka hūṃ/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni rdo rje gyebyen gyis brlab )pa'i me tog gi yal gas bzlas brjod stong byas la/bdag po'i gnas su gzhag go/ /bum pa gzhan rnams ni bzlas brjod brgya byas la/ sgo dang mtshams la sogs pa brgyad du gzhag par bya'o/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ཿba dan dag ni 'bum tsam bya ste/ stong las nyung bar /mi bya'o/ /spos la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa rnams la ni sngar rang gis mngon 7 par gdab par bya'o/ /mar me'i sdong bu dang spos khang dang / mal stan la sogs pa ni 'bum las lhag par 'bul te/ stong las nyung bar mi bya'o/ /blon po la sogs pas ni 'byor pa dang rjes su mthun par 'bul ⑪bar bya'o/ /rta dang glang po dang ba lang gi tshogs shin tu brtags pa rnams kyang 'bul bar bya'o—/ /rta babs dril bu la sogs pa dang ldan pa ji snyed pa las kyang bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes bgyis la/ /sems can don kun 'grub pa'i phyir/ /thams cad mdzod ces gsol ba gdab//37—/ 4/6

gsol ba btab nas phyi rol tu/ /rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud kyi sngags kyis phyi 1rol tu gtor ma byin la/ nye reg byas la nang du zhugs te cho ga lhag pa dang ma tshang ba rnams nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byas nas/ phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan dang slob ma dang lhan cig tu dkyil 'khor bstan par bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ gang gi tshe rdo rje sems dpa' ston pa na/ slob mas kyang rdo rje khu tshur nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /gal te rgyal po ston pa na/ rdo rje gnod sbyin nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /gang gis samordo rje chags pa ston pa na rdo rje bsrung ༄/ ba nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin ston pa na rdo rje las nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /phyag rgya rang gi gnas su bkrol la thal mo mnyam pas mnyes par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe rdo rje smra ba ston pa na rdo rje rin chen nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe rdo rje 'khor lo ston pa na rdo rje gzi brjid nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe rdo rje rdon po ston pa na rdo rje rgyal mtshan nye bar bstan par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe rdo rje 3chos ston pa na rdo rje bzhad pa nye bar bstan par bya ste/ phyag rgya bkrol zhing rang bzhin gye gnas su thal mo nges par bcings te/de ltar byas pas ni dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa byin gyis zlob par mdzad par 'gyur ro/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad du rdo rje slob dpon gyi las yin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi las ni zla ba nya nas brtsams nas phyi ma'i zla ba nya'i bar ram/ tshes gcig nas brtsams nas zla ba nya'i bar ram bcu gnyis nas brtsams nas nya'i bar ram phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor ni nyin mtshan gcig gis bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yongs su bzung nas lhag par gnas par bya ste gzhug par bya'o/ /phyag na rdo rjes byin brlabs 631—1417

shing / /de bzhin dad pas bsgrub pa dang / /byang chub sems dang 'gro don gyis—/ /byang chub sems dpar 'gyur bas na/ /dag pa'i chos kyi rjes 'jug pa/ /theg pa che la lhag mos pas/ /thams cad du ni kun 'grub 'gyur//zhes bya bas rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas slob ma yongs su gzung hūṃ zhing snod du rung bar bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rigs kyi bu smros shig ces 2brjod par bya'o/ /slob mas kyang / byang chub sems ni bla med pas — / /rdo rje slob dpon bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni babe+eb pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /sangs rgyas kun ni brtul zhugs che/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /dkon mchog gsum yang bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dang / /slob dpon dag kyang bdag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /slob dpon du yang bdag 'gyur kyikru/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /sdom pa dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa 5yang / /sdom pa bdag la hrul du gsol/ /de bzhin las kyi rigs chen la/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir/ /mgon pos bdag la sdom pa stsol/ /zhes brjod par bya ste/ de ltar yongs su bzung 6nas lhag par gnas par bya ste/ snying ga dang spyi bor de bzhin du bsams la/ khu tshur g.yas pas rdo rje bzung nas snying gar bzhag na lhag par gnas par byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sdom pa sbyin par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dus 'di nas bzung 7ste/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus 37byed1 418

gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges byas pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pas(1 / /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan par gzung 3bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams te gzung 1bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spong ngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung 4bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung 3 bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung 6bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog dag pa la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung 7bar babyu/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi 8phyir/ /bdag gis sgosdom pa ma lus gzung 7/ /ma bsgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba ni bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /de ltar sdom pa 'dzin nus pa de la ⑫ni dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bgyi'o / /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba la gal te bgegs byung bar gyur na/ de'i tshe rdo rje gnod sbyin kyi sngags 'bum bzlas pa'i phur bus bgegs thams cad la gdab par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gyi 4sa'i dbus su 37—/419

phur bus gdab bo/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab tu lcags ri'i thig gdab/de'i rgyab tu 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab kyi phyi rol tu lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa'i bgegs rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pas bkug la bcings te phur bus gdab—/ shar lho'i mtshams su ni me'i bgegs so/ /lhor ni yi dwags kyi bgegs so/ /lho nub tu ni srin po la sogs pa'i bgegs so/ /nub tu ni klu la sogs pa'i bgegs so/ /nub byang tu ni rlung gi bgegs sonyu/ /byang du ni gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i bgegs so/ /byang shar du ni 'byung po'i bgegs so/ /gsang sngags 'di ruphur bus gdab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra tī li sarba bispyo ban+ta hūṃ phaṭa/rdo rje spyan dang rdo rje me ltar rab tu phur bus bsrung bar bya'o/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis steng du nam mkha' bcing ngo / /rdo rje 'jigs byed rdo rje spyan dang rdo rje bsdams pa'i steng du rdo rje dra ba byas te/ de yang / sems can 'tshe bar byed pa dang / /sdig pa med kyis khyed ma 'jigs/ /rig sngags las byung dge ba sbyin/ /bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung / /zhes gsungs pas so/ /dkyil 'khor gye bya ba thams cad sdogs pa nas lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du gshegs su gsol/ phur bu bton nas 'o mas bkrus te/ sems can thams cad la dmigs nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /shar phyogs kyi sgor kha khyer gyi phyi rol rdo rje lta bu'i kha khyer la byang du mngon par bltas nas/ til bsregs nas sdig pa bsreg par bya'o/ /de bzhin du lho sgor rin po che 'dra ba'i kha khyer la shar du mngon par bltas nas rgyas par 'dod pas 'bras kyi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de bzhin du nub sgor zla ba kham pa lta bu'i kha khyer la byang du mngon par bltas nas tshe 'phel bar 'dod pas drur —ba'i myu gu mar la sbags pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /31—1420

de bzhin du byang phyogs kyi sgor go cha 'dra ba'i kha khyer la lho phyogs su mngon par bltas nas bsrung ba'i phyir/ ku sha'i myu gu til mar gyis byugs pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o—/ /yang na de bzhin du shar sgor ①kha khyer kun nas zlum po'i rnam pa la til la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /thab khung gi phyi rol du shar nas byang du blta ba dang / byang nas shar du blta ba dang / lho nas shar du blta ba dang /nub nas lhor blta ba dang / ku sha bkram la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de yang dkyil 'khor de dag de nyid ni/ /su zhig gis ni brtag par ④nus/ /rang gi lha yi spyor ba yis/ /dkyil 'khor brtag pa grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /slob dpon gyis rab tu bcug nas dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon gyi las rnams bslab par bya ste/ de nyid ni rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i gnas gsang ba ste/ gsang ba ni 'di nyid do zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /de nas rdo rje slob ma'i tshogs rab tu bcug la/ rdo rje'i chu la 'bum bzlas pas dbang bskur la/rdo rje slob dpon nyid thob 1par 'gyur te/ 'di yang rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badzo da ka hūṃ 'dis dbang bskur na dkyil 'khor thams cad bri zhing bdag nyid dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ro/ /gzhan gyis ni ma yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa'i slob dpon gzhan ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi jidakyil 'khor du gzhug cing dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rgyas par ni de nyid las 'byung 5bas 'dir ma smras so/ /de lta mod kyi khyad par cung zad cig bshad par bya ste/37—1421

rdo rje slob dpon gyis slob ma las (1yon blang bar bya ste/ slob mas kyang gus pas mchod yon sngon du 'gro bas yon dbul bar bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' lhag par mos pas yon gyi mchog rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /gang la yongs su btang 2dga' gang / /de ni mchog tu bshad pa yin/ /de la gal te mchog 'dod la/ /de yang ngan pa'i yon 'bul na/ /kun gyi slob dpon brnyas pas na—/ /de ni rtag tu sdug bsngal thob / /rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad du lhag par mos pas ni/ bu mo shin tu brgyan pa'am / /de bzhin chung ma sdug pa dag /phul nas rin gyis slu ④ ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mchog gi yon/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ni rin chen rgyan thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa phul nas slar rin gyis slu 5bar bya'o/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gis ni shin tu dkar ba'i ras zung ngam mu tig gi phreng dza ba bzang po'o / /nam mkha'i snying po'i rta dang glang po dkar po'am shing rta nor bu rin po che la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /rdo rje sna tshogs kyi ni yon thams cad blangs la cho ga 'dis dbang bsgur bar bya'o/ /de la rgyal po ni rin po che las byas pa'i dbu rgyan 9no/ /lhag ma rnams ni lugs ma'am bcos ma byas pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 7ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgu'i rin po che dang / dar dpyangs dang dbang bsgur ba'i dbu rgyan no/ /phyag na rdo rje'i ni rdo rjes dbang bskur ba'i nor bu'i dbu rgyan no/ /'jig rten dbang phyug gi ni 'od dpag tu med pa'i nor bu'i dbu rgyan no/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i ni rdo rje rin chen gyi myu gu dang ldan pa'i dbu rgyan no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis nardo rje rin po ches khams gsum gyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba'i nor bu'i dbu rgyan te/37—1422

dbu rgyan gye gsang sngags sngar bzlas brjod 'bum byas la dbang bsgur ba'i dus su dbu rgyan rang gi gsang sngags kyis husnalan brgya bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas dar dpyangs mgo la bcings nas rang gi rdo rje lag par bzhag la/ ji lta ba bzhin du dbang zhebaskur bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas khyod don 'byung ba'i dngos grub kyi ye shes dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas de gang mngon par 'dod pa de la sbyin par bya'o/ /yang na phyag rgya chen po bsgrub bye/par 'dod na de la rdo rje lta bu'i thabs kyi sgrub pa'i tshul gyis rang la sgrub pa'i thabs nye bar bstan par bya'o//de nas rang gi gnas su phyag rgya bkrol la dbang bskur ba dang cho ga bcings pa dang / mnyes par bya ba la sogs pa byas nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings la gyen du bkrol la/ sems can log par lta jeb dang / sdig pa'i las byed pa dang / brtson 'grus chung ba dang / sbyor ba med pa dang / ri mo mi shes pa de dag gi phyir kun du bzang po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i tshul gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor khru bcu pa'i phyed kyi phyag rgya bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor dz+re'o/ /yo byad thams cad dang mi ldan pa rnams dang / dam tshig 'dod pa rnams la ni phyag rgya gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi cho ga'i rjes su 'brangs pa dang / rang gi rtog pa'i cho gas bri bar bya'o / /5dkyil 'khor cho ga bsdus pa las/ /bsod nams bdag gis bsags pa de6/ /des ni sems can ma lus pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchog 'grub shog /dpal ldan rgya che ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdzogs so// //31—1423

༄༄/ /kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i sprun sreg gi cho ga3 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ sa man+ta bha dra nā ma ho ma lo bi ka /bod skad du/ kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga /bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems brtan las byung ba/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad phyag 'tshal te/ /dngos grub thams cad kun basbus pa/ /sbyin sreg de nyid bdag gis bshad/ /de nyid rigs 2pas sbyin sreg la/ /dgos nga/ dang po kun byas te/ /grogs bzang bya ba nges pa dang / /phyi nas sbyin sreg rab tu bya/ /gtsug lag khang dang grong rdal dang / /kun dga' grong ngam grong khyer ni/ /shar dang byang du blta ba ste/ /lho dang nub tu ma yin no/ /shis shing sngon ni ston pa yi/ /sa ni mkhas pas bgrod par bya/ /yang na yid ni dga' 'gyur ba/ /gang yin der ni brtsam 4par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni sbyangs nas su/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni bri bya ste/ /zur bzhi pa la 31—1426

sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni mdzes byas la/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan / /dar dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen spras par ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim thig gdab bo/ /de yi rim pa'i nang zhugs la/ /sbyin sreg thab ni bri bar bya/ /kun nas zur ni bzhi pa la/ /khru gnyis par ni yongs su bsgrags—/ /zabs su khru gang tsam la ni/ /kha khyer bzhi 1ni bskor ba'o/ /dbus su gtsug tor dgod bya zhing / /de yi shar du lhung bzed do/ /lho phyogs na ni rin chen te/ /nub kyi phyogs su pad+ma bri/ /byang du rdo rje hūṃ mdzad ni / /gdug pa thams cad zlog —pa'o/ /mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad du/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa bstan pa dgod/ /de ltar thab khung nges byas nas/ /kha khyer la ni 'jug par bya/ /dang po la ni sems dpa' che/ /bcu drug nyid du bsgrags pa yin/ /de yi rgyar ni sor brgyad la/ /dpangs su sor ni bzhi pa'o//kha khyer gnyis par gyur pa dag /de yang rgyar ni sor brgyad de/ /dpangs su sor ni brgyad par bshad/ /de dgongs 1bdag gis bshad par bya/ /shar phyogs nas brtsams rim bzhin du/ /pad+ma nags kyi mjug ma dang / /bgrang phreng ril ba spyi blugs dang / /a dze 4na yi phyag rgya ni5/ /tri shu la dang zla ba phyed—/ /ral pa mig dang rgyal mtshan che/ /mdzes shing bde ba'i phyag rgya che/ /lho yi phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /dung dang 'khor lo be con dang / /ral gri dang ni de bzhin phub/ /phag dang seng ge gshibs pa ni/ /nub kyi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /mdung dang dril bu ba dan dang / /rma bya de bzhin ra skyes dang / /khyem bya lang tshos dzimyos pa ni/ /byang gi phyogs su bri bar bya/ /kha khyer gsum 31—1427

par gyur pa dag /de yang rgyar ni sor brgyad pa/ /dpangs su sor ni bcu drug pa/ /sgo glegs dang ni gtan par bcas/ /de yi phyogs bzhir rta babs dang / /bcas pa'i sgo rnams bya ba dang / /dra ba dra phyed me long bcas /ba dan la sogs rnams kyis bskor/ /kha khyer bzhi par bshad pa ni/ /khor yug lta bur yang dag gnas/ /rgya ru sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /dpangs su sor ni drug pa'o/ /de yang rdo rje phreng bas brgyan/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'od 'khrugs 1pa/ /'di ni bsrung ba'i tso7mchog yin zhes/ /rdo rje can gyes sngon gsungs so/ /sdig kun 'phrog cing bsod nams dang / /dag byed dngos grub thams cad ster bye/ /bkra shis pa nyid yin bshad pa/ /'di ni thab khung yin par bsgrags/ /gang yang brgya rtsa bcu pa yis thu/ /thab khung bzang po bshad pa rnams/ /spyi yi thab khung gang yin pa/ /bye brag can bzhin gnas pa yin/ /thab khung gi byematshan nyid do/ /dgang gzar dang blugs gzar gyi mtshan nyid ni 'di yin te/ dgang gzar gyi yu ba ni rgyal po'i lag pa'i tshad kyis 'usor bcu drug kun nas sor bzhi pa/ dgang gzar gyi zabs su sor gnyis pa/ steng du sor bzhi pa/ dbus su rdo rje rtse lngas mtshan pa/ yu ba'i 'og tu rdo rje dang rin po ches mtshan pa ni dgang gzar gyi mtshan nyid do/ /blugs gzar gyi mtshan nyid ni khru gang tsam la steng du pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba sor gnyis pa la/ dbus rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa ni drugs gzar gyi mtshan nyid do//khrus dang nye reg la 'bad nas/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg khang par 'jug /de nas bgegs rnams nyer zhi'i phyir/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rjes dran bya/ /de la khro bo'i rgyal po ni 'di yin te/ khro bo ti rīrnyi 7ri'i phyag rgya bcings la/ hūṃ badz+ra a 31—1428

na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa 1hūṃ phaṭa/ khro bo ti rīrnyi snari'i phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje bcing ba nang du bcings la/ mthe bong gnyis po mnyam —pas / sor mo'i rtse mo thams cad bcir thubar bya ste/ 'dis ni bdud la sogs pa bgegs thams cad bcom par 'gyur ro/ /de nas go cha 'dis phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje gtsug tor dang / rdo rje zhags pas shar phyogs bcing ngo / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas/ /mthe'u chung gcig la gcig stel te/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar nas rtse mo bzlog ste/ spyi gtsug tu gzhag pa ni gtsug tor kyi phyag rgya ste/ sngags la oṃ hūṃ ban+dha hūṃ/ zhes kyang smrosabye / rdo rje gtsug tor nyid zlum por byas pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya ste sngags la dhīḥbadz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje hūṃb dan gyis nub phyogs bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la mthe bo gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung du bya / mdzub mo gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang pa 'di ni rdo rje ba dan gye phyag rgya ste sngags la oṃ badz+ra pa taṅgi pa taṅgi 7ni ra ṭa/ de nas rdo rje nag pos byang dang 'og dang steng dang mtshams rnams bcings te/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba bcings la mthe bo brkyang ste/ mdzub mo gnyis mche ba 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje nag po'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags la dhīḥ5badz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ de nas rdo rje rtse mos lho phyogs bcings te/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ rtse mo ltar steng du gzhag pa ni rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags la oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa ma ṭa/de nas rdo rje spyan gyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang rdo rje me ltar rab tu 'bar bas bgegs bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa byas la/ mthe bo gnyis brkyang ste mnyam por gzhag pa ni/ rdo rje spyan gyi phyag rgya ste/ /sngags la oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe tsu 31—17 29

tri ban+dha sat+tha bispyo 1rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la mthe bo gnyis brkyang pa ni rdo rje ti rībye 2ri'i phyag rgya ste/ 'dis spyi bo nas brtsams te bdag nyid dbang bsgur ba byas la dar dpyangs pa'i tshul du bkrol — nas mnyam pa'i thal mos mnyes par bya'o / /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings la/ /rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pa snying gar gzhag /rdo rje khu tshur g.yas pa bsor thuba'i tshul du gzhag pa ni rdo rje rnge ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i phyag rgya ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje me ltar rab tu 'bar bas 5bdud la sogs pa'i 6bgegs thams cad bsregs sngopa dang 'tshed pa dang thal bar byed pa la sogs pa la khyab par byas tekye/ sngags la oṃ badz+ra dzā byel a na lārka hūṃ/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya bcings la/ g.yas nas bskor bas phyogs bcings shing 1 sna/ dkyil 'khor bcing ba byas nas rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyi :lngasteng du rdo rje ra ba byas na dkyil 'khor bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sa gzhi bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje bsdams pa kha thur du bstan te sa la bzhag nas sasa'i gzhi rnams rdo rje'i rang bzhin du 'gyur te/ rang bzhin ngan pa rnams kyis 'jug par dka' bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra dṛ 4 narnyo me bhā ngab rak+ṣa sarde swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis sa bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas nam mkha' bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya ni rdo rje nag mo'i phyag rgya nyid do/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mig gi phyag rgyas steng bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings 15la mgal me bskor ba'i tshul du bskor te mgo bo'i steng du mdzub mo lcags kyu 'dra bar gzhag pa ni rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi nyu spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas rdo rje bsdams pas rdo rje'i dra ba bya ste/37byed/ /30

rdo rje bsdams pa ni rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra ban+dha/de nas dogs pa med par gyur par byas nas mchod pa bya ste/ rdo rje thal mo brkyang nas lus thams cad kyis phyag bya'o/ /oṃ 1 sadze+e ta thā ga ta pū dzo pasru nā ya / ad+ma snyeram̐ nit+yā ta yā 1mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a bye tiṣ+ṭha ngaswa rmā/de nas de bzhin du gnas la rdo rje thal mo snying gar gzhag ste dpral bas phyag bya ste / oṃ sarba 5 ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhe ṣe kā ya āt+pa 5dzā nit+yā ta yā mi/ sarba 7ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca rmā/ de nas rdo rje rkye thal mo spyi bor bzhag la khas kyephyag bya'o/ /oṃ sarba 6ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya āt+pa ram̐ nit+yā ta yā nyu mi/sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhadz+re pra brta ya rmā/ de nas de bzhin du rdo rje thal mo spyi bo nas phab steske/ snying gar bzhag nas mgos phyag bya ste/ oṃ sarba 1 ta thā ga ta pū dza kan+d+ra ṇi āt+pa rmā thunit+yā ta yā mi/ sat+tha ta thā ga ta badz+ra kadz+re ku ru rmā/des ni mchod pa bye ba byas par 'gyur ro⑫/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la/ pus mo gnyis sa ⑫la btsugs te/ spyi bo sa la gtugs pa ni phyag bya ba'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags ni oṃ sarba tso—ta thā ga ta kā ya bāka tsit+ta pā da ban+dha nargo ka ro mi zhes bya'ophre/ /bdug spos kyi phyag rgya babyungs la/ lha'i bdug pa'i mchod pa rnams dran bzhin du sngags 'di brjod do/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas me tog gi phyag rgya bcings 2 la / thang las skyes pa dang chu las skyes pa'i me tog gi sprin rnams spros te/oṃ sasba ta thā ga ta pu྾ pū 5dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas mar ske'i phyag rgya bcings la/ nyi ma'i snang ba dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ sazla ta thā ga ta ā lo ke rū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ byug pa'i phyag rgya bcings la/37 byed/ /31

lha la sogs pa'i spos kyi sprin rnams tshodabul bar bya ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gasgo pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas rin po che'i bye thubrag la sogs pa rnams dbul te/ oṃ sabyu ta thā ga ta bo bye ga rad+dhā lo kā 1ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas rtsed mo'i bde ba thams cad dbul te/oṃ sarba 6ta thā ga ta hā gya lā gya kṛ 7ḍa ra ti sau khya a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra sga ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas 8gos kyi mchod pa rnams dbul te/ oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta bo dh+yā 97lo ka ra ban+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya bcings te/ sems can thams cad kyi rkatshangs pa chen po'i gnas bzhi thob par gyur cig ces brjod la de dbul te/ oṃ sarba — ta thā ga ta tsa tu ra ma hā brah+ma bi ha ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ de nas rdo rje bsnyems pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/ sems can thams cad kyang byang chub kyi sems la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod nas de 1nadabul te/ oṃ sat+tha ta thā ga ta bo bye tsit+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa ⑩sa ma ye hūṃ/ sems can thams cad sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod la de dbul te/ oṃ sarba sata thā ga ta badz+red bha bā dā lan pā ra mi tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje sgeg mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /sems can thams cad tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod la de dbul te/ oṃ sarba dz+wata thā ga ta ma hā bo dha r+ya 1 ha ra shī la pā 1 ra mi tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje phreng ba ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /sems can thams cad bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod la de dbul 31—1432

te / oṃ sazla ta thā ga ta dhan+d+ra a ba bo dhi k+ṣan 1ti pā ra mi tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje glu mkhan ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /sems can thams cad 'khor ba yongs su khyaspong ba'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod la de dbul te/oṃ sarba 1ta thā ga ta san sā rā pā ④ri h+ye ka bīr+ya pā ra mi tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje gar 5 mkhan ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /sems can thams cad bsam gtan bzhi dang ldan zhing sems zhi bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ bdag gis ⑥bsam gtan sangs rgyas thams cad la dbul te/ oṃ sarba ②ta thā ga ta sau khya bi hā ra r+ya 8sna na pā ra mi tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje me tog ma'i phyag rgya'o rte/ /sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs par khong du chud pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces brjod la/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa'i phyir de dran par bya ste/ oṃ sarba ⑫ta thā ga ta kle shats+tsha da sa man+ta pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje bdug pa ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /bdag nyid 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi tshad dang mnyam par bsams la btud par bya ste/ oṃ sarba 11ta thā ga ta kā ya nit+yā ta na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i lce bsams la bstod pas mchod pa bya ste/ oṃ sarba tso ta thā ga ta bāka pra brta na pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ bsod nams de rnams bsdus la sems can thams cad la nye bar bsngo bar bya ste/ oṃ san+d+ra ta thā 31—1433

ga ta tsit+ta nit+yā ta na 3pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ mchod pa nyi shu sdogs so / / 7de ltar mchod pa byas nas dam tshig dang sdom pa blang bar bya ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung 5ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges byas pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi / /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom ri pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni babe+eb pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan par gzung 5bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng hūṃnas brtsams te gzung 7bar bgyi//nam du yang ni mi spong trīngo / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du gzung 97bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dam pa la/ /phyi nang 1 gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung / bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgye/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed nas ni/ /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung nga/ /ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs 37byed/ 34

dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das gzhag bgye/ /sdom pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyes༄1/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya ni/ /cho ga bzhin bcings zhugs nas kyang / / sgo ṭa'i 2phyag rgyas dbab par bgye/ /de la dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ zla ba lta bu'i lag gnyis kyi/ /gung mo btang bar gyur pa yi/ /mje bo mthe'u —chung so sor bsgreng / /sems dpa'i rdo rje rdo rje bsgreng / /shar phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje lcags kyu'i phyag rgya 5bcings la/ gsang sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /badz+ra e ku sha dza6ཿ/ lho phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje zhags pas bsgul bar bya ste/ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ nub phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog rjes su dran par bya ste/ badz+ra sgo ṭa baṃ/ byang phyogs kyi sgor rdo rje dril bu brjod par bya ste/ badz+ra ā be sha 7aḥ/ rdo rje 'bebs pa rjes su dran pas bskor ba lan gsum bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hūm̐/ rdo rje sems ma'i snying po ni/ sa ma ya ste oṃ sa ma ya hūṃ/ snying po 'dis sbyin sreg gi khang par rtag tu 'jug par bya'o/ /oṃ sa ma ya pra be sha ya mi hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma sgo ṭa a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa ba a/ gsang sngags 'di dang / rdo rje sems ma'i 8phyag rgya bcing ba sbyar ba byas la / ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /a zhes bya ba lan brgya bzlas na bab 7par 'gyur ro/ /theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa yang ci 'dod par bzlas par bya'o/ /gsol ba btab la/ phyag rgya de snying gar babyungs nas/ snying po 'dis dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ rnyo me bha ba/su tostso me bha ba/ shā shwa to me bha ba/ a nu rasto me bha ba/ su pokhyo me bha ba/j-i 1 da ya me a bye tiṣ+ṭha sarba sedhim+bi pra yats+tsha/ sarba kadz+re su tsa me tsi: gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ de nas phreng ba de thab khung du snying po 'dis dor bar bya'o/ /31—/435

oṃ pra tī stits+tsha badz+ra hoḥde nas phreng ba de rang gi mgo la snying po 'dis bcing bar bya'o—/ /pra tī kṛṇ+ḍa swā dzumi saṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ de nas snying po 'dis rang gi gdong g.yogs dgrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa swa yi te rgya/ tsagru ut+ta ṭa na ta dha ba khyer/ ugho ṭa ya te gesat+tha khyo badz+ra tsak+ṣu ra a nut+ta ra ma he badz+ra pā sh+ya de nas rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa'i spos chu dang / snyeng po 'dis bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca/ de nas rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi phyag rgya rnams kyis bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la de rnams kyi phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/mthe bo gnyis ni bsnol nas ni/ /mdzub mo ⑤rtse mo bkug nas ni/ /gung mo mnyam gyepa'i tshigs su sbyar/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mor bshad/ /de nyid gung mo rdo rjer bya/ /gung mo gnyis ni ⑦nor bur bya/ /pad+mo srin lag mthe'u chung gung / /lag pa'i sor mo rab tu brkyang / /de la de rnams kyi rig pa ni 'di yin te/ oṃ badz+ra dh+wa ti shwa zuri hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra badzi ni spu/hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na badzi ni mihūṃ/ oṃ dhadz+re badz+re ni (lngahūṃ/ oṃ karma badz+re ni ⑫hūṃ/ de nas rang gi rdo rje lag tu bzhag nas/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod ni bskur ⑫bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun du rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis long / /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti two/a bhi ṣilnga ⑩mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya ste/ de nas snying po 'dis rdo rje ⑩ming gi dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa two ma hā skya.a bhi ṣiñca rmā badz+ra na 7ma a bhe ṣe ka ta he badz+ra nā ma/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub rdo rje'i brtul zhugs blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams 31—1436

cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang //phyag na rdo rje'i 4brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba tso7ta thā ga ta sidhi rngubadz+ra sa ma ya nyiṣ+ṭha e ṣa ④two dha ra yā mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ bdag la byin gyis brlab khyal sogs/ /ji lta bar ni bka' nod do/ /de ltar bgyis nas bdag ming brjod/ /de nas rdo rje ( snabasgrub par bgyi/ /zhes gang gsungs pa de slar yang bshad pa de dag yin no/ /rdo rje slob dpon sems dpa' yi/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bcings nas ni/ /se gol mang po brdab bgyes la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdu bar bgyi/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ snying po 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na/ des sangs rgyas thams cad sras dang bcas pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs par 'gyur na/ gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom byed cing / /ming brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig rab tu brjod par bgyi/ /de nas sgo rnams thams cad du/ /lcags kyu la sogs las bgyis nas/ /las chen mchog gi rnguphyag rgya yin༄nya/ /dam tshig rnams ni gzhug par bgyi/ /dam tshig mchog gi phyag rgya dang / /sems dpa' rdo rje la sogs pas9sna/ /de ltar sems dpa' chen po bsgrub/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes brjod cing / de nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa/ /sems dpa' chen po kun bsdu bar/ /spyan drangs nas ni rab tu bcug /bcings ⑫nas de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod pas mnyes bkyis la/ /thams cad don kun 'grub pa'i phyir/ /thams cad mdzod ces gsol ba bgyi/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi yo byad thams cad rdo rje'i rtse mo'i sngags kyis bsangs la g.yas phyogs 31—1437

su gzhag go/ /mchod yon gyi snod ni g.yon du bzhag nas/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lkuye shes kyi ngo bo nyid kyi gsang sngags ni thu 'dis dgang blugs gsum dbul lo/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la asne ga/pra dīp+ta ā kaste ya san+d+ra ta thā ga ta thum hā sa ma ya badz+ra hūṃ dzaḥde nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad thab kyi dbus su ji lta ba bzhin du 5bsgoms la/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bcings nas/ til gye sreg blugs dbul lo/ /yam shing dmar po rnams kyi me/ /rab sbar rdo rje khro bo yi/ /mnyam par gzhag par snyems zhugs par/ /til bsregs 4 pas ni sdig bsregs shing / /gsang sngags ni 'dis bya ste/ oṃ sat+tha pā paṃ da ha na badzā ya swā hā/ khyem rgyas par 'dod pas bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan thab kyi dbus su bsgoms la/ mar gyi dgang drugs gsum dbul lo/ /yam shing de dag nyid kyis ni/ /me ni rab tu sbar nas kyang / /rtag tu 'bras ni sreg byas na7/ /gdon mi za bar khyem rgyas 8'gyur/ /gsang sngags ni 'dis bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra pubye 9ye swā hā/ de nas tshe ring bar 'dod pas/bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa thab kyi dbus su bsams la mar gyi dgang ⑫blugs gsum dbul lo/ /yam shing dmar po rnams kyis kyang / /mkhas pas rtag tu me sbar te/ /drur ba'i myu gu mar bcas pas/ /sbyin sreg byas na tshe 'phel 'gyur/ /gsang sngags ni 'dis bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu 1 ṣe swā hā / de nas bdag gam gzhan rnams bsrung bar 'dod pas/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa thab kyi dbus su bsgoms la/ til mar gyi dgangs ⑫ blugs gsum dbul lo/ /yam shing de dag nyid kyis ni/ /me ni rab tu sbar 31byed/ /38

byas 4la/ /ku sha'i yal ga 'bru mar byus/ /sbyin sreg byas na 3nges par bsrung / /gsang sngags ni 'dis bya ste/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzā ya swā hā/ de nas rang gi lha thab kyi dbus su bsams la til dang 'bras dang mar dang drur 5ba dang til mar dang / ku sha'i myu gu la sogs pa dbul ba dang / dgang blugs dang po dang rdzogs khar dbul bar bya'o/ /zhi ba phal cher srod la bya'o/ /rgyas pa snga dro bya ba yin/ /mngon spyod nyi ma gung la ste/ /sgrub pa pos ni mdor bsdus pa'o/ /zhi la kha dog dkar po ste/ /rgyas la ser por ④snang ba yin/ /rjes su chags la kha dog dmar/ /mngon spyod la ni sngo dang gnag /de'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma ni 'di dag yin te/ rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dgu tredang / /rin chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan 'dzum/ /pad+ma ral gri 'khor lo gzung 6 / /las dang go cha 'jigs byed bcang dza/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dang / /drur ༄ —ba dang dri'i mtshan mar gyur pa rnams te de rnam par spumathong nas/ dgang blugs phul la sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi 7lha rnams tshim par byas nas bya ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /de bas na nus pa med pas kyang ci nus pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /nus pa med pa'i phyir brjod par bya ste/ rang gi khang pa'i byang shar gyi phyogs su thab khung zur bzhi'am / zlum por khru gang tsam la zabs su mtho gang tsam brkos te thab kyi dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa sor brgyad pa'i tshad la dpangs su sor bzhi pa bzhag thab kyi ngos la dpangs su sor bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir rdo rjes mtshan par hūṃ bya'o/ /de la phyag rgya mdor basbus pa ni 'di yin te/ thal mo dam du sbyar ba las /sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi12/ /rdo 37—1439

rje thal mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje 'chang chen po la sogs pa'i phyag rgya yang dam tshig gi 1phyag rgya'i rim pa rnams nye bar bstan te/ rdo rje bcing bas phyag rgya thams cad bcing ngo / /rdo rje thal mo'i phyag rgya de nyid bcings nas/ rab tu bsdams pa ni rdo rje bsdams pa ste snying gar dgrol lo/ /badz+ra bhan+dha traṭa/ de nas phyag rgya thams cad bcings la rang la byin gyis brlab pa nas ji srid rdo rje rjes su dran pa dang dgug pa la sogs pa bsgrub mipa'i bye brag rnams rang gi lus dang ngag yid rdo rje la dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcing ba dang /dbang du byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i phyag rgya bcings la snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /a rdo rje khu tshur gyis mdzub mo sbyar ba ni rdo rje 'be+ebs pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas zhugs jenas rang la byin gyis brlab 5pa nas ji srid sgrub pa'i khyad par gyis mdza' bo nyid du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dam tshig chen po'i sems dpa' rjes su dran la/ snying po 'di brjod par bya'o/ /sa ma ya satwa haṃ/ 'dis ni rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgyas dam tshig chen po'i sems dpa' dang gcig tu gyur pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya thams cad kyi cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /de nas thun mong gi sgrub pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni 'di yin te/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig sems dpa' chen po de nyid rang gi lus la brten cing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la bzhugs shing 6/ rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i sgu bdag nyid du snying po 'dis bsgom par bya'o/ /sa ma ya 7haṃ/ de nas rang gi phyag rgya'i sems dpar bdag nyid rnam par bsams la sngags 'dis der byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /sa ma ya satwa a bye tiṣ+ṭha swa rmā/ de nas rang gi lha snga ma bzhin du thab kyi dbus 37byed17 40

su bsams la sbyin sreg ji lta ba bzhin du bya ste/ mchod nas snying po 'dis gshegs su 3gsol lo/ /badz+ra muḥde nas rang gi snying ga las byung ba'i rdo rje rin chen gyi ga phyag rgya rang gi dbang bskur ba'i gnas na gnas pas 1dbang bskur la mdzub mo gnyis kyi phreng ba bcings shing thude bzhin du snying po 'dis bcing bar 3bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca saza mu dra mi tri rti 6ku ru ba ra ka pa tse na baṃ/ rin chen sems ma'i phyag rgya ni 'di yin te/ rin chen rdo rje las mje bo mnyam ste 3mdzub mo bkug pa dang rtse sbyar ba'o/ /de ma/sa yang go cha'i mthar phreng ba bcing ba de bkrol la snying po 'di dang mnyam pa'i thal mos mnyes par bya'o/ /badz+ra tu 6 hoḥ— —/ go cha 'dis phyag rgya dgrol ba dang /dbang bskur ba spyobacing zhing mnyes par bya ba'am/ rdo rje sems dpas kyang rdo rje nyid du nye bar dgrol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa brjod la/gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhi bya'o/ /rdo rje 'gying ba'i tshul gyis su/ /bsam —pa g.yos pas gdung bar bya/ /phreng ba bcing dang kha nas byung / /rdo rje gar ni bskor ba yin/ /rdo rje khu tshur spyor ba yis/ /spos la sogs pa de bzhin dbul / /thur du blugs dang gyen du gtor/ /bskor dang de bzhin byug pa'o//badz+ra lā gye/ badz+ra mā le/ badz+ra gī skruti/ badz+ra dṛ h+ye/ badz+ra dhū 1 pe/ badz+ra puste / badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gadhe/ rdo rje bstod pa'i glu ni 'di yin te/oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra haṃd+ku / badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta re/ badz+ra dhan+d+ra gā ya ṣ+pemu/ badz+ra ka1 ka rosgo be+e / rdo rje bstod 7pa'i glu 'di dang glu blangs la/ lag pa'i rtse mos gar byas nas/ /mchod pa thams cad bya'o/ /rab dang 'bad pas khrus byas te/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg khang par zhugs / /zhes /naji skad du bshad pa de 37byed1 41

ma smras so zhe na/ de brjod par bya ste/ rnam rtog khrus kyi sbyor ba 'di/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis bshad pa/ /de ni rnam rtog tsam yin 1pas/ /de la blo ni 'jug mi bya/ /de bas sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /legs byas khrus ni bshad par bya/ /rnam rtog la ni spyod bzhin du/ /gang gi bgegs ni mi 'jug pa'o/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs so/ /khro bo ti rīje du ri'i phyag rgya bcings la snying gar bzhag ste/ lus 'bar ba'i gsang sngags bzla'o/ /oṃ ku pi ku pi kā ya ku pi pra dz+wa la ni swā hā/ de nas cho ga 'di dang / dang po'i yi ge'i go chas go bgo ste rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ snying gar mdzub mo gnyis kyis mdud pa byas la rgyab tu drangs te mdud pa bya slar yang snying gar drangs te mdud pa bya/ de bzhin du 1sgog ma'i steng du mdud pa ngabya ba dang /dpral bar mdud pa bya ba dang ltag par mdud pa byas nas/ rna ba gnyis kyi gong du mtha' nas dgrol bas dar dpyangs bya ste/ mnyam pa'i thal mos mnyes par bya'o/ /de la gsang sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ tsu rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis gdug pa thams cad bza' bar bya zhing / mche ba'i phyag rgya bcings la/gsang sngags brjod par bya'o/ /hūṃ de nas bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi gsang sngags brjod de/ a bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi phyag rgya ni rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas gsang sngags 'dis chu snyim pa gsum gyen du gtor bar bya'o/ /oṃ bhur dz+wa la hūṃ swā hā/ rig sngags 'dis cha gsum du bya ste/ gcig gis ni dge ba'i gtsang sbra bya'o/ /gnyis pas lus kyi gtsang sbra bya'o/ /gsum pas ni khrus dang nye reg bya zhing / rang gi mgor rang gi gsang sngags dang phyag rgyas chu gtor na/rang gi rnam par rtog pa las skyes pa'i bgegs mi 'byung ste/ sems can 'tshe 31—1442

ba'am sdig pa dag khyed la med kyi snam 'jigs shig /rig thupa las byung dge ba bzhin/ /bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung / /khrus byas nas ni sbyin sreg gi/ /cho ga thams cad spyad par bya'o/ /de nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcings te/ snying po 'dis gyen du dgrol lo/ /oṃ khyed kyis 'gro ba'i don kun mdzad/ /dngos grub ji bzhin gsol lags kyis/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra satwa muḥ/ de nas thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems chen po rjes su dran la/ ci bde bar gnas par snyebya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ming tsam zhig /lan cig yongs su gzung thubs kyang / /'di ni bsrung ba dam pa ste/ /mi zad rtag pa'i dngos grub ster/ /mkhas pa ngang pa'i rgyal pos rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ /'dir ni sbyin sreg cho ga bris pas dge ba gang bsags pa/ /des ni srid gsum tsher ma 'byin cing zhi bzhi rtog ldan pa/ /rgyal ba lnga yi cod pan 'dzin dang 'gro ba rjes su mnyam par shog /kun du bzang po 5zhes bya ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rdzogs so// //31byed14 /3

༄ga /rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga rab gnas kyi rgyal po bzhugs/ 1༄go/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal te/ /rgyud rnams thams cad las bsdus te/ /rab gnas cho ga bshad par bya/ /de la dang por spre re zhig rnal 'byor pa dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang thob pa/ rig pa'i sdom pa gzung ba/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'i 4bya ba shes pa/ dpa' la 5brtan pa spro ba che ba/ dul ba phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i spyod pa dang ldan pa/gsang ba'i ye shes bslabs 6pa/ phyag rgya bzhi bsgom par mos pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang / sgrub pa'i grogs po byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ gsang ba'i cho ga'i bya ba shes pa/ gtsang ma/ gsang ba'i bya ba la mkhas pa/ blo dang ldan pa dang / snying stobs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ grong khyer ram grong rdal lam / nags tshal lam/ ljongs sam/ kun dga' ra ba'am/ gtsug 31—1 /47

lag khang du lugs su blugs pa'am/ 'bur du brkos pa'am/ ri mor bris pa zhi ba'am/ dbang ngam rgyas pa'am/ mngon spyod la sogs pa'i sku rab tu gnas pa byed par 'dod na/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i nyunye 'khor du dris nye bar byugs nas dkon mchog gsum dang / rab tu gnas par byed pa'i lha dang / rdo rje slob dpon la dmigs te/ maṇ+ḍal lnga byas nas mchod pa lnga bshams nas stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs bgos nas cod pan dang rgyan btags te/ phreng ba dang dag byed dang ldan pas/ skar ma rgyal dang gza' phur bu'i nyin par khrus byas shing zas dkar gsum zos pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang dril bu rnams bris te/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs pa dang / yungs kar gyes bgegs bzlog nas bsnyen chopa dang / de la re zhig rnam par rtog pa shas chung na/ stong pa nyid kyis pekhrus bya ba/ lce byin gyis brlab pa dang / lag pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / khro bo bzhi'i lus bskyed pa dang / khro bo gsum gyis bgegs bsal ba dang / khro bo drug gis phyogs bcing ba dang / khro bo gsum gyis ra ba dang dra ba byas la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ rdo rje 'khor los dkyil 'khor sprul la/ mchod pa dang phyag btsal ba dang / sdig pa bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / mchod pa'i sprin dang lus dbul ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo 6ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / sdom pa gzung ༄)ba dang / gzugs brnyan gyi lhar bskyed nas de7mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / rdo rje thal mo dang /she rdo rje bsdams skrupa dang / bsdams pa dral /nyub dang / ye 31byed1448

shes dbab pa dang / dbab pa nye bar bsdu ba dang / ngan song dgug cing sdig pa 37dral ba dang / dkyil 'khor snying gar bsdu ba dang / mngon par byang chub ni lngas lhar bskyed la/ byen gyes brlab pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bsgom pa dang / snying gar dbang bskur ba dang / phrin las kyi rdo rje'i 4brtul zhugs blang ba dang / rnal 'byor chen po bskyed pa dang / rjes su rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pa'i khams gzhug 3pa dang / byen gyis brlab pa dang /dbang bskur ba dang / mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ bdag nyid thabs kyi 'khor lo rdzogs par byas la/ ye shes kyi sa sbyong ba stong pa nyid bsgoms ltepa dang / rdo rje'i sa sbyang ga ba 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed pa dang / 'chi ba'i srid pa ri rab kyi rtse mor lus gzhag pa dang / srid pa bar ma do bsam gtan gzugs med pa bsgom pa dang /skye ba'i rnal 'byor byang chub sems dpa' don grub tu bskyed pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin las bslangs 9nas dang po'i spyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog dang / las rgyal mchog bsgoms la/ ye shes sems dpa' zhugs 7pa'i las brgyad kyi 1 ye shes sems dpa' bcug la/ rgyas btab nas dbang bsgur ba dang / mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod la/ ji lta ba bzhin du bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar mtshan ma ma thob kyi bar du bsgom pa'am/ gtso bo la 'bum dang / 'khor rnams la khri khye bzlas pa dbul ba dang / rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma bzhin du/ zla ba bzhi 'am zla ba drug tu bsnyen pa bya'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa byas nas sa sbyang ba'am/ ma sbyangs pa'i gnas sa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du byas te/ lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de la mchod pa bsham pa 31byed/7 49

dang / rdzas bsags la 1rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan la gdong dri zhim par byas la/ me tog gi phreng ba btags te/ rgyu skar rgyal gyi zhag dang gza' phur bu la srung 2ba'i 'khor lo rten dang bcas pa dang / tshogs sogs pa'i dmigs pa'i yul dang bcas pa dang / tshogs kyi lam dngos sems bskyed pa dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje dbab pa cho ga bzhin du bya ba dang / phyag rgya chen po cho ga bzhin du bcing ba dang / mdun du sems dpa' cho ga bzhin du bskyed de bdag nyid rdzogs par byas nas/ 'byung ba ri rab dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i steng du sa'i lha mo spyan drangs la/ cho ga bzhin du de nas dpang du gsol te ji ltar bzhin du spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi ༄ ting nge 'dzin mngon sum 4du byas nas/ 'og min du don grub kyi gzugs su skyes par bsams la/ phyogs bcu'i sasangs rgyas thams cad spyan drang bar bya'o/ /de nas dang por spyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang / las rgyal mchog bsgoms la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs sogs pa'i cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du byas nas/ sgrub pa'i grogs kyis mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas gsol ba btab la/ bdag nyid 'khor los 6sgyur ba'i ched 7du brjod par bya ste / dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la khro bo'i bstod pa dang / bgegs la bka' bsgo ba byas nas/ rdo rje'i lta bas ra ba dang / dra ba byas nas/ stang stabs kyis bgegs bsal ba dang / sngags dang phyag rgyas srung ba'i 'khor lo 9byas la/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bkug nas/ de'i yan lag phur bu ji lta ba bzhin du btab nas/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis —bgegs bsal la dri'i thig le dang me tog tshom bu bkod la/ lha lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /de nas 37—1 /50

bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang / sbyin sreg lhag par gnas pa dang / gtor ma lhag par gnas pa ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas shing bu gru gsum kyi nang du kham phor bzhag nas/ der me drugs la zur gsum du bag zan gyes kong 1bu gsum byas te/ der me mar btang nas bag zan gyi chang pa gsum byas nas/rdo rje gtsug tor gyi sngags sam/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags kyis yungs kar gyis bgegs bzlog par bya'o/ /sgu gzugs sam glegs bam la sogs pa rab gnas gang byed pa de ras kyis g.yogs la/ hūṃ rgyu 2s+thāḥgasum gyes bsrungs nas gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /dga' ldan du rgo bzhugs pa na/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan 'dir bzhugs shig /'di ru mgon po brtan bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /che ge mo yi don slad du/ /bdag ni 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yis mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin brlab cing / /de nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /de nas nyi ma shar ba na dkyil 'khor gyi thig btab la/ tshon dgye zhing lha dgod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga las bshad pa bzhin byas la/ rdzas bsags nas dkyil 'khor gyi mthar bkram ste5/ lhag pa dang ma tshang ba bskang 6la/ bum pa gzhug par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su khrus kyi khang pa yid du 'ong ba/ shel gyi sa gzhi la rin po che'i ka bas brgyan pa/ mu tig dang rin po ches spras pa brtsigs pa'am bris la/ rab tu gnas pa byed par 'dod pas/ thog mar khrus kyi 37—/ 5/

khang pa der lha spyan drangs la/ khri'i steng du gzhag pa'am/ ras ris puste la sogs pa yin na mdun du bzhag la/ me long bstan la bum pa rnams kyis sku khrus gsol ba bstod dbyangs dang bcas pa bya ste/ de la bstod dbyangs ni/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta tsasnas ma ya shri 3ye hūṃ/ de nas/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i/ lha yi sku la gnas gsum du/ yi ge oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ gser dngul lam zangs las byas pa bum pa lto ba yangs pa mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba/ sman dang 'bru dang rin po che lnga dang ldan pa/ ras sar pas mgul pa dz+wabacings pa/ ldu bcas lcug mas kha brgyan la/ sngar bsnyen nga byas pa'i dri'i chus gang ba slob dpon gyis yongs su bzung nas/ me long dri'i thig le lnga dang / nyil mar thigs pa lnga dang /me tog gi tshom bu lnga dang / 'dag chal dang bcas pa'i pir gyis sbyangs la/bkra shis kyi 5tshigs su bcad pa dang / rdza rnga la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas sgu khrus gsol bar bya'o/ /de la til mar gyi sngags ni/ oṃ saza thuta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ dri'i sngags ni/ garnya ma la ya swā hā/drur ba'i pir gyi 7sngags ni/ oṃ ma lā saṃ sho dha ṣ+pe swā hā/ de nas sku khrus gsol ba'i bstod dbyangs ni/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan sku yi khrus gsol lo/ /tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal spyong byed pa'i / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan yon tan dbang 37—17 52

bskur ro/ /'du shes phung po rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa'i/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ /'du byed phung po rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa//bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan phrin las dbang bskur ro/ /rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang spyong byed pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /ji ltar dam pa tog dkar dga' ldan nas/ /lha mdzes lhums nas bltams la khrus gsol ltar/ /sku gdung ring bsrel dri ma rnged par bcas/ /sprul sku yid 'ong rnams la khrus gsol lo/ /zhes bya ba dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta su na su pra tiṣ+ṭha tshoswā hā/ zhes bya bas sran phye dang / bag phye'i chal dang / yung ba dang /'bras yos dang / til mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / 'o ma dang / gan+dha bha dra 3dang bcas pa sku gzugs nyid dam/ me long gi steng du btab la/ tsan+dan dang ga bur gyi dri'i thig le byas la/ me tog dang bcas pa la ku sha'i pir gyis bkru bar bya'o/ /de ltar sgu la sogs pa lan gsum mam lnga lngar bkrus nas/gos gtsang ma'i dris bsgos 4pas sku phyis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu gzugs rnams la ni/ bla gos dang snam sbyar gsol bar bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gos sna tshogs pa dang / khro bo rnams la ni gos sngon po dang / dmar po dbul zhing bkra shis kyi satshigs su bcad pa khugadon par bya'o//de la snam sbyar gsol ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ dī 7ba pra ba ye swā hā/ de la dri dbul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra gadhe swā hā/ de la byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa la rgyan dbul ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ ā ba ra ṇa bi zu ṣa ṣ+pe 8swā hā/ de 31—1 153

nas dkyil 'khor chen po spyan drangs la gtsug lag khang yin na mdun nam phyogs su ma yo zhing drang bar sku gzugs mdzes par bkod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo dang bcas pa mdun sna der bstan la dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas bdag dang gtso bo dang tha mi dad par bsgoms la sgo dza bya'o/ /de ltar bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor/ pū dza rdzogs pa'i rjes la rab gnas kyi lha la pū dza lnga phul nas dam tshig sems dpa' yi ge hūṃ gis bsal 3bar byas la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te rgyud las 'byung ba'i phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab la dbang bsgur nas dngos su 'byor pa'i pū dza lnga dang / yid kyis sprul pa brgyad dang / rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par bya'o/ /de la me tog dbul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa mchog 'di dag /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyis ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra puste āsneḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar byung ba'i/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i bdug pa 'di/ /mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis ci bder bzhes 4su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra dhū mupe āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar byung ba'i/ /lha dang mi yi dri mchog 'di/ /mchog tu dang bas 'bul lags na/ /ci bder 6bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra gadhe 7āḥhūṃ/bza' dang bca' ba phun tshogs pa'i/ /kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /thams cad 'byor pa'i zhal zas 'di/ /bdag gis 8'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe bibye 9āḥhūṃ/ sgeg mo la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na/ / ⑫rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pas/ /rdo rje las rnams byed par shog /ces brjod cing / badz+ra 37byed/ /54

satwa su saṃ gra ha ta/ ces kyepa la sogs pa glu blang bar 2bya'o/ /rdo rje dbyangs 1kyi las kyi dkyil 'khor nas byung snyeba'i rig ma bcu drug gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas kyang mchod par bya'o/ /de nas gzugs rin chen sna bdun dang / dpag bsam gyi shing dang / bum pa bzang po dang / 'dod 'jo'i ba dang / bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang / sgra rol mo cha byad bcu dang /dri'i snod brgya'am stong ngam/ ro'i snod brgya'am stong ngam/ reg bya ras zung brgya'am 5stong ngam/ tha ma yang spyir zung gcig dbul lo/ /de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis mchod la/ sbyin sreg dang gtor ma byas la/nyin mo nyal nas/ phyi de nang par nyi ma shar kar spyan dbye bar bya ste/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba rnams kyi spyan/ /sems can don du dbye bar bgyi/ /oṃ tsak+ṣu tsagru sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ni /6swā hā/ zhes bya bas gser la sogs pa'i thur mas spyan dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas snyan dbye bar bya ste/ gser la sogs pa'i rna 'bru thogs la/ 'gro rnams thos pas phongs gyur pa/ /rgyal bas chos kyi rnga brdungs ltar/ /de bzhin sems can don gyi phyir/ /rgyal ba'i snyan ni dbye bar bgye/ /oṃ dī 7bya kar+ṇa ye swā hā/ de nas shangs dbye bar bya ste/ gser la sogs pa'i smang tsher thogs te/ zag bcas phung po dri spangs pa'i/ /'gro ba'i sems can don bgyid phyir/ /rnam par dag pa dri brnyes ༷ltar/ /rgyal ba'i shangs ni dbye bar bya/ / dī bya gha 9 ṇa ye swā hā/ de nas thur ma thogs la zhal dbye bar bya ste/ 'gro ba thams cad tshim mdzad ltar/ /ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas dam pa 'di/ /dbul zhing zhi ba'i zhal ni dbye bar bya/ /oṃ 37—1 55

di bya mo snakha ye swā hā/ de nas spu gri thogs la/ rab tu byung ba'i gzugs yin na/ /skra bzhar ba ltar byas te/ ji ltar rang byung mchod rten drung / /ston pas khyem pa'i rtags spangs ltar/ /'gro ba sems can don gyi phyir/ /khyim pa'i rtags rnams spang bar bya/ /snam sbyar dang / sham thabs dang /bla gos gsol nas/ ji ltar sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed kyis/ /rgyal ba'i sku la na bza' gsol ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro ba rnams la phan bya'i phyir/ /ngo tsha khrel yod gos mchog gsol bar bgyi/ /oṃ di bya basbra ṇa rnguye swā hā/ chu tshags dang / lhung bzed thogs la/ oṃ i mu yu ga sa pa ri /༄kyika ra ye swā hā/de nas thugs kar rdo rje bzung la/ mtshan dang dpe byad la sogs bskyed pa'i phyir / /dung dang dpal be+e'u g.yung drung 'khyel ba dang / /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis rnam brgyan pa/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la rnam par brgyan par shog/oṃ dwa tro sha da ma hā pu ru ṣa la k+ṣa ṇi shi ti a nu byañca nā ya 4swā hā/ po ti dang glegs bam yin na yi ge āḥdīḥ5las rdo rje chos sam snang ba mtha' yas kyi skur bskyed pa'am/ yang na yi ge rja 6las yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'am/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyag rgya 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na bgrang phreng /g.yon gye gnyis pa na pad+ma'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bsnams pa bskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas rgyas btab ste/dbang bskur nas mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod la/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyis 7na bza' gsol te/ rgya rim pa bdun gyes gdab ste yig 'bru'i rang bzhin du zhu bar bsam mo/ /de la na bza' dbul ba'i sngags ni/ di 37—/456

bya bsnga /nyuye swā hā/ na bza'i steng du mdud pa btab la/ spra tshil las sin dhu ra'i rgyas btab la/ oṃ badz+ra mu dra ban+dha 4ya a bye tiṣ+ṭha swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /na bza' dbul ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni/ byang chub yan lag rnam dag pa'i/ /dam chos gsung gi 'od zer gyis/ /na bza' dri ma med pa 'di/ /dam pa'i chos la dbul bar bya/ /zhes brjod de/ mchod rten yin na/ rigs rnam pa lnga'i sprul pa'i skur snyebaskyed la/ ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas/ rgyas btab cing dbang bskur nas/ mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod la / mthar mchod rten gyi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ oṃ ā thur dze bi ra dze swā hā/ zhes bya bas sa dkar gsol lo/ /oṃ ha ra ma thuye swā hā/ zhes bya bas bye gzugs par bya'o/ /tsakra thub ra tsa ta nā 7ye swā hā/ zhes pas 'khor lo gzugs pa dang / oṃ ts+tsha 3tram̐ ye swā hā/ zhes gdugs gzugs (pa dang / oṃ rku bhi ra dh+wa dza khuye swā hā/ zhes pas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan gzugs pa dang / oṃ pa tai ka 11ye swā hā/ zhes pas ba dan gzugs pa dang / oṃ pa ṭa lo bha ༄ rtaye swā hā/zhes bya bas dar dpyangs bcings nyu/pa dang / oṃ pube+e mā la miye swā hā/ zhes bya bas me tog gi phreng ba gdags pa dang / oṃ tsā ma ra yiya swā hā/ zhes pas rnga yab kyis ⑩g.yab par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i cha lugs yin na so mangs dang / khab dang / snyung bu dang / gri dang / chu gri rnams phul la/'gro ba sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la bslab bya zhes / /ji ltar thugs dam rgya che bzhes pa bzhin/ /'khor —ba'i yo byad rnams ni dbul bar bya/ /oṃ a nyu5pa yu ka sa pa ri ka ༄ ra ye swā hā/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' ge thun mong du rin po che sna 31—1 457

bdun dang / bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang / 'jig rten pa la bkra shis pa'i bil ba dang / starga dang / zho dang / ras yug dkar po dang / gdugs gser gyi yu ba can rnams dbul bar bya ste/ dang por las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs la dri'i thig le dang / me tog gi tshom bu bkod nas/ ji ltar mi dbang 'khor los tshosnasgyur ba yis/ /rin chen sna bdun tshogs dang bcas pa ltar / /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la/ /rin chen sna bdun tshogs ni dbul bar bya/ /lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bgyes/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi —/ /'jig rten khyim bdag rnams kyis —dpal rnyed na/ /bil ba starga bum pa bzang dang bcas / /mdun du bdar 4nas bkra shis byed pa ltar/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul par bgyi/ /de nas 'byor pa yod na sbyin sreg bya'o/ /med na sgyed pu dkar po gsum btsugs la/ /sa las byas pa'i snod gtsang marathu/ /dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum gyi gzhi la sman sna tshogs btab ste/ sbyin sreg gi me'am/ rig pa'i me la yi ge brgya pa zlos shing bskol bar bya'o/ /de nas tsā ru dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams dang / /gang dag cho ga ma tshang ba/ /de dag bzod pa mdzad par rigs/ /kun du zhi dang rgyas dang ni/ /yon bdag tshe la rab mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon 6par mdzad du gsol/ /sa dang chu dang me rlung gis/ /ji srid bskal par 7'jig bar du/ /lha rnams kun gyi sku 31—1458

gzugs sdertel/ /de srid bcom ldan bsrung bar mdzod/ /thugs bzang 2dgyes par gyur pa yis1/ /slob dpon slob mar bcas pa yi/ /bu dang tsha bo bsrung mdzad nas/ /rang gnas dge bar gshegs su gsol/ /de nas dam tshig sems dpa' rang la bsdu'o/ /de nas yon bdag dang slob dpon gnyis kas sku'i gdan khri nas bzung nas me tog gi phreng ba phul te/ ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung gis bskal pa 'jig bar du/ /sems can kun kyi don gyi phyir / /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /de nas phyogs skyong ngam/ma hā kā la dang / yul gyi bgegs la gtor ma byin la/ 'gro ba sems can don slad du/ /bde 4gshegs rnams ni bzhugs kyi bar/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir/ /sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan bsrung bar mdzod/ /ces bya ba dang / bcom ldan 'das 5phyag na rdo rje la yang mchod pa phul la/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sgu/ bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pas ji srid bcom ldan 9bzhugs kyi bar du srung 7bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod pa dang / rab tu bsrung ba'i gnas brtan dang / /khyim pa'i gtso bo rnams la yang / /snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi sprul pa'i sku ni 'di yin gyis/ 'di khyod kyis ma nyams par srungs 8snazhes brjod par byas 9la/ lugs ma'am/ ras ris sam/ puste yin na/ na bza' bzang pos drangs la/ shing rta la 1 bskyon nas dri'i zig le byas te/ 'gro ba rnams dad par bya ba'i phyir grong khyer rnams bskor bar bya'o / /yon gyi bdag po rnams kyang glu dang / gar dang / rgyan shā2gdags pa dang / bkra shis pa rnams bya'o / /de la rab gnas kyi dus ni/ dpyid zla ra ba'am 'bring po 'am/ zhes pa nas/ skye dang skye ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes 31byed/ 59

༄/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rdo rje thams cad 'drung ba jes bya ba'o don bsdus pa/she ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra dh+wa tu ma hā maṇ+ḍa la lo pi 2 ka sarba badz+red ya nā ma piṇ+ḍarja/ bod skad du/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga rdo rje thams cad 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i don bsdus pa/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi lus ngag yid dag rnam dag pas/ /bdud kyi 'tshe ba go skabs med mdzad cing / /bsod nams tshogs dang de bzhin ye shes te/ /de gnyis rab rdzogs rgyu dngos 'gro phan mdzad/ /skye ba gcig gis thogs dang srid mtha' ba/ /legs 'gro gede nas rang gi sems rtogs pa/ /sngon 'gro mngon par byang chub rim 3bzang pos/ /chos rgyal nyid brnyes byams pa la sogs phyir/ /dkyil 'khor sprul mdzad phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /rang gi rnam par thar pas yang dag par/ /'gro ba gdul phyir bsdus shing las la bzhag /rnam par 6khyab pa bsnyus pas rnam 'phrul 31—1 63

bstan / /de nas 'dzam bu'i rgyal mtshan mi rnams la/ /phan phyir ji bzhin cho ga bzang po yis/ /tshon gyi dkyil 'khor skyon med ston mdzad pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don phun sum gnas brnyes pa/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' rnam 1'dren pa/ /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang phyug bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'di ni go rims nges pa tsam/ /gtso bor bya la gzhol ba yisarngo / /dkyil 'khor cho ga mchog 'di yi/ /don bsdus bdag nyid dran phyir bri/ /gang du rnam par rmongs pa'i gnas/ /der ni tshig don 'ga' zhig brjod/ /gzhan du blo gros ngan pa rnams/ /sgra tsam la yang log par rtogs/ /deng sang — sngags kyi theg pa mchog /yi ge'i don gyis rnam dkrugs shing / /bla ma gcig nas gcig 'ongs pa'i/ /man ngag rim la gus dang bral/ /de phyir bla ma'i man ngag gis//'di yi snying po cung zad bri/ /'dir slob dpon gyi zhal snga nas/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi lugs kyis slob ma dbang bskur te/ tshe 'di nyid la dga' ba dang bde ba'i mchog gi mthar thug pa 'thob pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa gzigs nas/dkyil 'khor cho ga rgyas pa bsnyu ba bzhed pas/ phyag 'tshal dngos po thams cad kyis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher smos pa mdzad do/ /de la 'dir ci'i phyir phyag btsal zhe na/ bdag nyid dam pa'i spyad jepa can du bstan pa'i phyir dang / 'di'i bsgrub 5par bya ba dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la dang ba ni legs pa thams cad thob khyepa'i rgyu yin pas gzhan de la dang ba bskyed pa'i phyir dang / bgegs zhi bar bya ba'i yang phyir ro/ /de la phyag btsal ba ni 'dud pa ste skad kyi byings las de skad du bstan pas so/ /rab kyi sgra ni mchog tu gyur pa ste de yang lus dang ngag dang yid thams cad kyis gus pa nye bar gnas pas so/ /31—1464

de'i phyir dngos bo thams cad kyis zhes pa ste/ lus ngag yid thams cad kyis so—/ /gzhan dag 'dir rigs spyi dang khyad par gyi phyag 'tshal ba lnga ni dngos po thams cad kyis zhes zer na/ 'di slob dpon gyis 1rtede kho na ltar mdzad ces grub par mi nus pas btags pa tsam du zad do/ /su zhig la phyag 'tshal zhe na/ rdor sems khyab bdag chen po la/ /zhes pa ste/ rdo rje zab mo'i cha brjod pa ste/ 'dir bskal pa grangs med thu pa de snyed du spros pa'i tshogs bor te shin tu brtan pa dang / 'phel 'grib med par byas pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ni rdo rje ste/ dang po'i bye brag ma lus pa 'gegs pas nor bu rin po che rdo rje dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na/ bskal pa du mar rab goms byas pa yi/ /rgyu dang rigs pa'i tshul dang sa la mkhas/ /gang gis 'dus byas grong khyer rnam 'jig pa/ /ye shes rdo rje brtan de 'phags bdag sprul/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de yang glo bur ba'i dri ma rnams bsal ba kho nar zad kyi/rang gi ngo bo nyid thog ma nas rdo rje lta bu mi phyed pas na/ rab tu brtan zhing dus gsum ༄ mi 'gyur bar gnas pas sems dpa' ste/ sems dpa' sngon dang tha ma med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /'di ni rang 'byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu rab tu che geba'i lha/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o//de ltar thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i phyir/ /'di ni sems can gyi gnas skabs na yang brtan pa/ sems can kun gyi sems gang yin/ /rdo rje zhes ni bshad pa ste/ /brtan pa'i phyir na dpa' zhes brjod/ /ces gsungs shing / de nyid shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang de las lhag par ma gyur pas na/ rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes ni/ /de 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' ste//37byed/7165

brtan —1pa'i phyir na dpa' zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na 'di ni chos kyi —sku'i ngo bo can te/ bsgribs pa dang ma bsgribs pa'i dus dag tu yang rang gi bdag nyid la 'bri ba dang / 'phel ba spangs par (thu mi 'gyur ba ni/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung ste/ chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid de/ de bzhin du gnas pa'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar chos kyi sku'i dbang las gzugs kyi sku dpe med pa 'byung ba ni rgya che ba ste/ji skad du/ rgyal bas chos nyid lus med rab zhi ba/ /gnyis med rang bzhin med par thugs chud nas/ /gzugs sku bzang po mtshan gyis brgyan pa yis/ /'gro ba ma lus bkang zhing ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /de ltar de lta bur thams cad du khyab pa ni khyab bdag ste/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad du snang ba ston pas shin tu rgya cher gyur to/ /de ltar zab pa dang 3 rgya che ba 'di ni ji skad du/ mtshan yang dag par brjod thupa las/ mi 'gyur kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /zhes gsungs pas gsal por mdzad do/ /de lta bu ni byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa'i bkod pas kyang bsgrun )du med pas na chen po'i sgra yis bstan pa ste/ rang bzhin dang / las dang / rgyu dag che bas na 'di chen po yang yin la khyab bdag kyang yin pas na chen pos nyakhyab bdag go/ /de ltar zab pa dang rgya che ba'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal nas da 'dir ci zhig byed ce na/ dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad bya ste/ /rdo rje thams cad 'byung dge ba/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ 'di ni 'dir rtogs 6pa dang ldan pa dag 'jug pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa dgos pa dang thabs phul rngudu byung ba dag bstan te/ re zhig dang po nyid du 'di la brjod par bya ba khyad 31byed1466

par can med de/ sbyon pa'i tshig las dur khrod dang ri rtse nyams mi kyedaga' bar yul gyi bzang mo dang phrad pa med pa lta bu'o snyam du sems pa zhedagag pa'i phyir / dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad bya ste/ /zhes bya ba smos te/ 'di na sngags kyi theg pa 'di las dkyil 'khor ni rab tu grags pas khyab pa'i dngos po'i stobs goms shing skyes bu'i 'dod pa tsam gyis ma phye ba yin la/ de dang mthun pa'i brjod pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /zhes dam bca' ba ni snying la babs 4 pas na sbyon thupa'i tshig las 'phags pas na 'di la brjod par bya ba yod dam zhes rtog par 'gyur gyi 'di ni mi 'tsham pa'i ngag go zhes ldog thupa'i yan lag ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir brjod par bya ba de yang gang zhig yin/ dkyil 'khor ni 'di na rab tu mang ste 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor yang yod la/ de ni sngags kyi rgyud las bkag ste/ kha cig thugazhan gyi rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pas/ ngan song gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa de dag ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas so/ /yang 'di na bya ba'i rgyud las rab tu sdug bsngal ba'i dka' thub brtan 8par bya ba'i dkyil 'khor yod la/ de yang 'dod par bya ba ma yin te rnam par g.yeng bas nang gi rnal 'byor dang 'gal zhing gcig tu sdug bsngal bas na mi 'dod la/ de yang dpal mchog dang po las bkag ste/ dka' thub spyad pa mi bzod zhepas/ /sems g.yengs ⑫gyur nas ma grub 11po/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher bstan pas so/ /de bzhin du 'di na kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs te gsungs pa khong du ma chud pas bud med bsten /pa la sogs pa sgra ji bzhin par 'dzin cing bud med bsten nyu/pa'i dkyil 'khor dag yod la/ de yang 'dod pa 31—1467
